kaikarka shasha/ /(/thu gaṅge hūṃsni/ cho 3 gli ༷ lhu/ tram̐/dzño+o+o+o/ yam̐ ra༅༅/ /rgyal gces lhag bsam gyis phyug pa'i rgyal rtse rig 'dzin chos nyid kyi sku che'i byung ba ‘zhang pa'i dran tho zhes pa bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pas chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng 11 par 'grem gnang bar yi rangs bsngags brjod zhu rgyu yin/ phyi lo brgya phrag nyi shu pa'i dkyil tsam nas bod rdzongs su dus 'gyur mi bzad pa'i dbang gis rgyal bstan chab srid mi rigs dang bcas pa chags 'jig gi gnas su gyar skabs snying lta bas dang / lhag bsam gyis phyug cing dpa' 'dzangs rtul phod gzhan 'gran ma mchis pa'i bod rigs pho mo grangs las 'das pa zhig gis rang gi gces pa'i lus srog la'ang phangs pa med par ngal ba khyad bsad kyis chab srid kyi las 'gul sna cesags su zhugasate/ lo grangs mang po btson rar tshud cing mnar gcod bsam brjod las 'das pa myong dgos byung yang zhum pa med par rang dbang gi go skabagathob ma thag slar yang mang tshogs kyi zhabs 'degs ldospro bas 'jug pa de dag gi sku che'i gnas tshu.ā+oni bod mi rigs kyi byung ba'i nang 'god par 'os pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi lo rgyus shig yin pa ma zad/ gzhon skyes rnams la snying stobs dang lhag slo spel ba'i skul—ma bzang po yang yin pas/ 'di dag yig thog tu 'god rgyu gal che'i 'gan khur zhig yin stabs dpe deb 'di'i rtsom pa por bkrin rjes dran dang /blo gsal don gnyer can gyi klog pa po mang por phan sgogs rlabs chen yong ba'i re 'dun bcas btsan drodal ro/da gzhung bka' shag gis phyi lo na005 zla 8 tshes zha1 la//— (ci7spya0mirtsam5smosnye5ṭīrdo sdu 1sbyi~Xsdu stu rdo shātāḍādri sdu stu/ni la/ sduṭ+wāṃ/ trī twosdu3sdu~Xrdo:| / kau ༷khri sdutrīgh+rishā2/ 7 dīsduk+to5 ṭ+wāṃ / ṭ+wāṃsmoshā/)0/892—nyi49 4

’47— / lhazlo/sgyu/‘ rī/ dzi (/ gyi/ /rdzo kā 7k+ṇi tsho7ngaspyo r+sha cho rdzo rta ( dzi spyo3 rdzanya/ r+ha4 ( —4 ༈༷ 96tshuspyo( rnyi/3 4 7 — ho sa rig 'dzin chos nyid dang / bza' zla bkra sa dbang mo/ bu slo bzang dbang ga bcas/ lo 1 97 8 lor/

dkar chagadapal ldan rang gzhung bka' shag nas stsal ba'i ched brjod/par bskrun gsal bshad/ dang pa/gleng brjod/ bzhi/be+e tshan dang po/ rgyal rtse'i dgon grong dang /༷/la sral gnad bsdus/ 1be+e tshan gnyis pa/ khyim rgyud dang / chung dus/ 11le tshan gsum pa/ zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing /rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 2༷be+e tshan bzhi pa/ lha kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug 47le tshan lnga pa/ lto kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa/ snyo4le tshan drug pa/ gzhis rtse e ma sgang nas spo bo spra rmog tu las sgyur la brdzangs pa/ 84be+e tshan bdun pa/ 'khor zhag gi dus tshod thengs gnyis/ 94

le tshan brgyad pa/ 7gong sa mchog gi sku par las/ nga dang a co ngag dbang la gnas tshul 'phrad pa/ 11phyile tshan dgu pa/ gcen d+ku nad dang / snes dbang gi bza' zla/ 124le tshan bcu pa/ rgyal sa lha sar khyim gzhis bcas te/rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 144be+e tshan bcu gcig lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ byu 1snyo be+e tshan bcu gnyis/ bod gnas khyab spel rgyud bsgrags dang /bros gyol/ 194be+e tshan bcu gsum/ btsan gyol spyi tshogs nang sri zhu/ 2༷phyizur bkol dang po/ rgyal rtse khul gyi bstan srung dang dmag rnams kyi ming gzhung gang dran bkod pa/ 214zur bkol gnyis pa/ rgya gzhung gi gdug rtsub 'og bod mi'i tshe srog shor ba'i ming gzhung / 218mjug byang / 2 9

par skrun gsal bshad/ gcigapar skrun gsal bshad/7spyi nor gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas gsum bcu'i dus dran thengs 28 pa'i thog bstsal ba'i bka' slob nang / de snga so so rang nyid kyi thog la gnas tshul mang po zhig byung ba dang / de bzhin gzhan zer rjes 'brangs ma yin pa'i khungs ldan gyi gnas tshul rang gis mthong thos byung ba dag tshang mas do snang chen pos yig thog tu 98 god dgos/ de 'dra ma byas na/ gnas tshul sdug bsngal ji snyed rang thog myangs pa'i mi mang po zhig rim bzhin cadags 'gro yi yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus skabs shig la de'i tshe de'i dus sdug po zhe po zhig byung ba red ces spom tshig tsam ma gtogs gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa'i gnas tshul zhib tshags su la'ang bshad rgyu med pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten dngos byung lo rgyus rgyas bsdus gang yin yang yig the ga la bkod de yig cha mang tsam 'don thabs byed dgos zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs dom dang / lhag par btsan byol spyi tshogs nang tshogs sde dang mi sger gang rung nas deb rigs sna tshogs

gnyis/ par skrun gsal bshad/par skrun byas dang byed bzhin yod na yang las gzhi 'di'i thog dmigs bkar phyag las gnang mkhan med khar/ rang yul bod nang du gzhi rtsa'i smra brjod rang dbang tsam yang med na mi cherware lo rgyus ngag rgyun tsam las yig thog 'god rgyu shin tu dka' bas skyid sdug mi 'drartab brgyud pa'i mi tshe'i dngos myong dngos byung gi lo rgyus de dag dang thog rang gi skad yig thog gsog bsgrub bgyis te rim bzhin 'di nas bod dbyin gnyis kyi thog dpar 'grems byed thub na/ lo rgyus deb phreng kha 'thor du mi gnas par rjes rabs klog pa po rnams la 'chodal bde ba/ de bzhin mgon po gang nyid kyi dgongs gzhi rlabs po che bsgrubs thub pa ma zad/ wa da kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus rtsom sgrig dpar skrun gyi kha bskang thub pa so/gas la dmigs te 'di ga cho gas pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyis las gzhi 'di 'go 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng bcu pa bar par skrun bgyis pa dang / da dung par skrun zhu 'char mang dag gcig yod khongs nas da res chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng bcu gcig pa 'di bzhin chab srid btson zur rig 'dzin chos nyid kyi lo rgyus 〈〈zhing pa'i dran tho 〉〉zhes pa ngangoji ṭa su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis rgyal spyi'i steng bod don thog rgyab skyor gnang mkhan rnams dang / de bzhin lnga da nang gi yid skyo ba'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib gnang mkhan rnams la lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhir thugs

par skrun gsal bshad/ gsum/phan gsos re/ lhag par bod phyi nang du gnas pa'i rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams kyis khong gis gtsos rgyal gces pa rnams kyis rgya dmar gung khran tang gi gdug rtsub 'og bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad pa gsal rtogs kyis bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gso'i don du zungs khrag gsar pa zhig sbyin thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yod/ mtha' don bod kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng bcu gcig pa par du skrun par rang gzhung bka' shag nas ched brjod bka' drin bstsal ba dang / lo rgyus kyi bdag po dang / 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig pa dang las byed rnams nas phyar ba gru 'degs gnang ba'i 'bras bus mthar par skrun thub par bce sa min snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa'i dza gas gtso/ka tsha ngag dbang 'od 'bar gyis/spyi lo 2005 zla 8 tshes 18 nyin/

gling brdzod// bzhi/gleng bathegad/sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ nor ldan blun wa'i nang na mang / /dpa' bo gcan gzan khrod na mod/ /legs bshad mkhas pa'i khrod 'byin pa'i/ /dam pa 'jig rten 'di na dkon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang stegs bu'i thog nas 'chad pa po la thogs pa med kyang gnas lugs gang dang gang gi don la bab pa'i gtam smra ba shin tu dkon tshod kyang / spyi lo 2004 zla 9 'di ga tshogs pa'i tshogs chen rgyas 'dzoms kyi stegs bu'i thog gnad la khel zhing spyi sems ldan ba'i gtam bshad gnang ba'i bgres song zhig gis nga'i yid dbang med drangs/khong gi lo rgyus bri rgyu'i las 'gan phran la bab pa nas nga gnyis bar 'brel ba'i 'go tshugs/ bgres song rig 'dzin mchog gis lo mang ring nas dka' spyad 'bad pas phyag bris mdzad pa'i ma

lnga / gling brdzod/zin shog grangs brgya dang brgyad cu tsam phran la gtad de bzo bcos ci dgos kyang byed dgos pa'i re bskul mdzad/ zla ngo gsum ma zin tsam ring dngos su las don 'di gar nga gnyis bgro gleng lhug pos snon 'phri spor gcog zhus te zla ba brgyad par dngos su grub/ de'i ring khong gis ka kor gcig kyang med par gal che snga na ches rtag phebs gnang ba ma zad/ gus kyi myong bar khong ni/ dka' spyad 'bad bce na gnang mkhan zhig dang / lo mang song ba'i snga/na gnad gang zhig la'ang lam seng gsungs thub pa'i dran shes brtan pa bcas kyis khyad chos la brten da bar mi tshe'i lo rgyus bris pa'i nang nas stabs bde shos kyi cha rkyen bskrun/da cha khong ni dgung lo bdun cur nye yang / bod mi rigs nyams rgud kyi g.yang sar zag dus khong zhing pa'i pho gsar dar ma na tshod yongs su rdzogs shing gnas lugs gsal rjen thub pa zhig yin/de nas bzung rang nyid skyid 'dod kyi re ba yongs su dor nas mi rigs kyi bde sdug khur du blangs te che phra'i 'thab rtsod nang zhugs/ gnad don des gzhan dbang 'og bya sgro rlung gis 'khyer ba bzhin gnas nges

gling baji+od/ drugamed du mar mi tshe sdug gi 'tsho dgos shing / rang gi dbang thang longs spyod dang / snying du sdug pa'i chung ma yang zla ngo gnyis las gshib rgyu ma byung bar yongs su blos gtong byed dgos byung /lhag par skad grags che ba'i bsam yas kyi ltogs gsod chen mo'i skabs khong bkres ltogs kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos smos med khar/ chung spar ma gang nas gso skyong mdzad pa'i khong gi skyes ma zhal 'jal ba'i go skabs tsam yang med par 'jig rten 'di nas sdug gi ngang gtan du gyes 'dug pa de lta bu'i sems sdug ni rang gi pha mar sri zhu che ba'i bu phrug gcig rgi ngos nas bshad na bajo da thabs ga la yod/ bsam yul las 'das pa'i sdug gi lo zla de dag nang khong gis mgo bo btegs nas mu mthud rang dbang gi phyogs su 'brangs pa las/lto 'grangs nyi ma dro tshe chos pa'i gzugs/ /rkyen ngan sdug bsngal byung tshetho mal ba/ /zhes pa'i ngang tshul du ma song ba ni lo rgyus nas ra 'phrad/de tsam ma zad/ khong btsan dbang gi khor yug las grol rjes bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar rang gi bse da nams kyi bgo skal du brtse

bdun/ gling brdzod/gdungs zab pa'i chung ma gsar pa dang bu phrug rgyu nor longs spyod mi dman tsam yang mu mthud snga da spyi wa na ched 'bad pa brgya phrag gnang ba'i g.yo ba med pa'i snying stobs dang lhag bsam bzang por slob sbyong byed dgos pa rang red/ deb 'dir khong gi mdzad rjes cha tshang 'god thabs ma byung yang bzo bcos skabs rang shed du ma song bar bgres song gi thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs thabs zhus shing / 'das pa'i grub 'bras kyi lo rgyus 'dis khong gi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa zhig min te/ 7gong sa mchog sku tshe brtan pa dang / nga tsho gzhis byes rnams rang dbang ldan pa'i ngang mnyam 'dzoms byung na/nga rgas po'i bsam don 'grub bo zhes yang yang gsungs/ de ni mi rgas na rang yul dran pa dang / bya rgas na tshang dran/ zhes pa'i nang dodan las brgal ba'i nga tsho rgan dar gzhon gsum tshang ma'i mngon 'asnga da nyag cig ma yin nam/blo bzang bkra shis kyis bod rgyal lo 2132 bod zla drug pa phyi ma'i dmar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa/spyi lo 2005 zla 8 tshes 24 nyin/
di

rgyal rtsa'i rgon grong dang /yal srol sand sīspus/le tshan dang lnga /rgyal rtse'i dbo na thodang dang / yul sredal gnad bsdus/ka dag snying rje'i gter chen mig mi 'dzum//kha ba ri pa'i mgon dpung mi yi gar//ga na gnas kyang snying rje'i lcags kyu yis//nga cag rgud pa mtha' dag 'phrog gyur cig/myang stod rig pa 'byung ba'i gnas kyi rgyal rtse ba'i yul lung chags bab dang / 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa dgon gnas/goms srol bzang po'i dus ston bcas mdor bsdus gleng bar bya ba la/yul ljongs mtho dman dang dro grang shin tu snyoms bing /sa zhing dang 'ango ga las mthun

2 zhing pa'i dran tho/rkyen thams cad phun sum cho gas pa'i yul zhig yin/ de yang thog mar rgyal rtse'i ri bo che zer ba'i rtser slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa phebs te sa gzhi rnams byin gyis brlabs/ de'i dus su lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba zhig bsnams nas byon te bdud rtsi'i bum pa slob dngo na gyi phyag tu phul nas lha'i bdud rtsi'i ro myang du gsol zhus pa dang / slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa zad mi shes par byin gyis brlabs/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la bum pa'i bdud rtsi skyes te/ rigs kyi bu lha'i bdud rtsi'i ro myang bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs pas yul gyi ming la lha'i bdud rtsi myangs pas myang zhes bya'o/de nas lha'i bdud rtsi mang por spel nas slob dpon rje 'bangs bcas pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa thodags te gnod sbyin gang bzang gi rtser bdud rtsi nas blugs te gangs ri 'di yang lha'i bdud rtsis byin gyis rlabs pas/de dag chu bo chen po 'di la myang gi chu zhes dang lha'i bdud rtsi'i ro myang bzhin pa myang gser gzhung ring mo zhes bya/ zhes byung ba ltar/ yul gyi ming la myang zhes dang / ri thams cad shel gyi mdog ltar dkar ba la shel dkar/chos rgyal gyi bzhugs gnas ri rtse na yod pa la/ stu/ brang rgyal mkhar rtse brjod pas/ de rnams gcig tu bsdoms pas myang lha da shel dkar rgyal rtse zhes ming du grags/

rgyal rtse'i dgon grong dang / yul srol gnad bsdus/ 3gnas der mkhas dang grub pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa du ma gyon pas myang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas zhes grags pa don dang ldan la/ khyad par chos kyi rgyal po rim pa gsum byung ba'i chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags ni/ mdo rgyud du ma las lung du bstan cing bod khams ched du skyong ba'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis kyang lung bstan pa yin te/ de yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis phyag dang skor ba rin po che'i maṇa ḍal phul nas zhus pa/ slob dpon chen snga lags/ bdag 'di nas tshe 'phos nas gang dang gang du 'gro ba'i don byed pa sogs bka' bstsal tu gsol/zhes zhus pas/ gu rus bka' bstsal pa/ rgyal po chen lnga legs par gson/ mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid skye ba bcu bdun brgyud pa'i tha ma la/'di nas lho nub mtshams nas yul rta ro dmar po kha phye ba 'dra ba zhig gi nang du 'brug gi lo la lhums su zhugs pa/ skyes pa shes rab dang snying rje che ba// brtson 'grus che la skrub pa la brtson pa/ dam tshig gtsang zhing rlom sems chung ba/ khong yangs shing kha nyung ba/ rgyud zhi zhing gzhan la sgro skur mi 'debs pa/ rig pa myur zhing yid gzhung ba/ mdog dkar la ngang rgyud ring ba/ skyes bu de lta bu zhig tu skyes nas rgyal po nyid la da lta ngas gdams pa thams cad dang 'phrad nas skye ba des rgyud bcad nas de nas nub phyogs

4 zhing pa'i dran po/bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ pad+ma la brdzus te skyes nas sangs rgya bar 'gyur zhes/ lung bstan/lha bas kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis rab byung bdun pa'i sa khyi spyi lo 1418 lo'i bod zla 6 tshes 2 la rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde'i dgon pa gsar du btab cing / dgon pa der grwa tshang bcu bdun yod pa ni/ dge lugs grwa tshang bdun/ sa lugs grwa tshang bzhi/ zha lu'i grwa tshang gcig dus 'kho ra grwa tshang bzhi/ sa skya dge lugs thun mong gi grwa tshang gser khang 'og pa bcas yin/ dgon pa 'dir grags che ba rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1419lo mjug bzhengs pa'i lha khang chen mo dang / rab byung bdun pa'i me lug spyi lo 1427 lor bzhengs shing thog sa bcu gcig lhag tsam dang rgya khyedan la gzhu 'doms brgya dang brgyad yod pa'i sku 'bum mchod rten chen mo bkra shis sgo mang / rab byung bdun pa'i spyi lo 1431 lor thog mar bzhengs pa/'i bka' 'gyur gser chos rgyal rtse them spa ngas ma bcas yin/ rig gnas gsar brje chen re/ra bod yongs kyi dgon gnas sogs gtor bshig gtong ba'i skabs ri lding grwa tshang dang gur pa grwa tshang gnyis kyi khang stong dang /dgon gyi lcags ri/ gos sku spel/ lha khang chen mo dang sku 'bum mchod rten bcas kyi phyi'i bkod par gtor skyon che ba ma byung bar lhag pa las/ nge

rgyal rtse'i dgon grong dang yul sro la sand bsdus/ 5min mes po'i shul bzhag gi lo rgyus ring zhing rin thang gzhal thabs med pa'i dgon khag rtsa stor btang ste bshul lus tsam med par bzos/ rjes su lha khang chen mo dang sku 'bum mchod rten nyams chag byung ba rnams rgya gzhung nas gron dngul btang ste nyams gso byas/phran gyi skyes yul kha mo dgon pa ni/ kha mo'i dgon bdag bla ma se 'bri ban dhe yin zhing bla ma se 'bri ban dhes yang dag gis skrub pa mdzad pas bum chu 'khol ba bum pa bsnams nas bar snang la 'phur te bum chu thigs pa re la shug pa re 'khrungs/ shug sdong bcu gcig sku da pa nas gsum ma gtogs rtsa stong phyin/ ring tshad thog sa gsum tsam yod pa'i lhag ma gsum po de yang skam por gnas pa rig gsar skabs rtsa 'gog btang /phyis kha mo dgon gu ru chos dbang gdung rgyud kyis bzung nas gtsug lag khang gsar du bzhengs/ kha mo dgon du nang rten gu ru chos dbang gi zhabs rjes tshe bum du grags pa zhig dang / yang them spang ma zhes pa'i zhabs ya gcig gi zhabs rjes/ sor bdun tsam gyi sku tshad ldan pa'i gu ru'i sku tshab gter lnga 'khrul med zhal gser rtsa ba nas mi bzhes pa gcig yod pa de gter nas ba'es par grags pa'i za ma tog gcig nang bzhugs su gasku la yod/ da dung kha ro ha yang sbug nas gu ru chos dbang gis gter nas bzhes ba shing gi gter phur khru do tsam yod pa zhig gter sgrom zhes 'bod pa'i sgog

snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/phor zhig nang mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i zhabs ngar dum bu dang / bram ze khye'u bdun pa'i dbu thod dum bu / gu ru chos dbang gi ral pa'i thod bcings glegs bam chung ngu zhig bcas yod/ 'du khang nang dkyil du gu ru chos dbang nga 'dra ma gsung dre na par grags pa zhig dang / g.yas su gu ru tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyi dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i gu ru tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyi sku zhig g.yon du gu ru'i bla sku gzhan zhig bcas 'jim sku mi tshad las che tsam gsum dang / de min khru do tsam sku da pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi 'jim sku/ 'du khang khyon yongs kyi gyang ldebs su na raka dong sprug tu gsal ba'i rdo brkos kyi zhi khro'i sku grangs med kyis yongs su bskor ba dang / gsung rten 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ de bzhin grwa btsun bzhi bcu tsam la 'dang ba'i ja snod gter khro zhig dang gter skyogs shig bcas sku da/gtsug lag khang gi thog khar mgon khang shar nub gnyis yod pa nas nub tu kha smad bla brang gis bskangs bshag sogs byed/ shar du dgon pa'i dbu mdzad kyis zla re'i dgu gsum la dgu gsol gtong / gong 'khod dgon pa'i nang rten gtso bo rnams nas rig gsar skabs kha mo bla brang gi lcam bgres mo can gyis sku tshab gter lnga sbas skung thub pa dang / phran gyi skyed byed mig dmar stobs rgyas nas zhabs rjes tshe bum ma sbas nyar thub

rgyal rtse'i dgon grong dang / yul srol gnad bsdus/ 7pa las rten gtso gzhan rnams kyis gtsos sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod pa'i yo chas grangs las 'das pa rnams rig gsar skabs rtsa lha ra btang /srung ma gtso ngo mgon lnga ma ning / lha mo bung bzhon dbang phyug ma/ rgyalapo sku lnga/ chos bdag jag pa me len/ yul lha btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun gyi ya gyal zhig bcas yin/kha mo dgon pa'i rgyun du chos phyogs byed sgo ni/ chos lugs rnying ma lho gter yin zhing zla ba 'char can gyi tshes bcu rgyas par gtong ba dang bod zla bzhi par nyin brgyad tsam sgrub mchod tshugs shing 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sgrog sbyang gnang / bod zla bcu pa'i nyer bzhi tsam nas bcu gcig pa'i bco lnga bar thugs rje chen po yang snying kun 'dus kyi sgo nas ma ṇi skrub mchod tshugs shing / de'i ring bcu gcig pa'i tshes shar la kha mo bla brang gis gtong sgo btang ste bod gzhung gi bstan srid zhabs brtan ched khro bo rol pa dang gshin rje chas ka nag po'i lha nas gtor skrub dang tshes bdun nyin gtor rgyag byed/ tshes brgyad dang bcu nyin grwa khral gtong sgo rgyas par gtong / tshes bcu bzhir 'cham dang kha mo'i dbo na bdag sngags 'chang gis ser skya mi mang la ma ṇi'i dbang bskur ba de skabs g.yas g.yon mi mang 'du 'dzoms che bas dga' ston rten 'brel ched lung tshan phan tshun gzhas dang zhabs bro'i 'gran bsdur gyis mtshan gyi dus 'das nas chodags

8 zhing pa'i dran tho/pa'i skya rengs bsu zhing / tshes bco lnga nyin dgon par lha bsang btang rjes g.yas gasku/na grong sde rnams kyis dar lcogs btsugs te chos zhu ba rnams chang 'thung dga' ston dang lha ra gzhas kyi ngang la rol/kha morware lho nub khyedags me le gang mtshams na/ nying ro dang myang chu 'dus pa'i mtshams der sa gru gsum dang / gnam gru gsum/ chu gru gsum gyi brag steng thong lcags rdzong zhes pa dpal ldan sa skya ba'i mthu sgrub sa'i rdzong gog cig sku da pa der jo bo mi tshad ma zhig dang mgon po gur gyi sku thang byin can du ma bzhugs/ de nas nying ro'i chu brgyud nas yar me le gnyis tsam gyi shar ngos lung shur dog po zhig brgyud grog ra zer ba'i grong tsho chung ngu zhig dang / de nas yar mtshams na/ 'u brag stod smad kyi grong tsho chung ngu sanyis yod pa'i byang rgyud kyi ri ldebs su 'o brag zer ba'i dgon rnying zhig yod pa de grub thodab dmar sgom gyis phyag btab tshul dang der chos sde gong 'og gnyis yod pa gsham der sku 'dra li ma dang gdung rten du ma dang / gsung rten pu ti gser chos dngul chos sogs 'du khang nang gi gyang gi mthod tshad dang mnyam par brtsigs pa bskor te bzhugs/de'i mkhris kyi ri ldebs su chos sde chung ba thog sa nyis thog yod pa der li ma dang sku gsung thugs rten mang / srung ma gce bo sno brag lha mo zhes pa mthu rtsal can zhig sku da pa bcas mdor bsdus tsam las/ myang je da smad

rgyal rtse'i dgon grong dang / yul srol gnad bsdus/ 9bar gsum gyi dgon gnas sogs 'dir re re nas brjod thabs bral bas rgyas par myang chos 'byung dang dung dkar tshig mdzod la gzigs par mdzod/yul srol goms gshis ni/ rgyal rtse khul gyi smad rgyud rnams kyis lo gsar bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas gtong ba dang / rgyal rtse'i stod dang grong khyer bas bod zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas lo gsar gtong srol yod/ rgyal rtse'i dge rtsa zhes bod zla gsum pa'i tshes sum cur rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde'i chos rgyud khag gi rang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod tshugs te bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lngar dar po che sku bzhengs dang /tshes bco brgyad nyin gos sku bkrams te bla khag so sos mchodad 'bul byed/tshes bcu dgu nyin nas rgyal rtse mda' dmag ces snga dro rta rgyug ma dang / de rjes ma ra rta rgyugs zhes khungs so sos me mda' dang mda' 'phen gyis rta rgyugs/ tshes nyi shu nyin rgyal rtse'i lho shar ngos kyi thang chen steng rdzong gtso rnams kyi gur dang mthus mi 'dzoms te 'khri khungs so sos mda' 'phen gyis 'gran bsdur dang / de nas ston mo rgyas par gtong / bod zla lnga pa'i nang rgyal rtse sman bla zhes dgon gyi bla khag rnams kyis sman bla'i sgrub mchod tshugs pa dang / rong thug po dang ra lung gnyis lo res 'khor gyis slor dpon zhes pas bskor ba'i sne khrid de rgyal rtse grong rdasmu dgon grong yongs la phyi skor du 'gro/

10 zhing pa'i dran tho/bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin rgyal rtse rdzong dang bla khag so sos 'cham dang dgu gtor 'phen pa bcas sngon byung mes po'i lugs bzang rnams dran gso lta bur mdor bsdus bkod pa las zhib par yig dzamags la 'jigs nas ma spros sdu///kā li ā li'i sdeb sbyor mi legs kyang //kha dro mngar skyur sna mang 'jig rten du//ga byas rmi lam lta bu'i 'das don rnams//nga yi sems su 'char ba rags rim bkod//mokhu sgyu la dri 'dzirdosditre+oXrdo+oX yatram̐ 7snyedi— —〉/rtedhe /༷ /rko ༷༷3) phukā/ཿ be+e kre 7skya

khyim rgyud dang / chung dus/ 11le tshan gnyis pa/khyim rgyud dang / chung dus/phran gyi skyes yul gtsang myang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas shel dkar rgyal rtse'i mnga' khongs kha mo hrong tsho khang spel zhes pa yin la/ yul lung gi 'tsho rten sa ma 'brog dang / thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod/khang spel ni mi tshang rnying khungs shig yin yang mi rabs mang po'i 'o/ rgyus bshad rgyu mi snang / 'on kyang phran nas yar ded pa'i mi rabs gsum gong gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus tsam 'chad na/ de sngo na kha mo khang spel la rigs rgyud 'dzin pa'i bu ma byung bar bu mo zla ba dpal 'dzoms zhes pa lang 'cho brtas rjes/ de nas mi ring ba'i sa lung dmar sbi khyim bu nyi ma dgra 'dul zhes pa mag par bsus / kho gnyis lo shas bza' tshor sbrel yang bu phrug

12 zhing pa'i dran tho/ma byung bas mag pa nyi ma dgra 'dul la yang bskyar kha mo khang rgyab dkyil gyi bu mo mig dmar bu khrid ces pa chung mar bsus nas bu phrug bu mo zla ba bu khrid dang / bu mig dmar stobs rgyas/ bu don grub bcas gsum byung /nang gi 'gan 'khur dang bu phrug gso skyong mna' ma chen ma dang chung mas bskyangs pa dang / pha nyi ma dgra 'dul rgyun du tshong las shugs che tsam gnyer te lha sa khul dang / 'u yug 'dzoms thang / lho kha byams pa gling / yar 'brog stag lung sogs tshong 'dus gang sar tshong skor la bskyod de pha yis dpal 'byor 'du 'god kyis khyim gyi 'byor 'khos sogs gang cir cha rkyen legs shing 'byu dngul bun skyed gtong yul yang rgya che tsam yod/'on kyang dus shig nas pha nyi ma dgra 'dul 'bam gyi nad gzhis zin te tshong bskyod skabs kyang rtar mi chibs par rgya bung la chibs pa dang /mthar nad gzhi des bu phrug gsum nas che ba bu mo lo dgu dang / 'bring ba lo drug chung ba lo gsum las nar ma son par pha nyi ma dgra 'dul dus kyi chos nyid du gyur/ des sems sdug gis dus de nas bzung chen ma sems khams mi bde bar gyur pas khyim dang shul lus rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i 'gan 'khur chung ma mig dam ra bu khrid kyi phrag steng du lhung /'das po nyi ma dgra 'dul kha mo bla brang gi mi khongs yin par brten/kha mo bla brang dang kha mo grong sde'i mi drag kha cig nas bud med dang bu phrug

khyim rgyud dang / chung dus/ 13la blta skyong gnang khul dang 'brel/ phyir btang bun skyed yig rigs rnams la zhib 'jug dang yig bsang brgyab pa sogs gang ltar/ thag nye'i bun skyed bsdu yul rim pas nyung ngur gyur nas khyim gyi 'dzin chas dang / gyon chas sogs 'thor skyon ma byung tsam las phyogs mtha' sa khad ring sa'i skyed gtong 'byu dngul bun skyed yong khungs sa thag ring ba 'u yug sa dmar khul sogs la bu lon ded mkhan ma byung ba bcas/ khyim tshang sngon lta bu'i cha rkyen med par nyam zhan du 'asku skabs kyang ma mig dmar bu khrid nas bu mig dmar stobs rgyas slob grwar btang yang slob mjug ma thon gong bu gnyis lo na bcu grangs son mtshams/ kha sma/ bla brang nas bu gnyis nang zan du bka' 'gug gis rdzi bor mngags/khang spel gyi bu gnyis kha mo bla brang gi nang zan du sdod skabs khang spel gyi bu mo zla ba bu khrid nar son gzhon nu ma 'tshar longs 'ong bzhin pa dang / rang bzhin gyi skyes 'bras mtshar ba/ pha ma bzang po'i bu rgyud kyi rgyan gos legs po bcas yod stabs de'i skyes gzugs la kha mo bla brang bi sras bgres gzhon 'bring gsum ka chags te rang rang gi 'dun thabs su 'dod kyang mtha' ma ra sras tha chung dang mdza' mthun 'brel ba byung / go skabs de brgyud khang spel gyi bu gnyis gnas skabs nang zan nas dgongs 'khrol gyis rang khyim du log thub kyang kha mo bla brang gi sras ṅgan 'bring sad+nghaces

14 zhing pa'i dran tho/kyis zhe 'khon bzung nas/ sras 'bring ba'i mna' ma'i gnyen nye rgyal rtse mda' dpon zhig yod pa de'i mdun khang spel bu gnyis kyis lugs mthun khral rgyug khrims 'khur mi byed pa'i kha mchu btsugs te dbang shed thub re byas kyang / mda' dpon gyis zhu rtsad thengs gcig byas rjes kha mo bla brang la bden pa med pa shes nas slad kha mchu gtug bsher byed dgos na gzhan du rgyugs zhes bdag sprod ma byas/de dus kha mo bla brang gi sras gsum gyis yab kyi bka' la ma brtsis par nang khul 'khrug rtsod chen po byung ste dgon gyi nang rten sogs 'thor skyon yong nyen la thug skabs yab kyis rgyal rtse spyi rdzong la zhu yig phul nas kha mchu btsugs/ kha mchu zhu nyan byed par sras gsum dang dgon pa'i mi mthus dang byed gte kha shas rgyal rtse spyi rdzong du bka' 'gug gnang skabs/khang spel gyi bu gnyis kyis lugs mthun khral rgyug ma byas pa'i rtsod rnyog sngar bshad ltar che ba mig dmar stobs rgyas byed gte'i khongs bka' 'gug gnang / kha mchu'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni dgon pa dang bla brang gnyis mchod gzhis dang / gtong sgo/ rten gtso khag gi bdag dbang la ma mthun par yab kyis dgon pa'i phyogs gnang bar mngon/ spyi rdzong sar bka' 'gug gnang nas zhu ba zhu len gang mtshams byas kyang kha mdzadri thag ma chod par gzhung sar snyan 'bul zhus rjes bka' shag nas zhib sa gro spyi shangs me ri

khyim rgyud dang / chung dus/ 15skyabs la bka' khyab phebs/ de bar sku gsung thugs rten rnams rgyal rtse spyi rdzong gis thel tse dam 'byar gyis bdag nyar mdzad yod pa gro spyir rtsis 'bul zhus/ gro spyi shangs me ri skyabs zhes pa de ni skad grags don dang ldan pa'i 'jigs zil che zhing drang shugs ldan pa zhig yin/ dper na/ kha mchu zhu sbyor ba dang gyod ya gnyis mnyam du skong 'gugs zhu len byed skabs khrims khang du 'byor 'phral tshang ma g.yas g.yon pus mo btsugs nas bzhag thog gro spyi'i sa srung dmag mi lding shog gcig yod pa ru sgrig gis dmag rol dang bcas gyod rtsod pa rnams mtha' bskor gyis bod mda' che ba 'dzam grags re zung 'phangs te/ las bya ba rnams kyis khrims lcags dang / khrims chad zhags pa sogs gyod snyu da pa rnams kyi mdun sar dbyugs nas 'jigs rngam chen pos mi rnams bla 'dar ba zhig bzos rjes/ gzhi nas zhu ba zhu len dang dri rtsad byed/ mi nyes can 'ga' shas kyis rna cog dang yan lag sogs gcod breg byas pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod/gro spyir lo gnyis ring zhu gtugs byas mthar bka' shag nas bcad khra phebs te bla brang dang kha mo dgon pa'i bar 'os shing gnyis mos kyi thag chod byung ba ma zad/ khang spel bu mi dmar stobs rgyas dang don grub rgan gzhon gnyis nas lo re dga' ldan lnga mchod gong kha mo bla brang la mi bogs dngul srang gsum re chad lus med pa phul phyin/ pha tsha bu rgyud nas nang

16 zhing pa'i dran tho/zan khongs las bskul snyan 'tsher gang yang mi chog pa'i lag star byed dgos bka' chad phebs/ khang spel gyi bu mig dmar stobs rgyas dang don grub gnyis lang 'tsho brtas rjes sgo bzhi gzhung rgyug khral khongs ma lang byang ma'i bu mo ye shes sgrol ma mdun mar bsus rjes phru gu bdun byung ba/ dang po dang gnyis pa bu yin zhing rgan 'go gdan sa chen po ser byes su rab tu byung / gsum pa nas drug pa bar bu mo/ de rjes ma ye shes sgrol mar mngal du phru gu 'khor nas ma skyes sngon gcen mo gsum pa pa sangs bu khrid la pha ma gnyis kyis ma'i mngal na yod pa'i phru gu 'di bu dang bu mo gang yin nam zhes bka' 'dri gnang ba/ gcen mos de'i lan du/ bu red brjod/ bu yin na ming ga re gdags kyi yin nam zhes dris par// bu rgyal tshe ring gdags rgyu yin zhes brjod/spyi lo 1936 bod me byi lo'i zla ba 1 tshes 3 nyin phran btsas 'dug pa byis pa chung dus rgyal tshe ring ngam zur chag tu lo rgyal zhes 'bod/ lo gnyis son dus pha ma gnyis mnyam du myang stod du yar stod lha ri gzim phug dgon pa'i yang srid rin po che zhu ba rnying ma'i bla ma zhig la mjal kha dang ming zhus pas rig 'dzin chos nyid ces bstsal/ phran slob grwar 'gro myong med kyang rang lo drug tsam nas pha yis zhor du bod yig slob khrid gnang nas bod yig 'bri klog shes tsam yod/ rang lo bcu la son

cim rgyud dang / chung dus 17skabs te bod shing bya 'o/ra pha mas rta drel la do po bkal nas lha sa smon lam/ chen mor 'khrid pa dang de rjes rang lo bco brgyad la son skabs mgo rje byang lho'i sru mo'i sku zla bsod nams dang lhan du lha sar smon lam zhal mjal zhu bar bskyod/ snga phyi gnyis kar lha sa smon lam chen mor s+t+ri nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po tshogs phebs gnang ba zhal mjal thengs du ma dang /thengs dang por dgong dro nyi ma bzhud la khad la 'char can jo bo dbu skra'i ri dwags pho morware nye 'khris nas 7gong sa mchog gis mang tshogs la chu tshod phyed tsam ring zhal mjal dang / skabs re gtsūg lag khang gi yang steng e waṃ khang du dam/ngas mjal gnang / rang nyid la snga phyi gnyis bsde mas mjal kha thengs lnga dang / zhal mjal thengs mang gi skal bzang sgob/ gdan sa ser 'bras dge sasum dang ri brgya bsam gtan gling brag g.yer pa bcas su mchod mjal la phyin pa dang / thengs snga mar phran gyi gcen po rgan pa ser byes gtsang pa khang tshan nang yod pa shag tu mjal bar bskyod/ de skabs rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi zhang lho bzang dngos grub dang / bkra shis tshe ring / pad+ma rgyal po bcas dang / dgon se shar gyi zhang dkon mchog dang ༷༅na nye rnams yang yang mjal/ smon lam mjug byams pa gdan 'dren grub pa dang rang yul du lag ga/

18 zhing pa'i dran tho/phran rang lo bcu gnyis la son skabs nang gi a khu don grub mkhris pa snyun pa dang / se rar yod pa'i gcen po gzhung dang se ra'i dus zing nang 'tshud de gnyis ka lo de gar snga rjes su 'das/ phran gyi pha de nyid ni rgyun du chos snang dkar zhing ris med phyag dpe gsung rnam gsung 'bum gzigs rtog la mnyes pa dang / rgyun du zhal 'don gtso bo spyor chos skal bzang mgrin rgyan dang / smon lam rnam brgyad/ gu ru'i bka' thang bsdus pa sogs mdzad pa dang / phyag dpe ma ṇi bka' 'bum ltod cha smad cha dang /pad+ma bka' thang / tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung 'bum/ 'khrungs rabs/ mdo mdzangs blun/ mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing / rje btsun mi la'i gsung mgur gsung rnam/ 'brug pa kun legs kyi bce ga gtam so/gas dpe cha mthun rkyen rang la med rigs khag bla dgon khag la g.yar nas gzigs/gcen po gnyis pa rgyun du g.yag pa byas te ston dpyid gnyis so nam zhing las dang / dbyar dgun gnyis gzhan gyi rdal skyel bar bskyod kyi yod/ gcen mo bzhi nye 'khor gyi lung pa khag la mna' mar rim pas phyin/ rang nyid lo bco brgyad tsam nas 'gag dog sar pha yi zhal tar nyan gyin khyim gyi 'tsho gos 'gan 'khur dang / rgyun du gzhung gi so nam las khungs kyi khungs gtogs 'ong kha stod smad gnyis dang / gzhung rgyug khral pa'i sa zhing sgrub zhing 'debs las kyi zhing las gtso bo byas nas cadad kyi yod/

khyim rgyud dang / chung dus/ 19rang 'o/ bco brgyad kyi skabs te bod shing rta lo bod zla 5 tshes 16 spyi lo 1954 lor nying ro nas chu 'o/ga thon te myang stod smad gnyis kar chu skyon yong skabs/ so nam las khungs kyi khongs 'ong /ba gcig cha tshang sngo thog chu 'khyer phyin nas slad sa zhing 'debs yul med par gyur kyang khyim la dka' ngal che rigs gang yang ma byung ngo //ca gas bzung ba'i rig gzhung dngos rdzas sogs//cha tshang rdzogs pa'i gangs can bod chen po'i//ja chang 'dod rgu'i gter mdzod gtsang gi lngongs//nya ma bdag nyid btsas pa'i gnas de yin//

20 zhing pa'i dran tho/le 'argan ga3/ma pa/ zhing khul gyi bhing 'jags dmo gas shing /rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/spyi lo 1956 lor rang nyid kha mo dgon dang / kha mo grong tsho zung gi 'gan 'khur spyi mi lo yun gsum dang / 1958 lo nas 'thod btsugs te lho kha sogs nas bstan srung dang blang dmag gi yi ge skyel ba dang yi ge kha shas brda tho lta bur sa gnas so sdudar 'phri bas zan chag dang / dgos mkho gra sgrig dgos lugs 'khod pa ltar/ phran dang phyag sbrel spyi mi gnyis bcas nas ༷ nga tsho'i khyim tshang tshang ma chodags skong rim par byas mthar bstan srung dmag sgar gyi yi ge dang / brda skyel bya dgo sa rigs khyim tshang bang sgrig res 'khe ra byas pa dang / lhag par zan chag sogs gra sgrig dgos lugs brda tho bzhin grong cho'i nang gi khyim tshang rnams 'byor 'khe sa drag zhan

zhing khul gyi wī nga 'jags dkrosas shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'asngong// 21rim pa lngar dbye thog rim pa mtha'arim rnams la zan chag sogs bsdu bskul ma dgos pa dang de min 'byor 'khos rim pa ltar mang nyung gis rta chag ched 'byu rigs gang tsam zhig dngos su bsdus zin pa dang / 'brel tshig tho chod gan zhig kyang yig thog/ bkod nas slad phyin bstan srung dang blang dmag 'di khul 'byor skabs khyim tshang tshang ma'i do chod mnyam 'dzoms kyis sne len sogs bya rgyu dang / 'bo song ji dgos 'byor 'khos rim bzos ltar bsdu 'grems bya rgyu sogs brjod tshig 'khod pa'i chodad gan la/ khyim tshang tshang mas sa rtags bsdu len byas pa yig 'bri dang / gtso 'gan rang nyid kyis 'khur/nga dgu lo'i spyi zla bzhi pa tsam nang rgyal rtse grong rdal gyi khor yug tu yod pa'i rgya dmar dmag dpung gis rgyal rtse'i grong rdal smad rgyud grong khul nas rta drel btsan bskul gyis khal phyag brgyab ste/ rgya dmag khyon che rgyal rtse grong rdal nas thon bskyod kyis lha sa bar gyi gzhung lam thodag bskyod 'go tshugs grabs yod skabs/ de'i nyin shas kyi sngon nas lha sar dmag 'khrug thag chod rjes nga tsho'i grong tsho nas le dbar lnga tsam gyi sa cha lung dmar gzhis ka dang ga'i/sa stod zer ba'i grong tsho gnyis kyi nang / 'go 'khrid khyung tshang phyag mdzod zer bas gtsos bstacha srung dang blang dmag mi bcu drug tsam lung dmar gzhis ka'i 'byu rigs bsngos 'thag las byas te lho khar

2da zhing pa'i dran tho/skyel 'dren bya rgyu'i las 'gan sgrub bzhin yod pa dang / khong tshor rgyal rtse nas rgya dmag thon grabs byed pa nas dngos su thon rjes rgyal rtse nas me le bco brgyad tsam gyi lam bar du yod pa'i rgyab brag zer ba'i grong tsho der 'byor nas tsha phogs brgyag gi sku/da pa'i bar gyi gnas tshul rnams rim brgyud bstan srung dmag mi rnams la brda bskyal ba ma zad/ dang dmag bcu drug kho ngas su nga tsho'i nye 'khor gyi rgyab brag grwa tshang gi grwa pa skal ldan yang yod pa rgya dmag rgyab brag grong tshor 'byor nyin gyi snga dro skal ldan dang gzhan dang dmag gnyis nga tsho'i thodang tshor rta re bzhon nas rgya dmar gyi gnas tshul rtog zhib byed par 'byor/ khong chodar yul mi rnams kyis ja drangs pa dang /kha btags g.yogs pa sogs byas te rgya dmag gi gnas dzaXl skabs lnga ga snyan seng zhu rgyu byas/de nas grong tsho'i nub ngos ri rtser so lta ba gcig dang ri gsham du mi gcig gsang brnga len mi bzhag nas lha sa dang nying ro'i 'gro lam gang nas rgya dmag 'gro yi yod med blta zhib byed skabs/ nyin de'i nyin gung tsam rgya dmar rta dmag bzhi bcu zhe grangs rgyal rtse thodang rdal nas nga tsho'i grong tsho brgyud/ lha sa'i lam rgyud ngos la 'dzul bskyod byed skabs kho nga tshor rgya dmag yong gi yod skor lan brda rim gtong byas pas/ khong tshos lung dmar nas gzhis stod du sku nga thog shing tsher ma'i dkyil gab ste nyin phyed

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 23yol tsam nas 'jab rgol byas pas rgya yi rta dmag gcig bros the/ra ba las de byings rang sar bsad/ rgya dmag bros mi des mjug sdon rkang dmag la klan brda sprad nas rkang dmag bzhi brgya tsam lam seng yong ste gnam blugs me sgyogs dang / me mda' sbag sbag sogs lci ba'i mtshon cha spyad pa dang / dang dmag rnams kyis dbyin ji kha ldum dang / zi ling sbo rag sog/sa mtshon cha yang ba'i rigs bed spyad de dgong dro nyi bzhud tsam bar dmag 'thab drag po byas mthar/ rgya dmag phon che bsad rmas btang yang dang dmag khongs nas rgyab brag skal ldan se gas mi gsum tsam grongs pa dang / mde'u yang zad pas/ 'go dpon khyung tshang phyag mdzod kyis gri 'phyar te rgya dmag du ma zhig bsad rmas btang rjes lus ngal mtshams rta bzhon te ral gri khrag ral nyil ler lung dmar gzhis kar 'byor te de ga'i mi mang rnams la nga la ja thang gcig sprod rogs/ gri 'di chu la bkru dgos pa dang ri ldebs su mi mang rnams don nas grams dgos zhes rang dmag dpung stobs chen po yod tshul mig dmag gis rgya mir mabo skor btang /de nas ra lung phyog/sa nas dang dmag bcu tsam rogs zlar yong ste dmag 'thab byas kyang mtshon bzang ngan dang stobs shugs che chung dbang gis ma bsten par/ mun ma rub tsam khyung tshang phyag mdzod kyis rang dmag rub bsdu dang grangs bsher byas rjes rgyab bshig rgyag gin phyir 'then byed

24 zhing pa/'i dran tho/bcug ste rang nyid rtar chibs nas lhod lhod ngang bskyod song zer/ dang dmag rnams kyis nyi bsdo/da mtshams nas dmag thag bcad kyang rgya dmag gzhis stod grong tshor bsdad dgos byung ba las mdun bskyod byed ma nus/de'i dgong mo gzhis stod nor khang gi pha rgan dam/ga thag chod rjes wa na med rgya dmag gis me mda' 'phen nas bsad/ nyin de'i mtshan mo gus chotsware mdun gyi gzhung lam lnga ga rgya dmag gi dmag mkho'i dngos rigs rdzas mnge/'u sogs dbor mkhan rta bong gi khal ma 'grul bzhud khyon che byas/ sang stu/gas gus tsho'i grong tsho'i yar tsam der dre'u zhig khal slog brgyab nas bsdad 'dug zer ba go lnga sa byung 'phral gus dang mi gzhan drug phyin nas blta skabs dre'u der rtsa ras phad khog chen po gnyis mgo sbrel te bkal ba dang / thag pa ring po zhig gis bsdams 'dug kyang dre'u do wa dang thag par 'khril nas 'bo ma thub par lus pa ngos tsho nas thag pa bkrol te rtsa ras phad gog gnyis kha phye nas lta skabs phad khog re re nang sgam chung gnyis re dang / sgam chung rer gnam 'gyogs mde'u brgyad re 'dug pa bsdoms sgam bzhir mde'u grangs so gnyis yod pa nga tshos grong tshor dbor/— grong chor 'byor rjes phran gyis mde'u rnams rta gnyis la bkal te mi gnyis nying ru rgyud bstan srung dmag la bskyal bar 'bo dgos/ gcig ngas 'asku chog gcig su 'gro 'am/ zhes bshad pas gzhis lung phun snu gas

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 25kyis ngas phyin chog zer byung bas ngos gnyis 'gro rgyu'i tshig thag gcod skabs phran gyi pha mig dmar stobs rgyas mdzadag gis snge na la gzab gzab byed dgos/ gal srid rgya dmag nas rtsang/ gcod byed par yong tshe lung chodar lha ga khra dang chag sgo sku nga nyen che bas gnas skabs sbas nyar bya rgyu las lam seng bstan srung dang blang dmag la skyel thal ma byas na legs/ rjes su rim pas gang 'gab blta na/ gsung don phran dang / gzhis lung phun tshogs/tshe ring phun tshogs/ gzhan zhig bcas mi bzhis de'i nub mo gsang thabs kyis sgo nas grong tsho'i nye 'gram bye ri'i ri ldebs su sbas/ yang de rjes sa cha de thog rgya mi'i lam thig brgyab nas lam bzo 'bo tshugs skabs gus snu sa mtshan mo zhig sa thig mi khel ba'i sa thag ring tsam zhig gi ri 'dabs su gnas spos/ de'i ngang tshul ni sngon gyi gtam dper/bskos pa'i las la bros pas thar sa med//dpral pa'i gnyer ma phyis rma sa dag sa me+ed//ces pa e ma bden/ rang nyid kyis mde'u bstan srung dang blang dmag la bskyal bar phyin sku/da tshe bstan srung dang dmag khongs zhugs nas yang na dmag 'thab nang 'chi rgyu dang / yang na rgya gar du btsan byol la 'byor tshod las rgya mi'i btson ra'i nang mi lo snyer gcig ring gshin rje'i grong khyer dang yi dwags kyi skye ngan ltar mnar gcod 'jigs skrag dang /

2snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/bkres ltogs/ bkol spyod tshad las 'das pa de 'dra myong dgos tshod med pa ltar snang yang sngon bsags 'bras bu ldog tu med pas rang nyid rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyis rang yul nas 'bo ma thub pas lan 'dugade rjes rgya dmag skor bskyod nyul zhib pa yang yang yong gi 'dug pa bo nga tsho'i mi rnams kyang zhed snang chen po byed/ kha shas kyis gus rang la skad cha dris don mde'u de'i skor grong tsho yas mas nas shes kyi med dam snyam pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i grong tsho'i mis kyang kha 'asnu gas e yo nga gang dga' zer/ gus kyi bsam blor mde'u de rnams rgya mir sprod 'dodad rtsa ba nas med kyang bya thabs gzhan ma byung bas nga tsho'i grong tsho'i nye 'dabs ri khrod du/gus dang bla cadab kyi 'brel ba zab pa'i dbus nas phebs pa'i bya bral ba dge bshes shig rgyun du bzhugs kyi yod pa thugs dam zhig phul lan/ grong chorware mi gzhan nas gang byas las khyod nas 'di byed sku/sa 'go ma ston na legs/khyed rang la nyen khra zhig 'ong nges zhes gsungs byung bas de nas bzung jus tog ma byas/ mde'u de rnams bstan srung dang blang dmag la sprad dgos re skug bya bzhin pa de ltar yang /yong yong a ce'i chu la yong rgyu med//mi yong dug rdzul nag po'i kha rlangs byung // zhes pa ltar bstan srung dang blang dmag slebs mi yong ngam snyam mur bsam yul las 'das

zhing khul gyi nying 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'chud/ 27par nyin gcig gong ming tshe ring phun tshogs sogs kyis gros mol byas te/mde'u de rnams rgya dmag skor bskyo da par rtsis sprad 'dug pa rgya dmag nas bsngags brjod dang 'brel grong tshor chang 'thung zer nas 'bru khal lnga tsam sprad/ skabs de dus grong cho'i yas mas tshang mar bod rigs lam bzo ba stong phrag kha shas dang rgya las mang po slebs pa dang grong tsho rnams zang zing gi 'go tshugs/rang lo nyer gsum son skabs nying ro sna thod bkras mdo bu mo chung skyid ces pa rang nyid las lo na gnyis kyi chung zhing skyes gzugs dang kha 'bras shin tu mtshar ba zhig mdun thabs su bsus pa dus 'gyur dbang gis nye 'brel rnams rub 'dzoms kyis gnyen ston stabs bde zhig byas/ chung ma zla gnyis kyi rjes bag gasku ga 'o/ga pa dang lhan du skyes khyim du 'khor zhag la phyin pa de'i ring phran gyi pha dang / gcen po/ phran bcas 'dzin bzung gis khyim la cad thel brgyab pa dang / khyim du skyes ma gcig pur lus par yang ca dngos sbas skung byas par snyad de thag pas bsdams bkyig byas te 'thab 'dzing btang ba sogs khyim tshang la gud chag tshad med dbang gis chung ma nged gnyis zla ba gnyis las gshib rgyu ma byung bar kha bral dgos byung /nyin gcig grong nang rgya mi las byed dang skad sgyur byams pa zer ba bcas mi kha shas yong nas grong mi tshang ma tshogs 'dur stodang thog lha

28 zhing pa'i dran tho sar zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su btang tshul sogs gtam bshad mang po zhig byas nas da lta ngo rgol gsum dang chag yang gnyis kyi las 'gul 'bo tshugs kyi red/ de ring tshogs 'dur shog zer dus tshang ma lam seng 'dzoms kyi mi 'dug da nas tshogs 'du mang po 'tshogs dgos pas/ shog zer dus lam seng yong dgos sogs brjod/ dus de nas bzung rgya dpon zhig dang skad sgyur byams pa gnyis tshe ring phun tshogs kyi nang du gtan sdod byas/de'i sang zhogs gus pa'i pha mig dmar stobs rgyas dang / kha mo bla brang gi ༷/ rgyan/ kha mo dgon dpal gyi yab tshe ring phan thogs/ ga/zhis lung gi pha rgan nor phum// kha mo bla spel gyi pha rgan tshe brtan phun tshogs/ phyug dpal gyi pha rgan mig dmar rab brtan bcas nyin bdun tsam 'dang ba'i rgyag rang 'khur gyi thog srid don slob sbyong byed par lung dmar gzhis kar 'khrid/ nyin gnyis song ba'i snga dro phran rgya dpon mdun skad btang ste skad bsgrur brgyud nyin bdun tsam 'dang ba'i zas dang nyal chas 'khyer nas lung dmar gzhis kar srid don slob sbyong la 'gro dgos zhes brjod byung / mar don skabs tshe ring phun tshogs kyis phran la nang mol gyis rig 'dzin lags khyed rang gang yang byed kyi ma red/ khyed kyi pha dgung na mtho bas brje po brgyag par yin gyi red ces bshad/ rang khyim nas lnga na rjes rgya dpon des rje nub dngos grub la mdzub mo gtad de khong gis khyed rang bskyal gyi red

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs r+shang / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ na9lab byung / skyel mi rje nub dngos grub dang phran mnyam du lung dmar gzhis kar 'byor skabs de gar phran gyi pha dang / bya khyung rin po che sogs mi bcu tsam yod pa'i khang pa bar lnga ga zhig la bzhag nas tshags par klog pa sogs byed bcug pa las gzhan gyi dri zhib sogs ma byas/ khang shod du lung dmar gzhis sdod kyi tshab shangs 'bri yul ba gnyer pa phun tshogs bkra shis 'dzin bzung gis gcig pur bcug 'dug skabs der tshags par nang lha sar lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje'i lag tu sprang rgyug cig 'dzin du bcug nas 'thab 'dzing gtong gi yod pa'i par dang de'i skor sogs 'khod/ lung dam/ra gzhis kar rgya dpon gtso bo 'bar tshags lo na zhe grangs tsam son pa zhig dang skad sgyur gro mo ba bud med nor 'dzin zer ba lo na sum cu lhag tsam la son pa zhig 'dug de nas nyin lnga tsam song ba'i dgong dro zhig skad sgyur nor 'dzin gyis phran tshor brjod don sang nyin snga po nas kha mo grong tshor tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos shing / lam bar dmag mi'i ngag bkod gzhir bzung gis sgrig lam 'khur dgos pa dang 'thab 'dzing yang gzed dgos pa'i nyen kha yod/gyon gos thug tsam gyon dgo sa pa dang za btung yag po gyos zer/sang nyin snga dro me mda' 'khyer ba'i dmag mi rgyab ded pa gsum gyis nga tsho dang / gzhis sdod tshab shangs 'bri yul ba phun tshogs bkra shis bcas nga tsho'i grong tshor khrid/ grong tshor tshogs ra rgya che zhig go sgrig gis

30 zhing pa'i dran h+pho/thang sder zhig tu sdings cha bzos pa dang / sa khul gyi grong tsho yas mas tshang ma'i mi mang rnams dang de'i khar lam bzo ba stong phrag lhag mnyam 'dzoms byas/ sdings cha'i gsham zur zhig la 'dzin bzung byas pa'i nang mi rnams sgur sgur ngang bzhag pa dang phran tsho der 'byor 'phral log spyod pa rnams mgo sgur zhes sgrog tse'i thog ma'o par sgrig pa'i mdun sgur te bzhag thog grong tsho kha shas da dung yang rnga rdung dar 'phyar gyis spyi tshogs ring lugs yag btsan rgyal ring lugs mjug ma bskums nas bros/ log spyod pa rtsa med btang / zhes sogs gzhas gtong bzhin yong / rgya las kyis nga tshor gnya' gnon bshu zhog gtong mkhan dang log spyod pa yin tshul bsgrags pa dang / u yon dang hur brtson pa rnams kyis log spyod pa rtsa med bzo dgos zhes 'bod sgra bsgrags pa dang de rjes mi mang rnams kyis kyang 'bod sgra bsgrags/ sngar nas 'char 'god byas pa'i hur brtson can rnams kyis lung dmar gzhis sdod tshab shangs 'bri yul ba gnyer pa phun tshogs bkra shis dang / kha mo/ bla brang gi o rgyan/ phyug dpal gyi pha rgan mig dmar rab brtan bcas la 'thab 'dzing gi nyes rdung tshad med btang ba dang chabs cig nang mi rnams la yang nyes rdung drag tu btang /rje nub dngos grub dang / kho pa'i gcung mo tshe ring bu khrid gnyis kyis sngar 'khon zhe larnobazung ste gus kyi gcen po dang nged gnyis la log

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 31spyod pa'i las ka byas pa dang ngo log pa'i sgrig 'dzugs bzos pa red ces/'thab 'dzing dang nyes rdung gang tsam btang mthar dgong dro tshogs 'du mtshams 'jog khar bla brang o rgyan dang / phyug dpal mig dmar rab brtan gnyis 'dzin bzung yin zhes kho gnyis kyi khyim tshang la sgo thel brgyab pa dang /thag pas lag pa rgyab tu bkyig ste dmag mi'i rgyab ded dang bcas nga tsho mnyam du lung dmar la 'khrid de/ lung dmar gzhis kar 'byor 'phral o rgyan dang / mig dmar rab brtan gnyis la rkang lcags re brgyab nas lung dmar gzhis sdod tshab shangs 'bri yul ba gnyer pa phun tshogs bkra shis dang chabs gcig bzhag de nas yang nyin lnga tsam song mtshams zhogs pa zhig snga po nas tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos zhes 'khrid byung ba de sngon ltar tshang ma tshogs rar 'byor rjes o rgyan dang / mig dmar rab brtan nang mi dang bcas par nyes rdung 'thab 'dzing tshad med btang ba dang / phran la rje nub dngos grub kyi khyim mi rnams kyis nyes rdung tshad med gtong bzhin grong tsho'i khul sgrig 'dzugs rgya che btsugs skor dang / dang blang dmag mi'i ched zan chag sogs btsan bsdu/ 'gyogs mde'u log spyod par bskyal rgyu'i ngan bshams/ rgyal rtse nas mtshon srung nyos te bstan srung dang dmag la zhugs rgyu'i 'char gzhi btings pa/ bstan srung dmag la zhugs pa'i gus kyi a zhang blo bzang rdo rje dang spun nye grwa brtson 'grus sogs kyang gus nas

na2 zhing pa'i dran tho/btang ba yin tshul bcas skyodan btsugs mang dag byas nas nyes rdung tshad med btang / gus kyis phar mtshon srung rgyal rtse gang nas nyos pa dang / rin pa ga re sprad pa re re nas khungs bskyal dgos/ khungs lung med pa'i skad cha gang byung bshad na 'grig gi ma red/ ces brjod skabs de bas kyang nyes rdung shugs che btang ba ma zad/ 'dod rngam chen pos khyod tsho mi bzhi la sdod khang rgya chen dze de tsam yod kyang nga tsho mi grangs bcu lhag la khang pa rgya khyon chung ngu las med pas khang brjes brgyag gi yin/ de ltar yong gi red dam ma red rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis gsungs dang zer ba/ gong 'khod tshe ring phun tshogs skabs de'i 'go khrid gtso bo'i gras shig yin pa kho pas khang pa dgos zer ba rang 'dod tsha thag chod pa red/ mang tshogs spyi la ma gtogs khyod tsho khyim tshang gcig la de 'dra yong gi ma red zer song bas smra lce 'gul ma nus par sdod dgos so///rje nub khyim tshang nas ngan bskul byas don lam bzo ba'i dkyil nas mi zhig gis khyod rgyal khab la ngo sku/ga mkhan zhig red/ khyedad kyi brang steng nag thig bris shing rgyal khab nas me mda' zhig g.yar te khyod la mtshon srung yod med blta yi/ yin zer nas stod sgal rdos rdzis btang ba sogs/nyes rdung tshad me da baṅkang byung bas khra nas khrag thon mur rtsid pa sgrim pa'i gur thag ring po zhis nge ra barme na zhing / las ngar gnyis la rim gyis dkris

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 33te lag 'gor cus skor re brgyab nas thag sne ske la bskon pa'i gug la brgyus nas sne mi gnyis gsum gyis 'jus/ skabs re ltod sgal rdog rdzis btang nas thag pa 'then pa dang / skabs re yar bslangs thog lha da sgal la pus mo btsugs nas thag pa 'then pa bcas gang ltar se ga pa phyi nang slog bo snyam pa zhig bsdams/ de lta'i mur nyi ma dgong khar slebs pa dang tshogs 'du tshogs mtshams 'jog khar phran dang byang lhangare pha rgan mkhas grub gnyis 'dzin bzung byas tshul khyab bsgrags byas pa dang nga gnyis kyi khyim tshang la sgo thel brgyab/ phran gyi gcen po yang chab srid phru ba spyong byed par 'gro dgos zhes lung dmar gzhis la dmag mi'i rgyab 'ded dang bcas khrid/thag pas bsdams shing ded skabs gus pa'i gzugs stod smad tshang mar na zug gis khyab ste lam bar smre ngag dbang med 'chor bzhin thag pa lhod du gtang res dmag mir sgal pa bstan skabs dmag mis de las ldog ste me mda'i mjug shing dang rdo zhus/ nga tsho'i grong tsho nas le dbar gcig tsam bar na zug bzod glags med pa myong si/na ༷/ tshugs kyis bskyod nas g.yas gasku na la mig bltas te rang shi rgyag sa'i g.yang gzar sku ga rong gtsang po sogs btsal bas ma rnyed/ de nas da dung le dbar gcig gi sar kyo lung khrang zhes gtsang chu'i 'gram gyi lam bkan zar can zhig brgyud dgos pa der g.yang nas gtsang chur lcebs dgos bsams shing skad ngan 'chor

34 'ing pa 'i dran tho/gyin/ 'go rje grong tshor 'byor nye'i mtshams rgyab 'ded dmag mis thag sne nas cung tsam wod du btang byung bas rim pas dza drag gi na zug gang tsam 'jags/ da dung lam bar thengs du mar thag sne glod byung bas mthar lung dmar gzhis kar 'byor skabs thag pa bskon nas bzhag pa lta bu red/lung dmar gzhis kar 'byor 'phral gus dang byang lho'i pha mkhas grub gnyis la rkang par lcags brgyab ste lung dmar gzhis sdod tshab shangs 'bri yul ba gnyer pa phun tshogs bkra shis dang / kha mo bla brang gi u rgyan/phyug dpal gyi pha mig dmar rab brtan bcas dang mnyam du bzhag yang nyin shas rjes kha mo grong tshor 'thab 'dzing tshogs 'dur 'khrid nas dgong dro yar log dus tshwa do gnyis tsam nga tshor lung dmar gzhis ka bar 'khyer dgos brjod pa/ nga tsho 'dzin bzung pa dang srid don slob spyong byed mi bcas bsdoms mi grangs bcu lhag yod pa'i nang gus lo na chung shos lo nyer gsum slebs tsam yin pas/ rgan pa rnams la bzod yang lta bur bsams nas tshwa do gcig lung dmar gzhis ka bar le dbar lnga drug tsam sar rang gcig pus 'khur/ lung dmar gzhis kar 'byor 'phral tshwa do sar phab rjes ha ya'o da shi song / zhes chig lab brgyab pas skad sgyur gro mo ba bud med nor 'dzin zer ba mos/ phran la khyod ga re lab kyi yod dam zer byung ba/ phran gyis nga ngal che bas ha ya'o da shi song / zer ba las khyed tsho la tshig gcig

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jasas dkrogs 'ing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 35rgyab bshad byas med/ nga'i nang mi tshang ma 'dzin bzung byas shing / khyim tshang la sgo thel brgyab/ da dung ga re byed 'dod kyang 'dod pa bzhin gyis/zhes kha che/ga brgyab pas mos phran la rkang lcags shig brgyab/ nga tsho 'dzin bzung ba rnams lung dmar gzhis ka'i lug tshang zhig nang bcug pa so dmag ni lam bzo bka' bkod khang ge dmag mi yin pa dang de rnams kyi nang 7paṇa chen sku srung dmag mi gang tsam 'dug phran gyi rkang pa lcags sgrog gis bcings nas khang pa'i nang 'dzul skabs de nyin so lta byed mi 7paṇa chen sku srung dmag mi des phran gyi mdun bcar nas brtsodad don/ khyed la rkang lcags brgyab par sems pham dang / 'di gar yod pa'i lam bzo ba se gas mi mang rnams la ngo tsha dgos ci yang med/ dus kyi 'a'o/ 'gyur dbang gis de ltar byung ba las khyed rang ni rku jag gi nag nyes bsags nas btson du 'tshud pa zhig ma red/ da lta khyed kyi lang tsho'i ljang gzhon ser rdung thebs kyang slad rang gis btab pa'i sa bon la 'bras bu smin dus 'ong nges skyo snang dang sems sdug bya tshe khyed kyi pha dang gcen po gnyis blo pham 'ong zhes brjod byung ba/ dgra phyogs kyi dmag sku sa gyon pa'i mi zhig nas sems gso dang gdung sems bcangs par ya mtshan dang sems 'gul dbang med thebs te skyo snang yang skyes/ lung dmar gzhis kar zla gcig lhag tsam sdod ring kha mo grong tshor 'thab 'dzing tshogs 'dur thengs lnga khrid pa dang lung dmar

3snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/grong tsho la tshogs 'dur thengs gnyis khrid/ nyin zhig nga tsho 'dzin bzung byas pa'i mi grangs bdun po nyal chas sgal par bskur te bang sgrig bcug nas rgya dmag gnyis kyis lung dmar nas shar phyogs su/ le dbar bcu lhag yod pa'i ra lung chung dus grong tsho bde shar zer ba'i khyim tshang chen po de rgya dmag gis bdag bzung gis dmag sgar bzos yod pa der khrid/yar lam phran gral gyi sngon mar btang ba rjes la yong mi tshang ma rgan rgon yin pas dka' ngal 'phrad dogs ga ler 'gro skabs/ dmag mis phran sogs sngon gyi mi rnams la rdo zhus nas ded pa sngon du bskyodad mkhan rnams rdog mkhres dang nyes rdung gi dka' ngal gang tsam 'phrad/ dmag sgar der 'byor rjes na mthil nya shul yab che ba dang ra lung tar khang gi las byed 'ba' 'bu zer ba sogs mi drug tsam 'dzin bzung byas/ las ka mang che ba ri nas me shing spen ma 'jor gyis rtsa bkog btang nas 'thu rgyu dang /skabs re grong 'gram gyi sa stong sa slog rgyag dgos pa sogs ngal rtsol bar med bskul stabs rang khyim nas spyodan pa'i khyodan chas rnams kyang rim bzhin ral ba dang lhag par gyon lham rtsab ral chags nas sgrog mdud rgyag byed dang / lhan pa yang ma rnyed/rang khyim la sgo thel brgyab pa dang skyed byed dang gcen po gnyis kyang srid don slob sbyong byed dgos zhes 'dzin bzung du 'tshud pa bcas nang

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang ‘redzin bzung 'tshud/ 37du ma ye shes sgrol ma gcig po yin pas zas gos skyel mi ni med/ re zhig song mtshams gcen po khyim du slog kyang khyim la sgo thel brgyab yod stabs zas gos cung zad las bskyal ma thub par mu mthud mi gnyis kyi zas gos so sos gtong dgos stabs/ dmag sgar de'i skad bsgyur bod rigs rgyal mtshan zer bar phran gyis da cha nga'i bza' bca' zad kyang khyim tshang nas bskyal rgyu mi 'dug gang drag ces bshad pas/ ngas dmag dpon la zhus chog ces de'i dgong dro rtsam pa ki lo bco lnga tsam zhig sprad/ nyin gcig ngos rang dang phyug dpal gyi pha mig dmar rab brtan gnyis dmag sgar sdod yul bde shar zer ba'i sgo ra'i nang gad phyag skabs phru gu'i rkang lham zad 'phro zhig rnyed pa nga gnyis kyis bsgrugs nas so so'i lham yur lhan pa glan/de 'dra'i sems lus gnyis ngal skabs gus rang bshal nad kyis gang mtshams mnar yang nad gso nyin gcig kyang sdod dbang med pa dang lus 'byar gyon chas las brje rgyu gzhan med stabs/ lus la shig je mang brgyab pa se gas dka' ngal myong bzhin par zla gsum tsam lus/bod zla bcu pa'i nang nyin zhig rgya mi'i 'go khrid gnyis tsam yong nas gus tsho re rer tshig tho blangs nas nyin kha shas song ba'i dgong dro zhig snga phyir 'byor ba'i nga tsho mi grangs bcu lhag tsam dang / de'i khongs 'go rje byang lho zer ba'i khyim tshang gi gus pa'i sru mo che ba'i bu mo phru gu ma 'byar

38 zhing pa'i dran tho/mnyam khrid yod pa'i pad+ma dbyangs can dang / gzhan gnyis bcas mi gsum ma gtogs tshang ma lam seng thon dgos/ zhes brjod de chu pha rol gyi gzhung lam gsar par sgug pa'i rlangs 'khor thog gus kyi thodang tsho'i mdun brgyud yud tsam zhig la btson pa brgya phrag du ma yod pa'i rgyal rtse brag khug btson khang du bskyal/ brag khug gzhis ka'i 'og khang du rta ra dang / bong ra sogs sgo ra kha shas su nga tsho kha gtor nas bzhag pa dang nyin gung phan tshun 'gro 'ong phran bu chodag kyang nyin zas dang dgong zas sprod pa las zhogs zas mi sprod pas/ nyin re'i lto dus skabs rtsam pa lcags kring nas so sos tshod byas te len chog pa nga chodas dgong dro rtsam pa phran bu'i mang ba 'khyer nas gsang nyar byas te sang nyin snga dro'i chu khol dang mnyam du skyo ma ldag gi yod//phran gyi nyal khang dang nye 'brel du yod pa'i gro mo ba dge shes blo bzang thogs med zhu ba'i mdun mi gzhan mang ngo sa chos kyi skor bka' slob zhu bar bcar ba/ gus kyis kyang dga' ldan lha brgya dang dmigs brtse ma'i ljags lung zhus te dmigs brtse ma 'bum gcig bsags pa dang / dge bshes blo bzang thogs med mchog la 7gong sa mchog gi sku par chung ngu zhig 'dug pa thengs kha shas mjal ba'i go skabs thob/ de nas 'o/ gsar tshar tsam la nyin gcig btson pa sku ngas rdzogs g.yul kha chen po'i thog bskongs nas dang po bang sgrig bcug pa dang / de nas mi re re'i bar spyi

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs bing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 39khre gcig tsam gyi chod pa byas nas tshang ma sa steng sdod bcug mthar mi re re bzhin lus po sngog bsher byas te phreng ba dang / srung ba/ gzi byur/g.yu sogs tshang ma 'phrog yar btson khang du 'dzul skabs nyal khang tshang ma'i nyal gdan dang / kha phor sogs tshang ma zang zing bzos 'dug pa dang phran rang la rgya gar nas thon pa'i dngul khug sked par dkri byed gcig dang dngul phran bu yod pa 'khyer 'dug de nas rim gyi dza drag tu btang nas nyal khang so so'i 'gan 'khur ba chogs 'dur skong ba dang mi 'ga' zhig la 'dri zhib byas/ nyin gcig dge bshes blo bzang thogs med mchog dang rma bya phun tshogs nor bu sogs mi kha shas lcags brgyab nas zur du bcuganyin shas rjes dge bshes blo bzang thogs med mchog la 'thab 'dzing gtong ba'i tshogs chen gyi sar khong sogs kyis btson khang nang sgrig 'dzugs btsugs skor rgya mi'i las byed nas brjod pa dang / mi 'ga' shas la ther 'don 'thab rtsod byed du bcug pa rma bya'i sras rig rnam gyis dge bshes blo bzang thogs med mchog dang 'brel ba'i skor skad cha kha shas bshad rjes tshig rdzogs khar ngu skad 'don bzhin mchi ma btang / rang nyid mi gzhan la 'thab rtsod byed dus 'bod sgra bsgrags pa dang rdzog mgo rkyong ba thengs dang po yin pa ma zad/ rang gi dge ba'i gshes gnyen zhig yin stabs da ni las ngan bsam gyi mi khyab pa bsags so/ snyam ste snying la gri zug pa ltar bzod mi

40 zhing pa'i dran tho/thub pa lta bu byung / dge bshes slo bzang thogs med mchog gis 'brel ba byung ba'i mi tshang ma'i ming mkhyen gyi med pas btson mi ru ltar dkyil yar 'khrid mar 'khrid kyis gdong la mdzub mo btsugs nas ngo sprod du bcug pagus kyi sar phebs skabs gus la phyag mdzub gtad de khong dang yang 'brel ba byung gsungs pa sogs mi du ma ngo sgod gnang dgos so//tshogs 'du dang gros sdur thengs du ma byas te mi 'ga' shas la lag lcags brgyab ste zur bcug byas kyang gus kyis dmigs brtse ma'i ljags lung zhig zhus pa las gzhan 'brel ba med lugs brjod par gnad don ci yang ma 'phrad/ spyi lo 1959 zla 11 nang nga tsho'i sa khul du 'gro dgos zhes dgong dro zhig gus dang / bla brang tse/ rgyan/ phyug pa mig dmar rab brtan/ byang smad tshe dbang bcas mi bzhi brag khug btson khang gi rgyal sgo'i mdun nas sa khul gyi 'go khrid tshe ring phun tshogs can sogs mi bzhis lag pa rgyab tu bsdams nas khrid/ mi gzhan gyis mi malnga nga ba'i mtshams nas tshe ring phun tshogs kyis btson pa rnams kyis thag pa bkrol nas 'khrid de rgyab brag grong tshor mtshan phyi por 'byor nas legs grub grwa tshang gi 'bru khang rnying pa zhig nang bcug sang zhogs gcin pa gtong bar khrid skabs gus kyi grong tsho nas slo bzang dang / lo rgyal/ de sngon gus par 'thab rtsod gtong mi'i gte po rje nub dngos grub bcas kyang 'dzin bzung byas nas nye

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 41'gram khang pa zhig nang bce na bcug byas 'dug kho pa rnams kyis gus mthodang ba dang gad mo tsher tsher bya yi 'dug pa gus kyis phar rnam 'gyur bzang ngan gang yang bstan med kyang / bla brang u rgyan gyis a tsi khyed tsho yang 'dir slebs sam/ zhes zur za byas song ba kho pa chorta brjod rgyus phongs te kha skyengs ngang gnas/ gus kyi pha mo gas kha cig srid don slob sbyong ched khang pa gzhan zhig tu yod pa de'i nang rje nub tshe ring bu khrid zer ba mo yang bcug 'dugade nyin snga dro nga tsho mi brgyad dang srid don slob sbyong ched zur bcug byas pa tshang ma chu yur bajo bar btang byung ba pha dam pa mjal ba sems nang dga' tshor chen po skyes/ de nas nga hrū tshang ma 'thab 'dzing dang 'grems ston gyi tshogs 'dur khrid de tshogs ra'i zur la sgo thel brgyab pa'i khyim tshang re gnyis kyi ca dalnga sa phyogs gcig la bzhag cing / phyogs gzhan zhig la dbul po'i khyim tshang kha shas kyi nyal chas thu ba rtsab ral dang / khog ma/za ru/ phor pa kha chag sogs bzhag nas/ gus tshor khyod chodas ngal rtsodal mi mang gis ngal rtsol byas pa'i 'bras bu bshu gcodag btang nas khyodad tsho bshu gzhog gral rim par ca dngos rgyas spros sku da pa dang / nga tsho rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi mang la khyim chas skyo po 'di 'dra las med tshul sogs brjod de mi 'ga' shas la 'thab 'dzing je mang btang yang phran la dmigs bkar 'thab

42 zhing pa'i dran sgo/'dzing gtong mkhan ma byung / rgyab brag grong tshor nyin lnga nyar rjes gus kyi skyes yul kha mo grong tshor khrid nas nyin bco lnga tsam bcug ring mang gtso bcos bsgyur gyi gral rim bzos pa dang / 'dzin bzung ba'i mi rnams kyi khang khyim dang / sa zhing / phyugs rigs sogs tho bkod zhib phra dang / do bdag gi lo brgyad tshun gyi lo rgyus/ de snga khyim tshang du g.yog pho mo dang mi gla sogs ji tsam nyar gyi sku/da pa bcas kyi tho bkod zhib nan bgyis/ de rjes btson 'jug byas pa rnams gral rim pa dang log spyod pa red/ ces sgo thel brgyab pa'i mkhar dngos gzhung bzhes btang nas gser chas dngul chas sogs rin chen gyi rigs/ 'dzin dngos drag rigs rnams gzhung nyar dang / gyon gos dang / gdan mal chas/ phyugs rigs/ khang pa/ sa zhing bcas mi mang la bgos/ phran la zhing pa phyug po dang log spyod pa zhes ming btags nas de snga bod gzhung so nam las khungs su bogs ma 'bul rgyu'i sa zhing gling lhag de dang gnag phyugs g.yag kha shas gzhung bzhes kyis mang tshogs la babo 'grems byas shing / khyim tshang dang nang chas rang 'jags yin tshul brjod kyang sgo thel ma bkrol bar khang mig kha shas nang rgya gzhung gis mi mang tshong khang btsugs nas khyim gyi 'dzin chas gang sar gyar ba ma zad/ khang pa'i 'og shod zhig nang gyon chas dang ca dngos drag rigs 'ga' shas yod pa de rnams sbas bskungs byas pa yin tshul brjod

zhing khul gyi rdzing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 43nas sgo thel rgyag dus nas gzhan du dbor ba dang / de rjes grong tsho phan tshun tshogs 'dzoms kyis zab 'phyor gyon dgos zer skabs nga la med kho la med ces brjod nas phran gyi gyon chas gang yod rnams 'go khrid kyis mang tshogs la g.yar tshul khyer ba dang / gnad che'i dngos rigs 'ga' 'go khrid rnams kyis lag zhor khyer/ gus kyis re 'dun bzhin 'go khrid 'gas gsang thabs kyis sgo thel 'og nas gyon pa spu phrug gcig dang / ko tho gciga'og 'jug gcig bcas sprad pa las gzhan gang yang ma thodab/mtshan mo zhig nga tsho khang pa gcig nang bcug yod skabs 'go khrid mi gnyis sku nga nas phran la da lta zhing pa mthun tshogs mdun yong dgos/zhes kha mo bla brang gi khang pa zhig nang rgya las gcig dang bod mi bcu tsam 'dug pa'i sar khrid/ zla ba phun tshogs kyis khyed rang skad gtong dgos don ni ca dngos dang / mtshon cha sogs phyi la sbas bskungs byas yod tshod la kha gsal zhu dgos brjod byung bas/ phran gyis ca dngos sne gcig phyi byu la sbas rigs med la mtshon cha ni gang yod nga tsho tshang mas shes sa/sal ltar/mnyam du de spon nas rtsis 'bul zhus pa yin brjod par/ yang kho pas 'o na 1 khyed kyi yig rigs gzhan dang mnyam du bka' shag gi dpyad khra mi 'dug pa ga par sbas yod ces bshad/ phran gyis nga/pe cha dang mnyam du dpe ras dang glegs shing la bsgril nas sku da brjod pas/ 'o na 'grigs so/ zhes

44 zhing pa'i dran tho/ mi gnyis kyis sngar gyi khang pa der bskyal/ nyin shas rjes brag khug btson khang nas yar sgong pa'i gus sogs bzhi sa khul hur brtson can zer ba'i gzhon nu kha shas nas 'khrid de brag khug btson khang gi sngon ma'i nyal khang so mo ra bzhag skabs der btson pa mang che bar las ka ma bskul bar khang pa che chung la gzhigs te nyal khang rer mi lnga nas bcu'i bar nyin mtshan med pa sgo lcags brgyab nas bzhag pa dang / snga dgong thengs re gcin pa galta nga bar khrid pa las grod khog bshal ba sogs byung yang nyal khang gi shing zam chung ngur mi btang thabs med red/ khang pa tshang ma'i sgo'i dkyil bu ga mtho gang gru bzhi re bton yod pa las dkar cha dang rlung 'gro gzhan med pa'i 'og shod yin stabs/ skabs re nga tso mi re gnyis phyi la bskul ba'i las ka tsag tsig chu tshod re tsam byas nas nyal khang nang 'dzul skabs dri ma tsha hūr hūr ngar tshub can zhig gis sna la tsha shur skyes/spyi lo 1960 zla 5 pa'i nyin zhig bce na pa phal cher bang sgrig bcug ste rgyal rtse grong rdal gyi ri 'dabs skyel thang zer ba'i bye thang du 'khrid de/ der 'byor rjes 'jor bu dang sbyag ma sogs sprad de sa khod snyom bcug de nas bzung zhogs pa snga po nas brag khud btson khang nas skyid thang du las ka byed par khrid ring de snga tshang ma mun nag tu yun ring bcug rkyen gdong mdog dkar rkyang gyur yod par nyi 'od 'phog pa'i bye thang tsha nus kyis

zhing khul gyi lhing 'jags dkrogs shing / rang nyid kyang 'dzin bzung 'tshud/ 45bsregs te bzhin mdog dmar rkyang gyur/ rim pas sna'i rtse nas bzung nyi chur don pa dang pags pa skyur te tsha shar bzod thabs med pa'i ngang mdog rmug nag pags pa dzar dzar can zhig chags/ de sngon khrims chad dus bkag bzo dus bcodan pa tshang ma tshogs rwar lha nga thog khrims dpon dang /khrims rtsod pa/ spyi bde mi sna bcas rgya las gang tsam 'dzoms nas khyab bsgrags byed kyi yod kyang / lo de'i spyi sgra 7 par btson pa bcu grangs snyong 'gug gis btson khang gi 'go 'khrid dang skad sgyur re yong nas tho gzhung klog pa ltar mi so sor khyod rang la khrims chad lo dus 'di ltar yin/zhes khrims thag bcad pa rnams sgo rwa gzhan zhig tu zur gasdudag byas/ nyin zhig nga tsho mi nyi shur khrims thag bcad pa'i nang phran la ngo log zing 'khrug par rgyab skyor byas pa sogs kyis khrims chad btson bcug lo bcu gnyis dang / rje nub dngos grub la deng dus gsar brje ngo log brgyab pa'i nyes pa bkal te bapu na bcug lo bco lnga/ chod bzang la lo bcu/ lo rgyal lo bcu/'o/ga spu+od pa dang gnya' gnon bshu gachodag gtong mkhan gyi nyes ming bkal ba'i sgo bzhi dpe ral jo lags la lo bco lnga / sa la sgang jo lags bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor lo bcu/ rgyab brag sne thur srid dar de'i sngon nas khrims chad lo lnga btang song snyam pa bcas nga tsho tshang ma khrims thag bcad pa'i zur gsog khongs lam seng nyal khang spo bcug go/

4snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/ twa thā ga ta'i bstan pa'i rmang nas bshigatha mal bod mi bkol spyod gdung bas mnar//da dang chu gnyer lta ba'i las 'gal nang //rjordo/ ‘3 — — lha// rdo // 3 tsho — 4ne skya

lha kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdu ga 47le tshan bzhi pa/lha kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdugang tsho khrims thag bcad nas nyin lnga tsam rjes su dmag mi 'ga' zhig dang btson khang gi rgya las kha shas yong nas nga tsho'i ming tho bsher gyin nyal chas bton dgos/ zhes mi grangs brgyad cu tsam btson khang gi lha kha'i thang sder du khrid cing / btson pa rnams re re bzhin dmag mir yig cha dang mnyam du rtsis sprad/ rlangs 'khor 'ga' zhig tu dmag mi rgyab 'ded pa dang btson pa mnyam du 'dzul ba dang / kha shas su btson pa gcig pur blugs/ re 'gar dmag mi gcig pur 'dzul te nub phyogs su 'khrid de chu tshod gcig tsam phyin rjes pa snam nor bu khyung rtser 'byor/ de ga'i btson khang nas btson pa grangs bzhi bcu tsam nga tsho mnyam khrid de mu mthud nub phyogs su bskyod nas gzhis ka rtse grong khyer gyi sbya'o khrang gi khang stong zhig nang bcug gzhis rtser slebs pa'i dgong dro dang sang zhogs bcas la

48 zhing pa'i dran tho/rtsam pa phran bu re dang chu khol nyung ngu las ma sprad par nyin gnyis par stag gru kha'i gru dang / 'u yug shog bu la/ gya la bcas brgyud yangs pa can du 'byor nas dmag sgar gyi khang stong nang bcug pa der yang chu khol dang rtsam pa phran bu las ma ster stabs/ grod kho ga ltogs pa dang sems nang sa cha gang 'dra zhig la 'khrid rgyu yin nam/ lam bar rtsam pa nyung ngu zhig las ma sprad kyang gnas sdod byed sar 'byor na rtsam pa grod khog rgyag tsam zhig sprad mi yong ngam snyam pa dang / de'i sngon rnga chen slog khang nas bros gyol yong ba'i bod dmag cig rin sprungs nas 'dzin bzung byas te rgyal rtse brag khug btson khang du nga tsho mnyam bcug pa/ khong gis da lta nga tsho 'dir las ka med par gu dog kyang dka' ngal che ba gang yang ma red/ btson pa gzhan rnams bskul 'ded kyis dka' ngal che ba ma zad/ 'tsho ba'i thad kyang rtsam pa mu zi'i sgam chung la 'jal nas bgo bsha' brgyab dgos brjod pa de yang blo la 'char nas sems nang dogs pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi 'go bskyar du tshugs/ de nas nyin gsum par yangs pa can nas khrid de 'bras spungs kyi thad ka'i dmag sgar zhig tu rlangs 'khor nang dus yurne gang tsam bzhag rjes/ nyi ma phyed yol tsam la thon te stag lung brag gi dgon pa'i 'khris su sog gur dang / bod gur 'ga'i nang bzhag ste dgong dro gtsang sbra byed par bskul/ nga tsho btson pa nang khul 'dir sdod rgyu min nam/ brjod pa

lho kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug 49las gar 'gro gar sdod shes kyi med stabs g.yang za ba'i ngang bsdad dgos/stag lung brag nas rtse pho brang dang 'bras spungs dgon mjal dus glo bur dga' lhang nge zhig byung yang bskyar du bsams skabs 7rgyal dbang rin po che ni ma bzhugs/ lung pa dgra lag tu shor tshar bsams nas yid rmus tshad med zhig dang sngon ma rang nyid lha sar yong skabs 7rgyal dbang rin po che tshogs phebs kyi mdzad rim rnams dang / rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang du zhang po blo bzang dngos grub/ khong gi dge phrug bkra shis tshe ring bcas la gnas tshul ci 'dra zhig 'phrad yod dam/ snyam pa bcas yid skyo la bya thabs sne gcig med khar sang zhogs yang bskyar rlangs 'khor nang lcags zam chu bo ri rgyud lto kha'i phyogs la 'khrid/ yar klung gtsang po'i gzhung brgyud glog gyu yod pa'i chu khar nga tsho babs bcug pa rang nyid de phyogs rgyus mnga' med kyang 'gro tshudang ba rnams kyis bsam yas gru kha red ces brjod/ glog gru dang bye thang brgyud nas bsam yas khams gsum zangs khang gling gi 'du khang nang bcug ste bcu shog bzos shing bcu dpon sogs bkod nas thog mar has po ri'i nub 'dabs kyi sa stong zhig tu sa slog par bskul/bsam yas su dang thog nga tsho gtsang rgyal rtse dang pa snam gnyis kyi mi brgya lhag tsam yod pa de'i thog nyin 'ga' nas lha sas gtsos dbus khul gyi btson pa zungs zad nus med dgu bcu tsam khrid nas nga tsho dang mnyam

50 zhing pa'i dran tho/du ngal rtsol bskul 'ded byas/ de nas yang bskyar sna dkar rtse rdzong nas bathoḍan pa nyi shu tsam khrid byung ba bcas khyon bsdom btson pa mi grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam yod par nyin ltar nam langs nas nyi rgas bar shing rtsa sngog pa dang / sbyag mas sa rgod slog pa bcas lci ba'i las rtsol kho nar 'ar 'ded gtong bzhin yang lto chas ni snga gung gnyis la rtsam pa skam zog phor chung re las sprad kyi med pa ma zad/ de yang rtsam pa phor chung nang sob sob byas te blug thog lag pas bre kha brgyab ste don dngos mang che bar phor chung khengs nges med cing kha shas la skabs re phor chung phyed las mi thob/ dgong mo mun rub nas las mtshams bzhag cing ma byan dang bcu dpon res 'khor gyis thug pa sdor sogs ci yang med par chu mdog 'gyur tsam gyi sla po skyogs re sprad/ snga dgong thab tshang nas ja khu tshwa med bcu shog re rer mi grangs ltar 'jal nas tshur bcu shog nang bgo skabs phran bu re las mi thob cing / 'tsho tshis skyod bas thug pa dang ja ldug skabs phran bu'i kha mtho dman la'ang rtsod gleng byed/de lta'i 'tsho ba ngan ngon bzod thabs med rkyen bcu dpon rgyud rgya las 'go byed tshor rtsam pa phran bu'i mang ba dgos pa'i re ba zhus kyang nyan 'jog rtsa ba nas med par mu mthud ngal rtsol la 'ar 'ded kho na dang / mun nag dkyil dgon pa'i rdo gcal du tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas khyod dza tshang ma

lho kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug 51rgyal khab la ngo log pa dang / zing slong mkhan sdudags nyes can sha stag yin pas ngal rtsol sgyur bkod gtang rgyur thag bcad nas rang nyes sel zhing mi gsar zhig tu bsgyur nas khrims chad dus bkag chag yang yong ba'i 'bad brtson byed dgos/ zhes mi rnams mgo skor gtong zhing chabs cig chordogs chung bcu shog rer nyin re sa spyi khre 'jal nas las bgos brgyab ste ngal rtsol la btsan ded byed rkyang las 'tsho bar blta rtog spu tsam yang ma byas stabs/ phran tsho bsam yas la spyi lo 1960 zla 8 tshes shar la 'byor nas bzung bod dmag khul thon skyed pu'u yi brgya shog lnga pa zer ba 'go btsugs te zla gocig lhag tsam rjes btson pa ltogs shi thebs tshad nyin re las mang du 'gra/rang nyid lo na nyer bzhir son pa'i pho gsar lus la nad med cig yin rung bkres ltogs kyis bzod glags med par nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i thog las ka lci bar brten/ gzugs nyin re las ma 'das par rid cing rus krang lpags g.yogs lta bur gyur pa dang / lpags pa'i steng nas thal ba skya phyur don pa/ shig sros lus yongs la khyab cing mtshan mo gnyid kyang de tsam khug mi thub/ phyi ro' du rgya dmag gi sdod khang sogs spo ba dang bsdu gsog/ rgyag par khrid skabs rus pa dang / ma ṇi'i 'khor lo'i lpasas pa / sobakyi/ khrab kyi dum bu sogs phran bu re rnyed nga/ bza' dgos byung / de

5na zhing pa'i dran tho/bzhin rtswa ring thung khru gang lha ga tsam zhig gi mgo bor snye ma 'dra ba'i 'bras bu sob mo ba cig chags pa de nam zla ston mtshams la skam por gyur skabs lag pas g.yab nas tsam par bsres shing za rgyu mang du btang / bathorgan grogs 'ga' shas kyis sa sru+og rgyag skabs sa gting nas chodan pa'i 'bu dkar po bsgrugs te bzas pa dang / gro mo ba dngos grub kyis sdig pa ra tsā bzas par grags te gza' nyi ma'i ngal gso zhig la 'thab rtsod kyang byas/ nyin zhig rta shi ba'i ro len par mi 'ga' shas 'khrid de dgong mo'i tshogs 'dur dmag dpon slob ston pa'i go ming can des/ sang nyin gza' nyi ma'i ngal gso la khyedad tshor rta sha gang 'tshams sprad rgyu yin zhes brjod par btson pa tshang mas thugs rje che/ zhes 'bod/ sang nyin mi rer rta sha rdog re sprad pa skyug bro'i 'char snang tsam yang med par zas bcud ha cang che bas bkres ltogs kyis bzod glags mi thub par shin tu phan zhing / btson rogs 'ga' shas la khyi sha yang bza' rgyu byung ba der 'phya smod bya rgyu lta zhog so so'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du brtsis/khyi dang rta sha'i zas kyi 'tsho bcud ring por ma thogs par yal nas mu mthud bkres ltogs ngang shugs las la btsan ded byas rkyen/ zungs zad btson pa rnams dbo nga mo las sa nas 'o/ga yong dus 'ga' shas lam bar ltogs shir 'gro/ kha shas dgong mo mar nyal dus bde thang 'dra bar

lha kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dala' sdug 53zhogs pa yar langs rgyu med par shi/ gson por yod pa rnams kyang 'chi nyer thug nas las kar dgongs pa zhu dgos byung nu// rtsam pa phran bu de yang skal ba bcad cing sdod gnas kyang phar tshur thengs kha shas spos bcug nas bsun po bzos/ dper na/ dang po khams gsum zangs khang gling nas bsam yas dkar me rdzong khang / de nas bu tshal gser khang gling du lpos bcug nyin zhig nga tsho rtsam pa skam zog gi lto chas bza' skabs nga tsho'i bcu shog bcu gcig gi bcu dpon gtsang pa snam spos khang dgon pa'i grwa dar rgyas bkra shis kyis spags mdag chung zhig khar bcug nas ja hub gang 'thung skabs/ glo skyug langs te mdag sgong kha nas shor te sa steng la rgyang nger zags pa de gtsang pa snam phyug po shar ma'i dbang rgyal gyis tog ste bsgrugs nas bzas/ dar rgyas bkra shis kyis dbang rgyal la mig ce rer bltas pa las gang yang ma brjod/ rang nyid kyang bkres ltogs kyis bza' rgyu zhig rag rme/ snyam pa las 'chi rgyu dang phan tshun 'tsher snang sogs ci yang mi 'dug la mtshan mo gnyid phran bu khug skabs sngon gyi ro bcud ldan pa'i zas dang / tshogs brgya'i tshogs rdzas/ rgyal rtse brag khug btson khang du rtsam pa grod khog rgyag nges bza' rgyu yod pa de yang rmi lam du yang yang rmis/nyin gcig bu tshal gser khang gling nas nga tsho btson pa brgyad tsam chu kha nas ca dngos dbor bar 'khrid byung ba mar lam dbu rtse rigs gsum

54 zhing pa 'i dran tho/lha khang gi byang sgo'i mkhris rta ro khyis phyed tsam bzas pa zhig 'dug pa/ nga tsho'i rgyab ded rnga chen glog khang nas glod grol btang ba'i btson pa lo chung zhig yod pa kho par sha phran bu re blang bcug rogs/ zhes zhu ba 'then nas gad snyig dkyil nas lcags kring bskrugs te rdo rtswab la brdar zhing rta sha gang lon byas/ phran la rta sha rgya ma gsum tsam thob byung bas dga' tshor ha cang chen pos yar 'byor rjes ma byan la re ba bton nas ha yang che ba zhig nang thab rgyab me ro'i steng btsos nas dasku nga mo tog tsam zhig bzas pa bcu shog gi mi gzhan gyis shes song bas phran bu re ster/ lhag chen po med spyang ca ga legs par byas nas nyin gsum tsam bar 'dang bar bgyis so/yang nyin gcig rgyab 'ded dmag mis gla ba chung ngu zhig bsad nas lpags pa phran dang stag bzang phug rab bkra shis dbang 'dus la ster byung bas nga gnyis nas btsos te bzas pas/ rta sha dang gla lpags rim par rag stabs rang nyid kyi lus po'i 'tsho bcud la 'chi sos sman lta bu byung ba las de min btson grogs lo chung las ka shugs che tsam byed mi phal cher ltogs rid ngang grongs/ thengs shig gus sogs mi brgyad tsam chu khar 'khrid byung ba glog gru nas pad tshal rnyid pa 'ga' chu khar spungs 'dug pa tshang mas pad tshal steng la mchongs te dud 'gro dang gnyis su med par rjen par bza' gang thub byas kyang lto ba khengs nges shig ma rag gong dmag mis me mda'i

lha kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug 55mjug shing gis rdeg nas pad tshal dang mi gnyis so sor phye/ btson pa'i bcu shog so sor mir gzhigs pa'i sa bgos te bang sgrig nas sa slog rgyag skabs rgyal rtse gangs steng chen g.yu rgyal rdo rje yis sbyar slog brgyab pa'i sa 'og nas rtsi rtsi zhig bros skabs/ lus zungs zhan pas rtsi rtsi'i rjes zin thabs med kyang bza' rgyu'i re sems shugs che 'byung bar rten rtsi rtsi de nga'i yin zhes skad brgyab/ mi gzhan gyis bdag bzung bya rgyu sngon 'gog ched sems/ kyis ma bzod par skad brgyab pa las rtsi rtsi rjes ded btang nas gsod thub pa'i nus pa yod pa'i btson pa gcig kyang med/ mu ge'i mjug la zla lhag ces pa ltar bkres ltogs kyis shi god che khar bshal nad tshabs che zhig kyang khyab nas btson pa du ma 'das bo/ngas song ba phran la yang bshal nad phog nas 'di phyi gnyis kyi so mtshams la slebs skabs/ sa slog rgyag par 'gro ma dgos par nyin lnga ring bcu shog re re gral star sgrig nas tshang ma tshogs 'dur bskongs nas slob sbyong byed bcug pa'i dus khel ya nga nad gzhi ha cang lcid che bas skabs re dran pa'ang mi gsal bar gnyid khug pa lta bur gyur/slob sbyong skabs rgya dmag 'go khrid nas legs sbyar gang tsam bshad rjes btson pa'i nang de sngon rgya nag tu slob grwar bskyod de rgya las byed myong ba rgyal rtse phun tshogs khang gsar ye shes dbang rgyal la gtam bshad du ma byed du bcug stabs legs kyis rang gi gzugs la ngal gso'i go skabs thodab
