5snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/pas nad gzhi rim pas drag tu 'gro ba'i nyin zhig ngo da dmag khul khang thon skyed pu'u nas yin skad kyi dmag mi'i 'go khrid dang / sman pa sogs 'ga' shas yong nas nad par phran bu'i lta zhib dang btson pa 'ga' shas la rgyun du rtsam pa mang nyung gang tsam rag gi yod med dang / ko ba sogs ci 'dra byas nas bzas skor dris shing nad pa 'ga' zhig zur dbye byas/de skabs btson pa'i nang mi re gnyis lto chas skyel bar 'gyor yang thad kar sprad mi chog par btang 'dzin bya yi 'dug pa dang / nyin zhig zhogs pa bu tshal gser khang gling nas btson pa rnams las kar ru star bsgrigs te rgyal sgo don skabs/ sgo khar sna dkar rtse 'dabs lung gdong dkar gyi snying nye bde chen gyis sha bag leb bkang ba'i slo ma chung ngu zhig bsnams nas rgyab 'ded par reng gi bza' zla jo lags bsod nams lha bas rgyas su sprad du bcug rogs/ zhes zhu ba 'then skabs/ der yod btson pa rnams kyis the tshom med par bag leb steng mcho ngas nas hab thob kyis bzas pas sprod yul do bdag la bag leb kyi zur tsam ma thob/ rgyab 'ded pas btson pa rnams la me mda'i mjug shing rdeg nas nyes rdung btang ba dang rjes su kha shas la 'dri rtsad kyang byas/ sna dkar rtse 'dabs lung gdong dkar dang gus kyi khyim pha mes nas dkar nyer song snying nye bde chen gyis mar phyur dang bu ram bcas 'dres ma'i gro zhib btsos ma'i spags ril zhig sku zla jo

the kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug 57lags bse da nams stobs rgyal brgyud gnang byung ba srog 'dzin gyi bdud rtsi lta bu byung ngo / lo de'i spyi zla 12 tshes 20 nang bce na pa rnams rgyun gtan ltar snga dre'i las kar 'gro grabs skabs rgya dmag 'go byed nas tshang ma'i nyal chas bsdams nas rgyal sgo'i phyi la ru chung dang bcu shog bang bsgrig/sa te don snartseg ces brjod pa bzhin tshang ma phyi log la ro/na nas phan tshun shub bur sdod yul spo dgos min nam zer/ nyal chas rnams bang sgrig ngang bzhag nas tshang ma rgyal sgo'i nang du khrid de lha khang gi rdo gcal nang mi re re bzhin lus bsher btang / tshang ma'i lus thog nas dngos po gzhan don rgyu med kyang yid bzhin nor bu las kyang gces par bcangs pa'i nyin zas rtsam pa skam khrodag phran bu de rnams phar bsdus pa dang nyal chas tshang ma sngog bsher gyis zang zing ngang bzhag 'dug lus bsher tshar ba dang rdo gcal nang tshogs 'du 'chodags thog 'go dmag gis brjod don/ da cha spyi 'otsware lo gsar slebs nye bas de ring nas bzung lo gsar dang sbrags nyin bcu ngal gamo gzhag rgyu ma zad/ de'i ring lto chas kha rgyag yin/ khyed tshos dang po nyung tsam bza' dgos pa las ltogs rngam ma byed/ nyin bcu'i rjes kyang grod pa rgyag nges mi rer zla ba gcig la rtsam pa rgya ma bzhi bcu zhe lnga yod pa lto ba che bas ma galta gas bza' mi thub ces brjod/ phran gyi sems nang masngo na

58 zhing pa 'i dran tho/sum yin nam rmi lam yin snyam pa'i yid ma ches kyi dga' tshor drag tu g.yos/ nga ṣ+ṭharware 'tsho bar 'gyur mdog btang ba dang chabs cig rgya dmag ru chen dpon dang chab srid slob ston pa gnyis las bsgyur btang nas gzhan gnyis 'byor/ dpon po gsar pa gnyis kyis nang mi lto chas skyel bar yong mi rnams thug 'phrad lhod por byed bcug pas btson pa'i nang mi yang mang po slebs/ dka' sdug gi dus yun zla ba bzhi'i ring der phyir dran byed skabs btson pa grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam nas phyed lhag tsam bkres ltogs kyis lnga lam du phyin pa dang / gal srid 'tsho bar blta rtogs ma byas par zla ba gcig tsam mu mthud de mur bzhag na brgya shog der btson pa mi gcig kyang gson por gnas pa'i skabs med/bod mi'i spyi mthun bsod nams dman pas spyi lo nga dgu nas re gcig bar nga tsho bsam yas // yod pa'i btson pa tsam ma zad/ byang tshwa la dkar po dang / kong po rtsebs la sgang / kong po sba spyi zhing ra/ tsha ba ༷ ma mda'/ dpal 'bar/ kan su'u/ lha sa 'dam ra la sogs su btson pa rnams kyang nga tsho dang 'dra bar ltogs shir thebs tshad ha cang che/spyi 'o/ 1960 zla 12 tshes 20 nang nyin bcu ngal gso gtong skabasku/ phran gyi gcen po lto chas skyel bar 'byor byung ba nyin mo mnyam du lhod por skyid sdug sgrung slong byas nas bsdad rgyu byung bar phran dga' tshor

lto kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug 59chen po byung rung / phran gyi lus zungs nyams shing mi sdug pa'i mdog der gcen por bzod mi thub pa'i sem/sa ngal 'phar ma zhig sprad/ btson pa rnams la lto ba khengs pa'i zas thob rjes yang bskyar dka' ngal zhig byung ba ni lto ba'i nang rong brgyab pa dang 'gul bskyod rtsa ba nas byed ma 'dod par nyal rgyur re yang nyal du bcug gi med/phran na gzhon dar bab yin pas lus zungs nyin re bzhin gasdudas shing rab rib kyi dran pa gsal du phyin nas nga tsho bkres ltogs kyi duḥkhas batho na grogs mang po zhig lto gas bkres ngang 'das pa dang gson por gnas pa rnams kyang bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal de ltar myangs dgos byung ba des/ las ngan sgrib pa dag nas yi dwags kyi skye sgo chod pa shog bsams pa'i dge sems khyad par can zhig kyang sdig mun 'thibs pa'i mun bskal de 'drar skyes byung ba da lta'ang skal pa bzang snyam zhing rang gi rang la rjes su yi rang byed bzhin mchis/de nas brgya shog brgyad pa zer ba'i btson pa'i ru chen zhig bsam yas la 'byor nas khams gsum zangs khang gling du bzhag ste rka yur bzo ba dang sa slog rgyag par bskul/ nga tsho'i brgya shog lnga pa'i nad pa bcu grangs shig lha sar btang ba dang gzhan rnams ltogs shir 'asku ba'i nyen tshabs las grol tsam yang sa slog brgyag rgyu dang / rka yur bzo ba/ 'drud 'then 'khor

snyo0 zhing pa'i dran tho/los sa slog pa'i la mag rdzog rgyu/ bsam yas shar ri'i thang gi bye thang thog son 'debs 'khor chung nga tshor 'drud bcug ste nas son btab kyang / sos than shugs ches ljang pa 'tshigs par brten yang bskyar son 'debs 'khor chung 'drud bcug nas bra'u 'debs bcug pa bcas dka' sdug che khar/ lhag par brgya sna ga brgyad pas 'debs 'dzugs byas pa'i zhog khog sa rgya gang tsam zhig gi lo mar 'bu bya mo zer ba'i chung ngu dmar khra zhig brgyab pa/ nga tsho brgya shog lnga pa nyin gsum tsam 'bu sgrug bcug cing snod nang bsags thog brgya dpon gyis phad bo ga nang mnyam bsdus byas te/ zhing kha'i mu tshigs su phung gsog brgyab pa'i rtswa snyig ran par me spar thog 'bu rnams mer sreg gtong dubo cus/ pa las ngan de ltar sems nas bzod min yang mi byed thabs ma byung nga /nyin gcig bsam yas chu khar shing gru chung ngu zhig bye mar 'khar nas bskyod ma thub stabs nga tsho btson pa bcu lhag tsam 'bud rgyag gtong bar khrid cing / chu'i nang 'dzul nas nus shugs gang yod kyis skar ma kha shas ring 'bud rgyag btang yang btson pa rnams ltobs shugs zhan pas gru chung 'gul bskyod kyang dka' zhing / nga tsho chu'i nang rang tshugs zin ma thub par bzi khyom mer tshang ma shing grur 'tham nas rang nyid skyobs thabs byas nas sdod dgos byung / der yod rgya dmag gis shing gru chu khar bton song ba

lha kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug snyo1nga tsho 'ga' re gru'i steng don thub pa dang kha shas grur 'thams nas chu khar slebs tsam byung rung / tshang ma gom bgrod mi thub par mgo yu 'khor nas dar cig chu kha'i bye steng 'gre ldog byas nas bsdad cing gang tsam nas dran pa sos skabs khyar khyor ngang yong nas bu tshal gser khang gling du dgong mo 'byor tsam byung /lo de'i bod zla bzhi pa tsam nang phran gyi skyed byed dang rogs pa gnyis bsam yas su 'byor te dang po gus pa thug 'phrad du phebs tshul gsungs kyang / nyin shas rjes rang la lus srog sbyin zhing chung spar ba gang nas gso skyong mdzad mkhan gyi drin chen skyes ma de nyid/ lo de'i bod zla gnyis par sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i mchodad 'bul ched chabs cig phebs zhes gsungs/ drin can gyi skyes ma gshegs khar rang nyid la zhal mjal ba'i skal pa tsam ma byung bar bsams shing bsams na yid rmus tshad med skyes kyang gra ma sgrig de 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid du bsams nas sdug sgom brgyab rgyu las gzhan ci/ skyed byed bsam yas la phyag mchod lha ra ba sogs mdzad de skyes ma dam pa ngan song gi sdug bsngal las thar ba'i thugs smon mtsharma sa sbyor gnang nas nyin shas bzhugs rjes lha sar phebs kyi yin/ zhes gsungs pa gus kyis mchod 'bru phran tsam bsnams rogs zhus don/ mchod 'byu bsnams byung ba gus pas sbar mo gang thod par

62 zhing pa'i dran tho/gtugs nas smon lam 'di ltar btab/ 7rgyal dbang rin po che sku tshe zhabs pad brtan cing myur bar bod du zhabs sor 'khod de zhal mjal skal bzang 'thob pa dang bod la rang dbang 'thob ste sngar sa yun gnas yong ba/ lus can rnams dbang med 'jigs skrag duḥkhas mi zad drag tu gtses pa'i btson ra dang btson pa'i ming yang mi grags par skal bzang gi rdzogs ldan gsar pa zhig 'char ba dang / ltogs bkres kyis dka' thub de lta bu myangs pa'i rnam par smin pas tshe sngon gyi las ngan dag nas tshe rabs phreng ba thams cad du gtso bo yi dwags gi gnas ngan len las thar ba shog ces smon lam de ltar 'debs bzhin par sngon bskal bzang lugs bzang skabs 'gro bskyod rang dbang ngang lha ldan gtsug lag khang du jo bo rin po che mjal ba bsam blor 'khor bzhin/ mig nas mchi ma dbang med phrum phrum du 'bru 'di jo bo rin po che'i lhung gzed nang dbul bar gyis zhes zhus/ skyed byed mchog rgod 'khar la brgyab nas lha sar phebs/de ltar bsam yas su bdag sogs btson pa rnams bkres lta gas kyis mnar ba'i thog lci ba'i las rtsol gyis gson pa'i re ba med par 'chi rgyur thag chod pa'i tshad med dka' thub drag po/ sngar bsams yul na med pa mi yul gyi dmyal khams dngos lta bu zhig rang gi lus sems la dngos su brgyud kyang dran shes dman pas zhib par 'god ma thub na/ de dus kyi

rnyed kha bsam yas su myangs pa'i dka' sdug snyozhalo rgyus zhib phra mkhyen chod yod mkhan rnams kyis 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i sdug bsngal gyi zhing khams der dngos su sku ngal bzhes khyodang ba btson grogs deng skabs rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang du bzhugs pa phyag zur sku zhabs rgyal mtshan dang / bzhugs sgar lha rgyal rir bzhugs pa'i gzim shag dga' brang sku mched pa snam a yar lho pa'i sku ngo rlo brtan rnam gnyis la rtsad par zhu/pa lo breg pa'i rab byung btsun pa dang //pha mes gos dkar lcang lo can gyi sde'i//ba gam mthon warware chos kyi mdun sa de// ma lus gshin rje'i grong dang gnyis su med//

snyo4 zhing pa'i dran tho/le 65na lnga pa/lho kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsodal la ded pa/spyi lo 1961 zla 6 nang 'bo 'khrid 'ga' shas kyis nga snu ra sā/ dkar rtse zhing rar bskyod dgos tshul nang mol gyis bshad pa ltar ṅgan grwa bsgrigs te nyin shas nas yongs khyab tu bsam yas su 'khyodar rgyu'i brgya shog dgu pa dang / brgyad pa gnyis bsam yas su sdod dbo sa/ sna dkar rtser brgya shog drug pa yod pa der nga tsho brgya shog lnga pa 'gro dgos brjod byung ba brgya shog lnga pa mang che ba gtsang nas yin stabs rang yul thag nyer brten sems nang dga' tshor chen po byung / nyin gcig ru chung dang po dang gnyis pa btang / nga dza/ ru chung gsum pa nyin shas nas 'gro dgos bshad pa bzhin so so'i nyal gos 'khyer zhing chu kha nas glog grur zhugs te yar klung gtsang po'i pha rol bsgral nas de'i nub mo chu khar bsdad cing / sang nyin phyed

ldo kha nas satsang du ngal rtsol la nged nga// snyo5yol bar sgug mthar gzhi nas nga tsho skyel 'dren byed pa'i rlangs 'khor gyis mun rub tsam la gong dkar skyid gshongs kyi btson khang stong pa kha shas mdun la bskyal/ der mtshan gcig bcug cing sang zhogs rlangs 'khor gyis mu mthud gam pa la mo brgal te nyin gung ma zin tsam la sna dkar rtse 'dzam chos dgon pa dang / bsam lding dbo na gnyis bar gyi rnam rgyal thang kha zer bar gur brgyab 'dug pa der 'gyor/spyi lo 1961 zla 7 tshes shar nas spyi sku/ 1962 zla 6bar rnam rgyal thang du sdod ring ri nas me shing 'thu rgyu dang / chu yur bzo ba / rgya dmag gis 'drud 'then 'kho ra 'o/sa 'debs las rgya chen byas pa de dag brnga bsdu dang g.yul las gtong rgyu sogs byas/ rgya gzhung gis sprod pa'i 'tsho ba skyon med tsam gyi thog nang mi spun mched kyis thug 'phrad dang lto chas bskyal bar rim pri sa 'byor ba phan tshun mthun sgril zab sdudas rogs ram byas pa/ de bzhin btson pa rnams kyis nya 'dzin pa bcas 'dza ba dang las rtsol gang la yang dka' ngal che rigs ci yang ma byung yang gus kyis kyang nya thengs gsum tsam 'dzin te bzas pa nyes med dud 'gro'i srog bcad par 'gyod bshags snying dbus nas zhu/spyi 'o/ 1962 zla 6 par lha sa nas rgya las kha shas shig slebs te bathergan pa rnams sa khul gang nas yin dang / btson du gang nas tshud sogs

snyo6 zhing pa'i dran tho/zhib bsher byas nas mthar kron chus se sor btang ste rnam rgyal thang du btson pa gcig kyang bzhag ma song // nga tsho brgya lha ga lnga pa ar las rgya cher byed mus kyang rgyal rtse khul la bskyal te rgyal rtse brag khug btson khang nas rdzong so so'i btson khang la rtsis sprad/ nga tsho rgyal rtse rdzong khongs rnams rgyal rtser bzhag ste gus rdo gshog sde tshan khongs las bgos byas/ mi bcu lhag tsam zhig ar ka 'don par rgyal rtse chos lung ri khrod ri gsham du 'gro dgos pa snga dgong phar 'gro tshur 'ong sa thag ring ba ma zad/ bcu shog de'i bcu dpon rgan pa stag rtse rta sgo'i ngag dbang nor bu dang / gzhon pa mkhar kha 'brang stodad pa'i dpal rdor gnyis kyis las kar skul 'ded chen pos dka' ngal che zhing / yang nyin zhig nga tsho mi bcu rgyal rtse'i sman khang zhig nang khrid de tshang ma'i rna cog dang mdzub mo'i rtse nas khrag phran bu re btsags te brtag dpyad byas mthar/ phran gyi ming 'bod byas te khang pa zhig gi nyal khri'i steng bsnyal thog lag g.yas pa'i gru mo'i khrag rtsa'i thog khab rtse jo ma zhig btsugs te nyal khri'i 'og bzhag pa'i khrag 'jib nus ldan pa'i shel dam zhig gis gyig gi rgyu ma brgyud khrag drangs/ dus ༷/na phran tsam nas gus la sman pas lag pa ma 'gul par mdzub mo brkyangs bskum byed dgos zhes bshad/ de ltar byas pas khab bton nas yud tsam nyal dgos zhes bakhyodad nas chu 'kho la mngar mo mog gang sprad/ mu mthud nyal pas gnyid zim zim zhig khug

lto kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa/ snyo7gang tsam nas khrag btsags mkhan sman pa de sku/nga nas yar longs dang mgo yu 'khor gyi mi 'dug gam/ zhes brjod/ phran lo na nyer lnga yin zhing sngar las gzugs gzhi thang du phyin yod stabs mgo yu 'khor gyi mi 'dug pa de don sman par brjod pas btson pa'i 'go khrid la mig ston ched lag khyer zhig sprad/ btson khang du 'byor rjes nyin bdun ngal gso bzhag kyang rgyun gyi rtsam pa'i skal thob ma sprad par btson khang gi thab tshang nang rgya skad la skong the na tud zer ba nyes can yin la btson pa min pa kha shas yod pa de rnams kyis lto chas skyel bar yong / kho tshor ngo dga' sprel las 'khrab na lto chas yag tsam sprad kyang rang nyid kyis rgyun nas de rigs 'khrab ma shes stabs nyin bdun ring lto chas kyang skyo po zhig las ma thob/nyin bdun rjes sngar ltar zla ba bzhi tsam las ka las mtshams spyi lo 1962 zla 10 nang btson khang 'go khrid kyis btson pa'i ming tho bsher ba gus pa'i ming yang bto/na/ btson pa phan tshun nang mo la la ming tho zur bton byas pa rnams glod bkrol gtang rgyu min nam zhes re ba byed/gang lags zhe na/ skabs der krung hin gnyis mtha' mtshams su dmag 'khrug langs kyi yod pas de sngon dmyo/ga khul thon skyed khul khongs gtogs yod pa'i btson pa rnams so so'i sa khul btson kha/ nga du slog cing / dmag khul 'go khrid rnams kyis rang khyim du log rgyu yong tshul brjod pa de ltar

snyo8 zhing pa'i dran tho/rang gi sems la khyim du 'gro rgyu mi yong ngam snyam ste re ba phran bu byung /nyin shas nas ming tho zur bton gyi mi rnams las kar ma btang bar dbo/nga dro tshogs 'dur bskongs nas ming tho bskya nga bsher byas pa/ bsdoms mi grangs bzhi bcu yod pa bcu lha ga bzhir dbye nas rgya dpon gyis de ring nas khyod rang tsho ru khag gcig red/ gnas skabs mkhar khar las ka byed par 'gro dgos/ der 'byor rjes sgrig lam dang ngal rtsol sogs bsgyur bkod legs po bya na mdun lam yod brjod/ nga tsho sang nyin mkhar khar khrid de gzim shag rma bya'i 'og shod bcug cing las ka shing sbyar pa cadang rgan nyos nas gcod rgyu dang / btub nas sgal par dbor rgyu bcas red/ snga dro sdod gnas las thon te shing sdong btub ma thub pa dang gshog ma thub pa'i dka' ngal/ de nas rang gi mkhres po ma 'khyog pa'i dka' ngal chen snga byung /mar 'byor rjes rdog mkhres re re bzhin rgya mar btegs te rdog mkhres chung ba 'khyer mi rnams la gshe gshe gtong ba dang / rgyu mtshan dri ba/ ker langs byed bcug pa/ sa thag ring ba'i chu len yul du chu len par gtong ba sogs byed/ nga tsho'i der rgyal rtse brag khug btson khang nas btson pa rim par btang byung bas mthar mi grangs brgya dang bzhi bcu skor zhig yod/btson pa'i khungs stag rtse rta sgo'i ngag dbang nor bu dang / sbrang stod dpal rdor/ cimakhar kha'i pho gsar 'ga' zhig gis nang khul shed ngoms dkrog

lho kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa snyo9dkrog gis rdog mkhres ki lo brgya dang gsum tsam dbor ba sku gas las rtsol shugs cher byed cing gzhan la yang skul 'ded gtong / btson pa'i 'go 'khrid rgya las kyis rtag tu kho dza ra kha yisri phye gtor du ma byed/mkhar kha/ thang smad kyi rgya che ba'i sa stong du zhing rwa 'dzugs rgyur brten bcu shog so sor nyin re sa phag grangs tshad kyis brgyab bcug pa sa phag grangs tshad ma longs pa'i dka' ngal che khar/ de sngon sna dkar rtser rang nyid dang / nyeng ru ser rwa lung spar gzhis chos bzang / pa snam pa kha shas bcas bros byol du 'gro rgyu'i gsang mol byung ba dang / spyi lo 1962lo mjug mtshams la pa snam rdzong gi btson khang nas btson pa 'ga' shas bros byol du phyin pa'i gnas tshul byung bar brten pa snam rdzong gi mi dang 'brel ba yod na/ dogs pa shugs che byed/ sna dkar rtser nga tsho'i bcu shog gi bcu dasngo na pa snam gyi mi yin pas phran gyi gnyen tshan kha mo blo bzang gis gus dang pa snam gyi mi 'brel ba yod tshul rgya 8smus la brjod 'dugader brten btson pa rnams/ daso/nga mo nyal khang du 'gro khar 'char can bang bsgrigs nas grangs bsher byed pa'i dus la gus rgya las sar bskongs nas khyod rang dang pa snam rdzong bi btson pa sgrig 'dzugs btsugs yod pa mi gzhan gyis ngos len byas zin/ khyod rang gis da lta ngos len bya na rang 'gul ngos len byas par brtsis te tang gi srid jus ni kha gsal

70 zhing pa 'i dran tho/la gu yangs dang / sbas skung la drag gnon yin/ zhes dza drag gis dri rtsad byas kyang gus pas rtsa ba nas lnga sa len zhu rgyu med/ gal srid gzhan gyis gnad don yod khul zhus yod na/ mi ngo ra sprod kyis thag gcod ga re mdzad kyang de don dang len zhu rgyu yin/ zhes mthar skyel byas pas de nas dri zhib mtshams chod/ 'on tang rang nyid kyi sems su btson khang nas nge sa byol 'gro thabs bsam gzhigs kho na byed skabs 'gro yul kha phyogs nying ru nas wa skyes la brgal te 'brug yul du slebs thub/ der brten wa skyes la'i lam rgyus yod pa zhig rogs par sbran dgos snyam/ btson pa'i nang rig 'dzin gyi ming can gsum yod pa gus na chung shos yin yang gzugs ring bas rig 'dzin che ba zhes 'bod/ khang dmar rdzong nying ru nas yin pa'i rig 'dzin chung ba sngon ma khal g.yag ded nas wa skyes la brgyud 'brug yul du tshong brgyab par lo ltar bskyod myong ba kho par rim pas rgyud bskul bya dgos bsams/ phran bcu lha ga bzhi pa dang rig 'dzin chung ba bcu shog gsum pa yin yang mkhar khar bcu shog gnyis mnyam du bzhag pas nga gnyis nyal sa tshogs chung mnyam du byung / phran gyis rig 'dzin chung bar 'brel ba btsugs te nang mol yin tshul gyis sngon ma khyed rang 'phan por gtong skabs bros byol phyin yang ma thar ba red ces thos byung ba dngos bden red dam/ zhes 'jam pos dris pas rig 'dzin chung bas de de bzhin red/ ces

lto kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa/ 71brjod/ de nas bzung gus gnyis skad cha bshad rgyu'i go skabs phran bu re yong stabs bros gyol thub na dge mtshan yod 'u/gas gleng mol byed kyi yod/skabs der las rtsol ha cang 'ar 'ded chen pos bskul ba/ dper na / lags kyi thong lha la chen po zhig mi bzhi tsam gyis 'then te sa stong cagasar sbol byed dgos pa/ bcu shog so se sa bgos kyi sbyag phru ga brgyag rgyu 'gran bsdur gtong ba/ chu med skam thang ri gsham la phan med chu yur gting ring 'ga' bzos pa/ brag rdor rdzas me brgyab nas rdo bshag pa sogs byed dgos/ gzim shag rma bya'i gsham gyi thang smad kyi skam thang du sa phag gis lcags ri chen pos bskor ba'i dmag gur nang btson pa rnams spos bcug kyang nga gnyis kyis gsang ba dam zab thog bros byol 'gro rgyu'i dus tshod dang / gcin pa gtong bar 'gro khul gyis gsang gcod nas mchongs te so so lam gang thob bros te ki lo mi ḍar gnyis kyi sa'i brag rdo zhig mdun phan tshun 'ug pa'i skad brgyab nas 'dzoms dus bgyis pa dang / de nas nyin ri la gab sdod bya rgyu dang mtshan mo zhing dkyil snye mgo dang la nyung bzas te nyin kha shas kyi sa thag yin stabs khungs 'khyol ba'i ngos 'dzin byas/ spyi lo 1963 'orware ston mtshams kyi mtshan mo zhig nga gnyis bros rgyu gtan khel zhing nyal khar mngon chung thog gyon chas gyon te phran tsam nyal nas tshang 4 sh+tsa ma gnyid khug mtsham sa sngar nas gra sgrig byas pa 'i rtsam pa dang / yang lā/ sku

72 zhing pa'i dran tho/tsag sgra bcas am phrag nang blugs nas gcin pa gtong bar 'gro khul mnyam du phyin te/ gsang gcod mdun nas lcags ri'i sgang lag pa bsnyabs nas 'dzegs grabs dus srung bya rgya dmag gis glog zhu khra lham mer thad kar brgyab byung bas nya rgyab kyi sa rdog rkub phyis yin khul blangs nas yang bskyar gcin pa gtong khul byas nas gur nang phyir log mi yong ka med byung /lo de'i dgun dus kyi slob sbyong ma tshugs gong tsam la khang mig chung zhing star pa ring ba'i btson khra/ nga brgyab tshar bas bcu shog re khang mig re rer bzhag pas gus dang rig 'dzin chung ba ga/nyis kha bral/ lo sngon mar krung hin mtha' mtshams dmag 'khrug skabs btson pa chosar bsam tshul dang skad cha 'dra min byung ba dang / pa snam rdzong gi btson pa bros byol phyin pas nga tsho'i der yod pa'i pa snam rdzong gi btson par dogs gzhi yod pa sogs la brten/ spyi zla 12 nang las mtshams phyed 'jog gis dgun dus slob sbyong yun ring la dza drag chen po 'ig btsugs/ gcin pa gtong bar 'gro dus kyang bcu shog so so las phan tshun thug 'phrad dang skad cha tsam yang bshad mi chog par so so'i nyal khang nang da bar ngos len ma zhus pa'i nag nyes dang nor 'khrul ji yod rang 'gul gyis gsal por zhus na nyes pa sel thub pa dang / gzhan skyon 'ther 'don gyis byas rjes bzhag ste mi gsar chags thub pa byed dgos/ zhes snachar can ltar bshad/ nyin gcig gus

lto la nas satsang du ngal rtso la la ded pa/ 73la nag nyes rang 'gul gyi ngos len rtsis 'bul zhu yi yin nam min/ kha gsal la gu yangs dang sbas skung la drag gnon ni/ tang gi srid jus red sogs brjod kyang phran gyis rang nyid nas ngos 'dzin ma thub pa'i skyon nor yod nges kyang sbas skung zhus pa ci yang med ces bshad/sang nyin zhogs zas tshar rjes so so'i nyal khang nang slob sbyong dang gros bsdur byed skabs skyes yul pa snam nas yin pa'i bud med las byed skyid pas phran la nor 'khrul ci yod bsam blo thongs/ zhes dgun dus grang ngar che zhing thal rlung 'tshub pa/'i sgo khar bton/ tshogs chung brgyad pa'i sgo khar de sngon ga dang dmag sgar gyi bcu dpon pa snam pa lhag rgod bton 'dug pa khong dang phran gyi bar gas nga mol sogs ci yang med snyam mur/ pa snam pa nyi ma bsam 'gyub kyi tshogs chung gcin pa gtong bar khrid pa gus kyis nyi ma bsam 'grub la bltas te am gtsigs bsdams tsam byas pas khong gis bzhin nag por bsdus nas mchil ma zhig sa steng g.yā’gas/ de sngon sna dkar rtse 'dzam chos zhing rar gus dang nyi ma bsam 'grub sogs nge sa byedal 'gro rgyu'i gsang gros byas pa gzhan la mi bshad pa'i mna' chen po bskyal yang khong gis mchil ma g.yugs don ga re yin nam/ mkhar kha'i btson khang brgyab dus mi glar yong ba'i zhing khul gyi shing bzo ba 'ga' zhig gis rgya dkar nag sa mtshams kyi dmag 'khrug skabs rgya gar thengs gcig

74 zhing pa'i dran tho/ pham yang dmag 'khrug yang bskyar langs nas rgya gar la 'thob re sku da pa dang / rgya dmar gyi dge rgan ra shi ya dang rgya dmar gnyis da cha 'chams mthun med pas rgya dmar gang cir nyag phrar gyur nas bod la rang dbang 'thob re yod tshul sogs re stong mang po zhig bshad 'dug pa/ skabs der nyi ma bsam 'grub dang kha mo blo bzang gnyis lag g.yog yin pa de'i skor lnga sa len byas pa las bros byol 'gro rgyu'i gsang gros cibyas nas lo lnga yang gnyis 'das pas der 'brel ba yod kyi ma red snyam /de lta'i mur snga dro'i dus tshod 'khyol yang nyin gung mu mthud sgo khar bsam blo gtong bcug byung ba nga tsho'i khyim mtshes su yod pa'i rig 'dzin chung bas phran sgo khar bslangs pa gsal por mthong stabs/ yar 'gro mar 'bo byed pa'i rgya las la/ tud krang lag/sa/ nga zhu rgyu gcig yod ces brjod pa rgya las kyis sgo phye nas las khungs la 'khrid de dus yun gang mtshams nas mar thon skabs/ phran gyis khe par mig 'bur tshugs su bltas te am gtsigs bsngams kyang gdong smad de zhum zhum gyis 'gro ba da ni nga gnyis kyi spor ngos len tshar 'dug snyam ste gus kyis kyang rgya las skyid par nga lnga sa len zhig zhu rgyur yar bcar chog pa zhu/ zhes bshad pas yar shog zer byung / phran gyis skyid pa'i mdun rig 'dzin chung ba nga gnyis bros byol la 'gro rgyu'i bya rim rnams zhib tsam ngo sa len byas pa mos yig chodag tu bkod

lho kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa/ 75kyang / skyid pa kha tsha ba las sems gnag po gang yang med pas khyod rang gi phran bu'i ngos len byas pa rnams gzhan gyis ngos len tshar ba red/ sngon ma sna dkar rtser nag nyes bsags pa rnams ngos len zhu yi min nam/ mar phyin nas lam dkar nag gang la bskyod mu mthud bsam blo thongs/ zhes kha phyogs shig bstan byung / sang nyin de yang phran dang bcu dpon lha rgod gnyis mu mthud so so'i sgo khar bslangs te rgya las rim pas tshig ngan smras cing dgong dro skyid pa dang zhing ra'i 'go dpon zu'u gnyis kyis ngos len zhu dang mi zhu zhes tha tshig bsgrags/ sems su da ni nyi ma bsam 'grub kyis sna dkar rtser bshad pa'i gsang mol gyi thig sne shor tshar 'dug pa lha rab byung na nyi ma bsam 'grub thug pa'i thod skabs shig brtsal dgos snyam ste/ rgya las gnyis la phran sna dkar rtser sdod skabs kyi gnas tshul rnams ngos len zhu 'dod kyang lam seng dran gsos min la brten dran rim bzhin yig thog bkod nas 'bul chog pa zhes zhus pas/ sang nyin nas tshogs chung nang gros bsdur sogs la jus tog ma byas par gnad don ji yod gsal por bkod nas brtsis 'bul dgos zhes bshad byung ba/ khang pa'i nang bsdad dzadag pa ma zad/ tshogs mi rnams rgyal spyi rgyal nang sogs kyi gros bsdur byed skabs rang nyid yi ge bris nas sdod rgyu byung yang lhag rgod sgo kha'i rlung dmar dkyil mu mthud bslangs nas bzhag thog da dung rkang lcags shig kyang

1 snyo zhing pa'i dran sgo/brgyab/ rjes su gnas tshul gsang nyan byed dus nyi ma bsam 'grub dang lha rgod gnyis brol byol la 'gro rgyu'i sta gon byas skor nyi ma bsam 'grub kyis sngo sa len zhus kyang / lhag rgod nas khas len ma byas tshul sogs nyi ma bsam 'grub kyis kho rang gi snga phyi'i gnas tshul rnams ngos len byas pa'i cho zo dod pas/ sna dkar rtser sdod skabs bros gyol 'gro 'char gyi nang mol rnams bshad rgyu min pa'i gna' bskyal bar ma ltos rnga/ra ngos len zhu yig nyin lnga ring bris shing skyid par sprad/ skyid pas zhu yig zhib par bltas rjes ngos len phran bu zhig zhus kyang da dung 'tshems lus yod med bsams gre/zhigs byed dgos zhes slog byung /nyin bcu tsam zhig rna ba 'jam thing nger tshogs mi spyi mtshungs slob sbyong byed skabs snga dro zhig rgya las re gnyis yong nas gus par brjod don/khyod la nor bu mdzub rtse tsam zhig yod pa bton shos/ ces gus kyi nyal thodas rnams phyi la bton nas sngog bsher zhib tshags byas pa de khyodan nas stod gos kyi gong bar wa lpags sbyar ba'i gseb sbas pa'i ngo da g.yu spus legs de kho pa tsho'i lag tu thebs/ khrang krang des rgya skad thog gus par sprod ces lab kyang rgya las gro mo ba bud med ska/smu bzang gis tho brgyab nas rjes su sprad chog ces nyar ba dang / da dung gsang sbas byas pa'i nor bu bton shog ces mthar bkag byas pa phran gyis nor bu rtsa ba nas med brjod dus tshogs

lho kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la nged rī / 77chung gsum pa nas kha mo blo bzang 'khrid de rig 'dzin la yod pa'i nor bu de gang 'dra zhig 'dug gam/ zhes dris song ba kha mo blo bzang gis gus la o lo rang la tshon mdog ljang khu'i nor bu mchod rten gyi dbyibs/ can zhig sngon ma 'dug pa ga re red dam/ zhes brjod pa/ phran gyis kha mo blo bzang la 'a rdzi/ phru gu'i snang ba zerid ce na/ lo rgan red/ de ni phru gu'i rtsed chas 'dra ba'i shel ril nar mo zhig red/ phan thogs ci yang med stabs sgo phyi'i rtsig srub la bzhag yod/ ga ler brtsal na/ rnyed kyi red/ ces bshad par mig la ston dgos baya/da pa bzhin gus nas phar tshur brtsal tshul gyis rtsig srub nas bton te sprad// rgya las kyis kha mo blo bzang la 'di red dam zhes bcadad pa kho pas red ces bshad/ rgya las kyis tshogs chung dang lnga nas bzhi pa bar tshogasdo/ 'du 'tshogs nas rig 'dzin che bar lho ba gso/ dang skyon brjod byed dgos zhes nyal khang phyi rol du tshang ma sa steng sgor sgor bsdad pa'i dkyil/ gus pa bsdad bcug nas re re bzhin tshang mas gtam bshad byas/ phal che bas khyed rang gis gnas tshul rnams chabs cig ngos len zhus yod na de ring gi rnyog khra 'di 'dra yong don med zer/ rgyal rtse gangs steng chen g.yu rgyal rdo rjes ca dngos de dag da bar nyar dgos rgyu mtshan dang / dmigs ༷/la bshad dgos/ brjod pa/ phran gyis nga bros byol thar na 7rgyal dbang rin po che mjal ba'i re ba yod pa dang / de bzhin

78 zhing pa'i dran tho/bod kyi gnas stangs slar gso yong nges snyam pa'i bsam tshul dang dmigs yul tshang ma nye char rtsis 'bul zhus pa las da dung dmigs yul dang rgyu mtshan lhag ma zhu rgyu ci yang med/ shel ril phru gu'i rtsed chas 'dra bar gal che mdog yar 'bul na las byed par dbu skor zhus pa las don gnas ci yang mi 'dug bsams byung brjod/ sang nyin nas phran tshogs chung bzhi pa nas stag sgor ngag dbang nor bu'i tshogs chung bdun par spos bcugaspyi lo 1963 gyi lo mjug/ tshogs chen spyi sku/ 1964 zla 2pa'i nang 'tshogs pa de'i thog bod kyi ga dang dmag sgar gyi bcu dpon lha rgod khrims chad dus bkag 'o/ lnga'i steng gsum spar/ phran la khrims chad 'o/ bcu gnyis thog lo gcig spar ba'i khyab bsgrags byas pa las nyes yig sogs gang yang ma sprad/ lo de'i 'debs las dang ston bsdu tshar rjes sdod gnas spo rgyu'i grabs bshams te spyi lo 1964 zla 11 pa'i tshes shar la batho na pa lo na mtho ba dang nad pa rnams chu don nas gzhung lam brgyud ther ge'i nang btang ba dang / nga tsho nyer chas sgal par 'khyer nas rkang thang la 'khrid cing lam bar lto chas thengs gcig bzas pa'i dus tshod sprad pa las nyin gcig rang la brag khug tu 'gyor ba 'khrid cing / nyin shas rjes rgas gathe nga ma gtogs mkhar kha nas yong ba'i nga cho mi gzhan rnams brag khug btson khang nas le dbar gnyis tsam sa'i shar phyogs zhing rar lton

lho kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa/ 79bsdu'i mjug 'phro byed bcug nas zla ba gcig lhag tsam bsdad/ spyi lo'i lo gsar 'char nye'i skabs te spyi zla 12 zla mjug gi nyin zhig nyer mkho'i nyal gos las yang bskyar 'di gar yong rgyur/ nyal gos lhag ma bzhag dgos zhes nga tsho tshang ma brag khug batho na khang la khrid nas dgun dus slob spyong byed bcug mus spyi lo'i lo gsar gyi dus ston la rol khul bgyis/ dang po'i 'char gzhir 'gyur ba btang ste shar phyogs zhing ra'i nyal gos rnams brag khug tu dbor nas so sor rtsis sprad/spyi lo 1965 zla 2 par btson pa nang khul brag khug btson khang gzhis rtser gnas spo bya yi sku da skor gsang gtam bshad kyi 'dug pa/nyin gcig tshogs chen sgog rgya las kyis deng sang khyod rang tshos btson khang gnas spo bya yi med dam zhes pa sogs sleng mol dang bsam tshul mi 'dra ba du ma yod/ gang ltar sa cha gang du yin yang rang nyid bsgyur bkod legs po bgyi na mdun lam bzang po 'thob kyi red ces bshad/ nyin shas rjes rlangs 'khor 'ga' shas yong nas bathe na pa'i ming tho bsher gyin nyal chas sogs rlangs 'khor nang blugs rjes btson pa kha shas 'khrid cing btson pa mang che ba lhag yod kyang rim pas 'khrid rgyur gtan khel/ dgong dro zhig btson pa tshang ma nyal khang so sor sgo brgyab nas bcug cing phyi nas rgya las kyis ming thod bklags pa rnams phyir bton pa phran dang / stag sgor 'phel

80 zhing pa'i dran po/ rgyas/ rje nub dngos grub sogs mi grangs sum cu 'dug shar phyogs zhing ra'i rtsis pa rgya las des nga tsho'i dbus nas lo gzhon shed stobs che ba bcu gnyis 'dems bsgrugs kyis bcu dpon stag sgor 'phel rgyas bskos te las shog gcig tu bzos/ nga chos mi bcu gnyis las shog bzos nas skar ma gcig tsam las ma 'das gong yang rgya dasngo na gzhan zhig gis nga chod zur khug cig tu 'khrid nas khyed tsho mi su/ma cu gu yangs btang yang / gnas skabs las ka'i dgos mkhor gzhigs nas khyod tsho mi bcu gnyis 'di gar bsdad de rlangs 'khor nang ca dngos do rdzong rgyag dgos pa dang / phyi'i khang par spo chog mi bco brgyad sang nyin thon rgyur nges pas do nub yar log rjes nyal khang du gleng mol gang yang ma byed ces bshad kyang phran gyi sems su de sngon btson bcug dus bkag lo bcu gsum bzos kyang da lta gu yangs yin zhes brjod pa dang / yang gnas skabs sdod dgos pa ci yin nam/ ming nor ba min las che/ phran dang mnyam du khrims chad lo bco lnga btang ba'i rje nub dngos grub sogs 'ga' shas kyang glod 'grol btang ba yin zhes pa'i khongs su 'dug pa bcas ci yin chodad bgam mi thub pa'i re dogs du mas mtshan mo gnyid kyang de tsam ma khug mi sum cu nas bco brgyad dang gzhan mi nyis brgya tsam sang nyin snga sngo nas lnga na pas nga chos mi bcu gnyis zhogs zas grub rjes btson khang phyi rol khang pa'i nang spos bcug byung /

lho kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa/ 81btson pa mang che ba thon yang de'i gong nas glod 'grol yin zhes pa'i kha mo blo bzang dang / 'o/ rgyal zer ba sogs kha cig brag khug btson khang du bzhag 'dug pa kho tsho zla ba gcig gi dus chongad nang dngos su gu yangs glod 'aspol btang ste rgyal rtse brag khug btson khang du btson pa gcig kyang med par bzos te/ shul lus nga tsho mi bcu gnyis la rgya las gnyis kyis 'go 'khrid de rlangs 'khor rirma 'gyor la btson khang gi dngos rigs yod tshad do rdzong brgyab ste brdzangs nas nga tsho thon grabs la/ glo bur nyin gcig rgya dpon gyis skad sgyur brgyud nga tshor khyod tsho lo gcig ring 'dir son khal drug cu'i tshal zhing rnams sa stong ma lus par 'bru 'debs las dang khang pa srung nas dzadad dgos/ nga tshor yod pa'i sbyag ma sogs so nam lag cha rnams gzhis rtse e ma sgang la bskyal tshar bas so nam lag cha sa/nga 'dra dbo sa khyed tshos go bsdur byos/ zhes bshad/ nga tshos go bsdur byas te sang nyin rgya dpon gcig dang skad sgyur/ nga tsho mi kha shas bcas rgyal rtser sbyag ma kha shas dang bod kyi thong shol gcig nyos te rim gyi sa khod snyom zhing chu btang nas mi gsum res thodang shol 'then nas rmo 'debs gang thub byas te sa zhing khyon yongs kyi gsum cha gcig lhag tsam btab kyang / yang nyin gcig gung zas rjes nas sku nam las mtshams bzhag bcug ste sang nyin khang migage dang / sge khung / shel sgo/ lcags ri'i nang gi sbyar lcang ga tshod yod

82 zhing pa'i dran sgo/pa bcas grangs tho brgyab bcug cing rgyal rtse nas mi 'ga' zhig yong nas rtsis blangs/ khang pa dang sa zhing tshang ma rtsis sprad rjes rgya las kyis nga tsho tshang ma gzhis rtse e ma sgang la 'gro dgos pas khyim tshang thag nyer yod pa rnams nang mi thug 'phrad chog pa'i chog mchan sprad pa bzhin gus kyi gcen po yang yud tsam thug 'phrad 'byor/spyi 'o/ 1965 zla 5 par nga chos brag khug btson pa rnams rlangs 'khor thog gzhis rtse brgyud e ma sgang zhing rar 'khrid/ der gtsang khul gyi bce na pa khyon che gu yangs btang yang mu mthud las mir nyar ba rnams sa phug dang / gur nang bzhag 'dug pa nga tsho yang gur zhig nang bzhag ste nyin shas dmangs dang mnyam las kar mngags/ nyin gcig rgyal rtse chu stag bar gyi sku zhabs bde chen dbang phyug dang / 'brong rtse theg mchog gling gi dbu mdzad sku zhabs dbang phyug rdo rje/ dbu mdzad sku gzhon sku zhabs spen dbang / stag sgor 'phel rgyas/ gus bcas zhing ra'i sne zur gyi chu 'khor lug ro'i nang spos bcug nas chu 'khor dang / rngo 'thag byed sa'i khang pa/thab sogs nyams gso dang / de dag nyams gso tshar rjes bcu dpon bde chen dbang phyug bskos nas yos sngo rtsam 'thag zla gcig ring bgyis/ thengs gcig nga tsho btson pa las mi rnams tshogs 'dur bskongs nas sman pas nga tsho 'ga' zhig la brtag dpyad byas te ming tho brgyab pa nang khul de sngon yang

lho kha nas gtsang du ngal rtsol la ded pa/ 8zhabartag dpyad byas te las mi mang lnga zhig sa cha gzhan la btang ba bzhin sa cha gzhan zhig la brdzangs rgyu red ces brjod/nyin gsum tsam nas tshogs 'dur bslongs te mi bzhi bcu tsam gyi ming tho bklags pa bcu dpon bde chen dbang phyug ma gtogs nga tsho rngo 'thag las ka byed mi bzhi yang ming tho bklags shing / sang nyin de ming tho zur bton byas pa rnams gzhis rtse bkar khang la 'gro dgos zhes snga po nas 'gro khar bcu dpon sku zhabs bde chen dbang phyug gis mig nas mchi ma 'dorme/ bzhin thod pa gtugs nas mgyogs po ngo 'phrad 'ong ba'i smon lam 'debs rgyu yin/ zhes gsungs pa/ khyed rang sku gzugs la thugs bcags gnang dgos/ ngo tsho li ra mgyogs po mjal yong zhes zhus nas sems skyo ba'i ngang than na/tsa rir gnas bzang bskor ba'i rnal 'byor pas//tsha grang bzod med myangs par grags na yang //dza drag mtshon cha'i so kha'i bdag cag dang //wa ler bsdur na dka' thub mnyam ma yin//

le tshan drug pa/gzhis rtse e ma sgang nas 〈sna wa spra sna ga tu las sgyur la brdzangs pa/nga tsho khyon mi bzhi bcu ther ge'i nang zhugs te gzhis rtse bkar khang patson khang du bskyod de nyin bdun tsam sdod ring / yang bskyar e ma sgang dang nya ri btson khang nas mi rim 'byor gyis khyon bsde mas btson pa las mi drug cur rgya las bzhis 'go 'khrid de lha sa'i phyogs la thodan dgos tshul las gang du 'gro dang / ci'i phyir 'gro sogs gsal bshad tsam yang med par gzhis rtse nas rlangs 'khor thog snga dro zhig thon/ 'u yug dang / gya la / shog gu la bcas brgyud lha sar nyi ma bzhud la khad 'byor ba grwa bzhi btson khang gi sgo kha'i sa stong gur nang bzhag nga tsho mtshan mo nyal rjes char rlung drag po zhig gis gur gyi ka ra slog nas gur ldib pas grwa bzhi btson

go/zhis rtse e ma/ sgang nas spo bo spra rmog tu las sgyur la brdzangs pa/ 85khang gi sgo ra'i nang 'khrid nas tshogs khang chen po zhig nang bcug sang zhogs rgya las dang rlangs 'khor thon pa'i grwa sgrig byed pa nga tshos lha sa grong khyer nas dgos mkho 'ga' nyo rgyu dang / 'ga' zhig gis spun mched thug chog pa'i re ba blta na yang mi bcu gsum rgya las dang mnyam khrid pa las nga tsho gzhan bkag pas rang nyid kyang rtse pho brang sku gas rgyang mjal las ma byung /rang nyid dang mi lnga 'tsho ba'i 'gan 'khur byed mkhan du bskos te de'i dgong dro char pa shugs che zhig babs kyang gzhis rtse nas yong ba'i rgya las bzhi'i khar grwa bzhi nas ngal rtsol sgyur bkod las khungs kyi 'go gtso han dang /dngul gnyer/ gnyer pa/ sman pa bcas kyis 'go 'khrid de nga tsho dang mnyam du grwa bzhi'i btson pa se ra'i blo bzang thogs med ces pa ming ngan la co ta zer ba yang khrid/ rlangs 'khor lha sa nas shar phyog/sa su kha gtad de bskyod mur rang gi sems su gu yangs btang ba yin khul gyi las mi'i khongs su ma slebs par sngar bzhin btson pa yin na e ma sgang du bzhag yod/ da ni sa phyogs thag ring zhig la 'khrid rgyur nges pas gson por log rgyu yong min cha ma 'tshal snyam ste/ ku ru zam pa ma slebs tsam la kha phyir slog nas myur du log thub cing mi ring bar 7rgyal dbang rin po che nga/nga / jo bo rnam gnyis/ dgon gnas khag sogs mjal rgyu'i lha skabs 'thob pa shog ces spyodan lam drag tu btab/ kong po dang / gser skyems la/ klu nang bcas

8snyo zhing pa'i dran po/brgyud spo yul sa sne 'byor skabs char zhod ha cang drag pos bgrod lam gang sar log nas shar bskyod ma thub pas lam bzo bzhin rong gting yod sar gur brgyab nas zhag sdod byed skabs mtshan gung dug sbrang gi 'tshe ba ma zad/bkan gzar gyi chu sgra gnam sa gas pa lta bur grags/snga dgong dang las ka'i bar gseng la rgya las rnams kyis nga tshor yu+os kung gi ri bo spos pa'i snying stobs la slob sbyong byed dgos zhes slob sbyang dang / bsam 'char bshad mjug pa/ rang skyan rang brjad/ phan tshun skyon brjod rtag tu byed bcug de ltar sgo yul nas tsha ba pad ma/rgyal mo dngul chu/ mgar ma la/ tsha spom mda'/ ri bo che/ dmar ri dgon/ yi dwags la/ zhabs g.yas zam pa bcas brgal nas lta rong rdzong gi r+yā rgyud nas rlangs 'khor gyi lam gsar pa zhig bzos 'dug pa der slebs/ rlangs 'khor gyi lam gsar pa'i thog 'byor skabs mun rub cing drag char rlung 'tshub drag tu 'tshub pa dang lam de ni rlangs 'khor bskyod thub tsam las spus ka ha cang zhan yang da dung rma tshan der lto rdzong du 'gyor thub pa dgos zhes rlangs 'khor gnyis sngon du bskyod pa dang / gnyis rim pas bskyod skabs rjes ma de mgo rting log song ba nga tsho rlangs 'khor spon mar sku da pa'i mi rnams kyis glog 'od las gsal por mthong / nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor bkag nas god chags byung sar rgyug skabs de sngon bod kyi cha dang

gzhis rtse e ma sgang nas sgo bo spra rmog tu las sgrur la brdzangs pa/ 87dmag sgar gyi brgya dpon ngag dbang rgyal mtshan rlangs 'khor gyis mnan nas 'das grongs gyur pa dang / gzhan rnams lam zhabs gtsang chur zag nas rmas skyon dang brdab skyon che chung ma gtogs tshang mar 'phog cha dang brgya dpon ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang gshibs myong ba'i mi rnams kyis mi gshis dang yon tan gang cir phul byung mkhyen spyod gnyis ldan de 'dra zhig 'das grongs gyur pa shin tu 'phangs zhes blo pham tshad med byed/ de'i mtshan mo rgya las gnyis kyis gcos mi 'ga' zhig dang rlangs 'khor bcas sa de gar bzhag cing gzhan rnams kyis rmas ma dag skyor gyin bgrod nas nam phyed yol tsam la lho rong rdzong du 'byor/ sngon du bskyod pa'i mi ཿ/mas rgya mis btsugs pa'i chus su 'byor 'dug pa nga cho 'byor ba dang mal sa nas langs te sne len byas/ sang nyin nga tsho gzugs gzhi thang ba rnams rkyen ngan byung sar mngags te rlangs 'khor chu nang nas tshur bton pa dang rgya las kyis ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi sku phung khyed rang chos ci byed 'dod pa ltar gyis zhes brjod pa ltar/ nyams myong yod pa'i mi bzhi tsam gyis sku phung dum bu 'ga' btubs nas gtsang chur bshams/ nga chodas mgo rting log pa'i rlangs 'khor gyi ca dngos rnams rlangs 'khor gzhan gyi nang blugs rjes rdzi tho dgon bshig ro'i dbus rgya gzhung gis bzos pa'i lto rong shan zer ba bar phyin/ lho rong shan nas rlangs 'khor gyi lam med pas ca dngos rnams

88 zhing pa'i dran tho/nga tshos sgal bar ki lo me ḍar bcu tsam sa'i ngom mdog dgon bar dbor dbo sa byung / ngom mdog tu dgon ro rgya chen zhig 'dug pa spyi lo 1960nang rgya dmag gis stor ba red zer/ nga chod gzhis ka rtse nas zla ba gcig tsam ring bskyod rjes lho rong ngom tho dgon du spyi lo 1965 zla 8 nang 'byor nas de gar bsdad rgyu gtan khel ba'i skor bshad cing / sa der bod rang skyong ljong btson khang ang gsum pa 'dzugs rgyu'i 'char gzhi btings pa'i skabs red/ nga tsho nyin shas ring btson pas gsar lbol byas pa'i zhing khar nyung son 'debs su bcug cing de nas las rtsol che ba'i lo gzhon nyi shu nyal gos bskur nas nyin phyed ring gom bgrod kyis lung pa'i phur shing gcod du bcug pa dang / bcad pa'i shing rnams gtsang chur bskur nas mar 'khyol thabs byas kyang phu hrag gi gtsang chu yin stabs shing rnams 'khar bar/ nyin gang chu nang 'dzul nas shing 'don bskur byed dgos byung ba dka' ngal dang nyen kha ha cang che ba'i ngal las zla ba gcig tsam byed dgos byung / lnga ma mdog tu ma slebs tsam gyi chu kha'i sa stong zhig tu shing rnams bton nas tshang ma ngom mawa ga tu 'khrid de las mi mang che ba thang dkar sgyu nga zhes pa'i sa stong du sa phag brgyab par bskul/ sa phag brgyab ma tshar gong bod rang skyong ljongs btson khang ang gsum pa 'dzugs rgyu'i 'char gzhir 'gyur ba byung ste las mtshams bzhag nas tsang ma ngom lnga dgon du 'joḍams

gzhis rtse e ma sgang nas spo bo spra rmog tu las sgrur la brdzangs pa/ 89bcug lnga ga sa cha 'di nas gzhan zhig tu bskyod dgos pas/ spo bo dung la brgyab nas spo yul du bskyod thub min blta bar 'gro rgyu yin zhes 'go khrid cig dang mi gnyis tsam phyin nas tshur 'khor rjes la rtse gangs kyis 'gags yod tshul dang sngon yong sa'i lho rong brgyud nas 'gro dgos pa dang / rgya las gnam gang gis gtsos mi nyi shu ngom mdog tu mo da pa'i rta drel dang g.yag rnams blta rtog ched bsdad de phyi 'o/ gangs bzhu nas la lam phye mtshams yong rgyu'i 'char gzhi btings/ nga tsho mi bzhi bcu ngom tho nas rdzi tho rdzong / lho rong / tsha spom mda'/ pad ma/ ra hor brgyud lpo bo gsum 'dzoms su zla ba 11 pa'i zla 'jug la 'byor/ der lung shur shin tu dog pa yar bltas na gnam dang gangs ri/ mar bltas na sa chu las mthong rgyu med pa zhig tu gur brgyab nas bca' sdod byed bcug thog ber shing bcad nas sol ba bsregs rgyu dang / sa stong phran bu zhig las med pa de yang sbyag slog brgyab bcug sa rong dog pa'i gsum 'dzoms su zla ba gcig/ lhag tsam song rjes te spyi lo 1966 lo 'char ma thag nyin gcig nga 27 rlangs 'khor nang khrid de spo bo spra rmog rdzong dang / khu ta zam chen brgyud spra lung du 'khrid/ der rgya gzhung gi zhi ba'i las byed dang dmag mi/ nyen rtog pa bcas mang po 'dug pa dang chab mdo khul gyi las mi drug cu tsam sku/da pa der gnas skabs sdod dgos zhes bzhag nga tsho'i 'go khrid kyis mngon chung

90 zhing pa'i dran tho/thos/ nga tshor thab chas dang lag cha sogs mnyam bsres ma yin par zur 'jog byed dgos brjod/ las bgos brgyab pa'i nang phran dang deng dus rda sar yod pa'i ding ri ba a jo ngag dbang sogs shed shugs che ba 'ga' shing gcod las shog tu btang / nyin ltar ri la shing gcod par phyin nas zla ba gcig tsam rjes rgya las ru dpon hu'u yis phran la las mi'i 'tsho ba'i 'gan 'khur gyi rtsis gtsang ma brgyab nas 'khrul 'khor gyi kha lo ba slob sbyong byed par 'gro dgos skor bshad kyang yid ma ches/spyi lo 1966 zla 2 tshes 16 nyin ru dpon hu'u dang ru dalnga na gro mo ba rta mgrin dbang phyug gnyis kyis phran btson khang las khungs lhe bar 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i kha lo ba'i slob sbyong byed par mngags/skabs der gzhis ka rtse nas yong ba'i mi rnams la zla re'i phogs thob rgya sgor nyer bzhi nas nyer brgyad bar sprod pa phran la yang sgor nyer brgyad yod pa zas gos tshang ma de nas 'deng ba bya rgyu las gzhan gyi thabs 'tshol byed yul ci yang med/ 'drud 'then 'khor 'o/ gtong mi'i dge rgan yang rgya mi cun tsha'e zhes pa ngan grags can zhig gis gtsos kho pa'i bza3 zla rgya mo kha lo ba zhig dang / bod pa bzhi 'dug pa tshang ma dbang cha yod pa sha stag red/ btson pa las mi'i khongs skye sa yul gtsang thob rgyal nas yin pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che'i 'phrul 'khor slob grwa ba pad+ma rgyal po 'drud 'then 'khor lo gtong

gzhis rtse e ma sgang nas spo bo spra rmog tu las sgrur la brdzangs pa/ 91bar dgos gel yod na 'khrid yong gi 'dug khong ni mi spyang grung ldan pa zhig red/ dpyid kar ru chen khag nags 'dabs zhing ra dang / mdong chu ru chen/ rdzong sna ru chen/ chu mdo ru chen bcas su ru chen rer son khal stong phrag gnyis gsum gyi sa zhing yod pa tshang ma rmos 'debs byed dgos/ rang nyid 'phrul 'khor gyis 'then pa'i lcags kyi thong shol gting ring thung tshod 'dzin byas nas zla ba gnyis tsam sdod ring las shugs che cher 'don dgos pas lus por chag brgyab nas dka' khag che tsam byung / de nas ston kha ston slog dang dgun gro 'debs pa sogs kyi las ka g.yas g.yon gang sar byed dgos/ lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig nang dgun dus phru ba sbyong tshugs pa gus pas las mi tshang 'dzoms sar ngas las slob sgrig gsum la ma 'dang pa'i nyes pa bsags med kyang rgya rigs las mi rnams la ngal rtsol gyodan ras dang khrus rdzas/ khrus ras sogs sprad kyang phran la ma sprad pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re yin nam zhes bshad/ der 'go khrid nas dmigs bsal gyi lan ma btab kyang slob sbyong tshar rjes slob ston pa/ lha sa ba phun tshogs sna rjes gtsos 'go 'khrid rnams kyis sems gnag byas nas spra lung du mngags/ der shing chu bshag brgyab dgos kyi las ka lci bar ma ltos par gzhis rtse nas yong mi tshang ma yod stabs sdod 'dod che ba byung yang zla ba gnyis tsam nas yang bskyar rdzong snar 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i las

92 zhing pa'i dran rbo/ka byed par 'gro dgos brjod byung / phran gyis ru dpon hu'u la sngon 'drud 'then 'khor sku(re las ka byed skabs gus kyis nor 'khrul gang yang byas med kyang gzhan la ngal rtsol gyon ras sogs sprad pa bzhin/ nga la yang sprod rosas lab pa de ma 'grig par brtsis nas spra lung du phyir log btang ba mu mthud 'di gar bsdad chodag pa zhes bshad pa yin/ ru dpon des kha spyodan khyod rang gis chodar 'khrul gang yang byas mi 'dug la da dung de 'dra ma bshad par yar phyin nas 'drud 'then 'khor lo gtong stangs yag po sbyang dgos/las khungs lte bar 'byor ba dang ngal rtsol gyon ras sogs lam seng sprod brjod chog ces yar u tshugs kyis mngags/ der mu mthud lo ltar stodan dpyid gnyis nyin mtshan med pa rmo slog gi las ka byed dgos pa dang rmo cadag gi las ka med skabs rgya rigs btson pa las mir bsgrur ba kha cig dang mnyam me shingagacod pa dang / sngon zur khang gi kha lo ba shar pa dpal 'byor dang mnyam 'drud 'then 'khor lo dang rlangs 'khor baX bcos bcas bgyis/bod rgya mi rigs su yin yang srid don slob spyong gi do dam du 'tshud pa nas bzung gza' nyi ma nam 'char la gza' 'khor gcig nang las slob sgrig sogs ji byung rang skyon rang brjod dang gzhan skyon ther 'don byed dgos pa dang / de bzhin lo phyed slob spyong / dgun dus slob sbyong zhes pa'i lo yi mjug sdom gyi slob sbyong bcas byed mus khar/ rig gnas gsar

gzhis rtse e ma sgang nas spo bo spra rmog tu las sgyur la brdzangs pa/ 9zharje 'go tshugs te do dam che cher 'gro zhing phran dang shar pa dpal 'byor gnyis rgya mi rnams dang mnyam du dgong ltar slob sbyong byed dgos shing / rgya las nas nga tshor da lta tshang mar srid dbang med pa zhwa mo yod pas mi ser dang 'brel ba so/gas byas mi chog mu mthud bsgyur bkod mthar phyin gyis mi gsar pa zhig tu gyur nas mang tshogs dang 'brel ba thub pa byed dam/yang na klad rnying mkhregs bzung gis mu mthud log spyod lam du 'gro bcas lam gnyis gdam kha byed dgos zhes/ rnying bzhi rtsa gtor sogs kyi las (regul nang slob sbyong yin khul gyis bsun gtser sdug sbyong sna tshogs btang /tha na mchu to 'gul tsam byas kyang rmongs dad byed par bsnyad de 'thab rtsod dza drag pos mjug 'bras skyi g.ya' ba zhig bzos/ phran gyi las rogs rgya mi yin par brten de rnams la do snang gtso bzung gis rang nyid la dmigs bsal dka' tshegs che ba dang gnas tshul gsar pa gang yang ma 'phrad pas las khungs lhe ba nas blta stangs skyon med tsam yod do/zhwa bzhin btsan pos mnan pa'i rgya dmar sngo sa//za zir dngangs skrag rgya mtsho'i klong chen du//'a 'ur dbang med bdag cag ded pa'i tshe //ya med dpung stobs can yang ci bya dben///

94 zhing pa'i dran tho/ le tshan bdun pa/'a〈snar zhag gi dus snumad thengs gnyis/rgya rigs las mi de rnams skabs 'gar rgya nag tu 'khor zhag gtong gi 'dug pas gus kyis kyang spyi lo 19snyo8 lo'i dpyid 'debs tshar 'phral 'khor dgongs shig gnang rogs zhus pas/ khyim du zla ba gcig bsdad 'thus kyi dgongs pa sprad de 'khor zhag tu 'gro mi gtsang phyogs kyi rgya las mi lnga dang mnyam du btang / rlangs 'khor brgyud lha sar 'byor skabs gyen log dang mnyam sbrel shog khag gnyis kyi 'thab rtsodad bskyar du langs nas gang sar bskyod yul med par gnas tshang du nyin bzhi bsdad rjes/rgyal rtser 'gro ba'i 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor thog rang yul kha mo grong tshor 'byor/ khyim du 'gro skabs nga tsho'i shar ngos khang pa dang / gu ru chos dbang gi gdan sa kha mo dgon gyi brten rten pa tshang ma stor bshig btang ste gyang ro bzos pa ma zad/ ri'i rtsi shing dang tha na zhing kha'i mu kha'i tsher shing

'khor zhag gi dus tshod thengs gnyis pa/ 95rnams kyang rtsa ba nas bkog ste ri klung yul hrong tshang ma skya thal ler gnas/rang nyid khyim nang glo bur 'byor ba dang pha dam pa yar bzhengs nas gus la 'thams te chabs cig zhe sa dang bcas lus khams bde thang dang dka' sdug ji byung bka' 'dri gnang zhing / phran thug par dga' snang dang gus rgya las kyi cha byad lta bur gzigs te 'tsher snang yang mdzad par gus kyis pa lags khyed rang sku gzugs gang 'dra 'dug gam/ gcen po gang du yod dam/ khyed kyis gus par 'tsher snang dang zhe sa ma mdzad rogs/ nga ni khyed rang gi bu ma gtogs gzhan gang yang ma red/ ces zhus/ nyin gcig gnyis rjes sngar bzhin thugs dgyes tshor dang zhib sleng gnang /gus kyi gcen mo bzhi spyi lo 1959 bo nga nas sa khul de khul du 'jig rten mthun 'jug zin te gcen mo gnyis pa drug cu'i lor khyim mi dang bcas 'brug yul du skyabs bcol du bskyod kyang gzhan gsum so so'i khyim skyong gi las su zhugs sku da pa tshang ma gral rim mnga' tshab dang / log spyod pa'i khyim tshang red ces grong tsho gcig tu gnas kyang thug 'phrad mi chog pa dang yul lung tha zhan de lta bur gyur bar brten sems ngal yid rmus tshad med byung / grong tsho'i 'go khrid rnams la ngo sprod lag khyer mig la bstan nas dgongs 'khrol gzhir bzung 'khor zhag yong skor dang lung par sdod ring gcen mo sa/sum dang thug 'phrad chog pa'i bka' 'khrol gnang rogs

9snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/zhu skabs/ kho tshos gros bsdur byas chog ces pa las thag gcod ma byas/dgong dro zhig dmag don sku tshab kyi rgya dmag cig dang skad sgyur gcig chus nas grong tshor 'byor te tshang ma tshogs 'dur bsgongs te/ 'go khrid rnams rim pas 'dzoms pa gus pa rgya dmag gi mdun bcar zhing ngo sprod bstan nas zla gcig sdod ring spun mched rnam thug 'phrad chog pa zhes zhus pas/ngo sprod yi ger bltas rjes spun mched thug na 'grig ces brjod byung / rgya las gzhan rnams la bstun ma dbo sa par gcen mo gsum gyi khyim dang tshur ga dus yin yang ngo 'phrad byed chog pa byung /rig gsar gyi las 'gul nang sku gsung thugs rten rnams rmeg med du bcoms shing phran gyi pha dam par zhwa mo 'bog tho zhig g.yogs shing /sog byil zhig btags/ sgal par rang khyim gyi yon chab 'bul byed 'jon krong zhig bskur nas grong tshor bskor bar khrid/ khyim gyi g.yang sgam nang gi gzi rnams dang g.yu pha g.yu ma g.yu/ gnam lcags rdo rje/ sa khul der nga chorware khyim gzi mang shos yin pa lus rgyan g.yu byur gzi la sogs pa btsan 'phrog byas pa dang / khyim chas shing sgrog dang ka gdung gyang ldebs tshang mar dkar rag byug nas thal skya 'tshub pa zhig bzos/ gser dngul chas ka rdo rdzog btang ste leb mo bzos pa phran tsam lhag rin po che'i rigs de dag rdo rdzog btang skor brjod kyang don dngos sus khyer gsal shes med/ sngar

'khor zhas gi dus tshod sbengs banyis pa/ 9mi bde zhing skyid pa'i yul lung bzod thabs bral ba'i 'dre yul lta bur gyur nas mi rnams nyin las rtsol dang mtshan tshogs 'du dang 'bral med thog 'grul pa rnams bkag ste ma'o deb kyi nang don ngag rgyugs blangs te ngag rgyugs ma 'a'o/da bar lam nas mi gtong / gral rim kyi ming btags pa rnams nyin bdun re'i nang bsam shog 'bul dgos la dgong mo gcig slob gso'i skyon brjod tshogs 'dur skong zhing don med 'thab 'dzing nyes rdung skyi g.ya' ba gtong / gral rim pa sanyis lam du thug kyang phan tshun skad cha tshig gcig bshad mi chog pa ma zad/ pha ma bu phrug khyim tshang so so yin na / chog mchan ma lnga ba par 'brel ba byas mi chog pa bcas/ gnas stangs brjod kyi mi lang ba'i thabs sdug de 'drar gyur pas rang yul yin yang sdod ma 'dod pa'i tshor snang drag tu skyes/rgya dmar gyis bod mir btsan bskul gyis dmar srung dmag gis dgon grong gi lha sku rten gsum ming tsam lhag med stor bcug skabs gu ru tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyi 'dra sku bcag pa de'i nang sku sha skam min rlon min dang / dbu skra sngo chob tsam yin pa'i dmar gdung zhugs yod par 'go khrid rnams kyis ngal rtsol mi dmangs 'byor med pa rnams mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis bsad nas sku'i nang bzhag pa red/ ces sogs byung rgyal du smras te sha 'od kyis phung gsog thebs pa'i sa sgog cig brus nas sa dong

98 zhing pa'i dran tho/nang sbas pa red ces brjod/ dgon pa'i nang rten gu ru chos dbang gi zhabs gnyis rjes shul dbus su tshe bum gyi dbyibs gsal ba'i tshe bum zhes pa nye rabs su'ang bdud rtsi 'khrungs lugs bshad rgyun yod pa de rdo la brdab kyang bcag ma thub stabs/ nga tsho'i grong tsho chags yul ri ldebs su dor ba rbab 'gril gyis chu yur nang lhang pa phran gyi pha phebs zhor zhig la rnyed pa gsang ba'i thog bsna mas nas gcen po dang gcen po'i bza' zla gnyis la yang ma bshad par zan khang nang sbas/ phran gyi gcen mo bzhi par bu chung ba rig 'dzin log rgyu byung na/ khyim du gzhan gang yang bstan rgyu med kyang zhabs rjes tshe bum ma nyams pa ra bstan rgyu yod/ ces gsungs/ phran dang pha dam pa gcig pu yin pa'i nyin zhig zhabs rjes tshe bum dang / ston pa'i sku par zhig 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i sku par gnyis/ 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che dang yongs 'dzin dngul chu rin po che rnam gnyis mnyam du sgron pa'i sku par gcig 7skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i sku par gcigalam rim tshogs shing gi sku par gcig bcas gdung lcam gseb nas gdan drangs te mig ston mdzad pa dga' spro dad gsum sgo nas zhabs rjes tshe bum ma gtogs gzhan rnams spo bo spra sna ga tu gdan drang rgyu bgyis/'khor zhag dus dzartad rdzogs la nye bas gzhis stod sru mo zhi spel zla skyid ngo 'phrad byed thabs ma byung bas sru mor rgya sgor kha shas shig gcen

'khor zhas gi dus tshod thengs gnyis pa/ 99mo bzhi pa brgyud bskur/ khyim nas rgyal rtse grong rdal du rlangs 'khor sgug tu yong skabs gyen log dang mnyam sbrel shog khag gi drag po'i 'thab rtsod bskyar langs kyis sa gnas gang sar mi khyus lam bkag nas khyod rang gi lta ba shog khag gang yin zhes dris/ rang nyid 'khor zhag gi ngo sprod bstan nas nga la lta ba gang yang med/ btson pa gu yangs thob pa zhig yin/ 'khor zhag tu nang mi thug par phyin nas mar 'ahro mkhan yin/ ngo sprod yi ger gzigs rtogs gnang rogs zhes zhu 'bul byed dgos byung / gnas tshang nas rgyal rtse lcang lo zam chen nye 'gram dmag sgar gyi rlangs 'khor babs tshugs su snga dgong thengs re bskyod de babs tshugs kyi 'go gtso rtsad bcad de lha sar rlangs 'khor nang gtong thabs yong ba'i re ba zhus/ lha sa bar bskyod pa'i rlangs 'khor med kyang rgyal rtser gong smos shog khag gnyis nang 'khrug zang zing gis nyen 'gan che bas chab mdo glog khang gi bzo pa rin spungs pa zhig dang mnyam du/ gung dkar gnam thang la 'gro mkhan rlangs 'khor zhig gi thog chu shur zam chen bar babs tshugs 'go gtso de'i rogs ram 'og bskyod thub/ chu shul zam chen gyi pha rol rta dkar nye 'khris su dmag sgar gyi rlangs 'khor babs tshugs shig 'dug pa der nga gnyis kyis 'go gtso rtsad bcad de/ lha sa bar gyi rlangs 'khor zhig la mngags pa'i re ba zhus pa bzhin khas blangs kyang rlangs 'khor bskyod mkhan mi 'dug

100 zhing pa'i dran tho/ dgong mo rta dkar grong sde'i 'go khrid la gnas g.yar yong ba'i re ba zhus kyang las khungs nang sdod yul med kyang grong tsho'i 'go khrid cig gi khyim du bsdad chog pa'i chog mchan sprad pa ltar grong tsho'i 'go khrid cig gi khyim du gnas g.yar byas/dgong dro zhig babs tshugs 'go ga༄ḍa de'i rogs ram 'og lha sar 'gro ba'i rlangs 'khor thog gdong dkar gyi lho ngos dmag sgar nub phyogs kyi skyel 'dren babs tshugs su 'byor/ lha sa'i khor yug gang sar shog khag gnyis kyi drag po'i 'thab 'dzing zing cha che bar brten lha sa grong dkyil du dmag don u yon lhan khang btsugs te/ 'grul pa'i lag khyer zhib bsher dang rlangs 'khor bkod sgrig sogs byed pa'i yan lag cig gdong dkar nub ngos dmag sgar gyi bab tshugs su btsugs 'dug pa/ der nga gnyis phyin nas gnas tshang g.ya/ra ba'i re ba zhus par lo na lnga bcu tsam la sdudan pa'i dmag dpon zhig gis nga gnyis kyi lag khyer la mig ma blta sa par khyed gnyis ga par 'gro ma khan yin nam/ zhes dris/ phran gyis rgya skad thog chab mdodar 'gro mkhan yin brjod pas nyin kha shas bskug dgos zhes dang /ming dris te lag khyer zhig mnyam du sprad de nyal khang do dam byed mi brtsal shog zer byung / nga gnyis de'i dgong mo der bsdad de sang zhogs snga po nas phran gyi lam mo gas lha sar zla ba gcig tsam sdod mkhan yin zhes nam

'khor zhag gi dus tshod thengs gnyis pa/ 101gsal ba dang lha sar thon/ phran der bsdad de lag 'khyer der don ga re bris yod min rlangs 'khor sgug pa'i bod rigs las byed cig la dris pas blo mthun rig 'dzin dang mi gnyis gran rdur 'gro rgyur/ dmag khul khang gi rlangs 'khor thog bsdad 'thus dang lam khel babs tshugs khag nas gnas tshang dang zas gos sogs kyi mthun 'gyur sprod dgos zhes bris 'dug zer ba/ gzhi nas phran gyi rgya skad ma dag pas chab mdo dang khran rdu gnyis go nor byung ba shes byung /'on kyang stes dbang gi lag 'khyer de 'dra zhig thob pas chab mdo bar shar bskyod rlangs 'khor med kyang dmag khul khang gi rlangs 'khor thog dus yun zla ba gcig lhag tsam ring dmag mi'i sne len babs tshugs kho na brgyud spo bo rgu shang du 'byor/ sa gnas de nas rlangs 'khor 'gro lam zhig nas med/ stabs le dbar gcig gi sa'i btson khang ang gnyis pa'i khongs kyi sa phag sreg pa'i ru chen bar gom bgrod bya rtsis la lung tsho de'i 'go khrid kyis gang nas yong dang / gang du 'gro/ gang byung 'gro mi chog ces brjod pa / phran gyis nga ni btson khang gnyis pa'i las mi zhig yin/ 'khor zhag nas btson khang ang gnyis pa'i las khungs lte bar 'gro rgyu yin yang do nub rgu shang ru chen la bsdad kyi yin/ nga'i lag 'khyer la gzigs rogs zhes lag khyer sprad/ grong tsho'i 'go khrid des rgya yig ma shes stabs gang ltar

10na zhing pa'i dran tho/ca dngos bzhag nas rgu shang ru chen nas 'go khrid cig 'khrid yong dgos/deng sang gang byung phyin mi chog ces brjod byung bas/ phran gyis mgyogs myur ru chen du phyin nas las byed par gnas tshul rnams brjod pas kho pa tshos rnam 'gyur bzang pos nga tsho kha shas slebs yoci+ong / las mi re gnyis 'khrid de ca dngos brlags yod med zhib 'jug byed dgos/ lag 'khyer yod bzhin du lam bar bkag 'gog byas pa mi ser gyi 'go 'khrid de khyad tshar thag chod pa red/ deng sang 'grul pa yong thub mab/ na mi 'dug kyang khyed rang gang 'dra byas nas yong thub bam zhes hang sang sang byed/ don dngos kyang phran la lam 'gro de ltar rgyugs pa las gzhis rtse nas thon nas bzung dmag mi'i rlangs 'khe ra ma gtogs rlangs 'khor gzhan rnams bkag 'gog byas 'dug pa dang lam bar yang shing sdong dang lcags sdong gis rim par bkag byung / de nas las byed mi gsum dang ca dngos len rogs bcas nga tsho 'gro skabs mi ser gyi 'go khrid de bsdad med kyang kho pa'i bza' zla 'bod de las byed rnams kyis mi 'di nga tsho btson khang gnyis pa'i khongs mi yin pa'i lag 'khyer yod bzhin du/ ka kor bshad dgos pa ga re yin nam/ zhes brjod song ba bud med des dmag sgar gis nga tshor mi gang byung 'gro ru ma bcug zer gyi 'dug kyang khyod rang tsho'i mi yin na/ lab sleng gang yang med brdzod/

'khor zhag gi dus tshod thengs gnyis pa/ 103de nas dgong gcig rgu shang ru chen du bsdad de sang zhogs ca dngos rnams rjes su ther ge'i thog gtang rgyur mngags te phran rlangs 'khor zhig gi thog le dbar sum cu tsam bskyod cing / de nas spra lung gi las mi yod sar gom bgrod kyis bskyod de dgong gcig bsdad nas rgyal rtse khul gyi las mi rnams la rang yul gyi gnas tshul dang / gnas 'phrin yod par gnas 'phrin sprad/ khyim nas khyer ba'i sku par rnams gsang ba'i ngang slos thub ding ri a jo ngag dbang la mjal khar ston pas dga' gus tshad med byed pa dang rang nyid kyi sdod gnas rgya mi dang mnyam du yin rkyen sku par nyar thabs bde po med pa bcas a jo ngag dbang la bcol/ sang zhogs spra lung nas le dbar brgyad tsam yod pa'i bzung sna'i las khungs lhe bar phyin nas 'brel yod do dam 'go khrid la lam bar dka' ngal je mang 'phrad de shar bskyod ma thub par zla gcig tsam nar 'gyang phyin lugs brjod pas/ 'go khrid rnams kyis gang yang byed kyi ma red/ yong thub pa zhe drag yag po red/nyin gnyis tsam ngal gso rgyobs zer/ skabs der nyer mkho'i chas ka yang nyo yul dka' ngal ha cang che bas tha mag 'then mi rnams kyis ja ro rtsodag bur bsgril nas 'then gyi 'dug phran gyis lam bar dmag sgar zhig nas pho/sa pa'i mngar cha dang tha mag nas rgya mi las mi rnams la rkang re gnyis bgos te sprad pas dga' tshor chen po byung song ngo /

104 zhing pa'i dran tho/skabs der rig gsar las 'gul dza drag spel ba'i sgang yin par brten phran dang shar pa dpal 'byor gnyis btson khang ang gnyis pa'i las khungs lhe ba'i khongs yin pas nga tsho las slob sgrig sogs la do dam chen pos/ snga dgong gtan 'bebs dus tshod ltar slob sbyong rgyun mthud khar ma'o yi rtsom deb nas don tshan 'ga' dang / yus kung gi ri bo spos pa dang /pa'e chi'u an la dran gso zhu ba/ mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba bcas rtsa ba'i gsung rtsom gsum zer ba slo 'dzin byed dgos pa ma zad/ snga dro yar langs pa dang tshang ma ru star gyis ma'o 'dra par mdun langs nas nyin gcig gi las slob sgrig gsum khas len tshigs bcad 'ga' shas tshang mas dus gcig la skad brgyab nas 'don dgos/ dgong dro ma'o par mdun nyin gcig gi las lho ba rnams ji byung snyan seng zhus nas ma'o tshe lo khri phrag thub pa dang lin pe'o lus khams bde thang yong ba'i smon 'dun tshigs bcad 'ga' bcas skad gsang malnga na pos tshang mas mnyam skyor byed dgos/ gal srid phran bu'i rnam 'gyur tsam ma sgrig tshe 'thab rtsod dang dgag pa mthar phyin byed cing nyin shas sger bcug sogs byed/ rang nyid rgya mi dang mnyam du yin stabs 'khor zhag gi dus gnyis pa spyi lo 1971 lor zin pa ma zad/ skabs der khyim nas gnas 'phrin kha shas 'byor ba'i nang pha dam pa'i phyag la rtsa grib phog pa dang gcen mo che ba tshe lī sa 'das pa'i skor 'khod

'khor zhag gi dus tshod jengs gnyis sī / 105'dug pa/ yid skyo tshad las 'dasdoshaṃ kyang bskos pa'i las dang dpral pa'i gnyer ma zhes pa ltar zlog thabs ci la yod/ pha dam pa'i rtswa grib la sman res btson khang ang gnyis pa'i las mi ru khag khongs kyi de snga sman rtsis khang sman pa mkhas pa tshul khrims bstan 'dzin mchog dang / thub bstan shākya rnam gnyis la pha dam pa'i snyun gzhi'i gnas tshul dang sman ga re dgos sogs bka' 'dri zhus/ khong gnyis kyis sman bsam nor dang byu dmar nyer lnga/ rin chen bsam 'phel re gnyis gnang /lo de'i dpyid 'debs tshar 'phral 'khor zhag tu dgongs pa zhus nas rgyal rtse ba stag sgor 'phel rgyas dang / rin spungs byams chen dgon gyi grwa snar lcang gong chos mdzad blo bzang chos ldan bcas dang mnyam du thon/yar lam kong po nying khri shing gcod ru khag tu de snga bsam yas kyi btson grogs bod lugs sman pa mkhas pa dbang rgyal mchog gtugs te pha dam pa'i ched sman ra ṇa bsam 'phel sogs sman phran bu gsol bstsal byung / lha sar yang bod sman phran tsam thabs shes byas/ rgyal rtser khyim du 'gyor skabs mi mang gi thon dngos rnams mi mang ru khag tu bsdus nas bod spyi dang lhag par gtsang khul la mu ge sngar bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba zhig lo shas bstud mar byung bas/ bod mi ltogs bkres kyi shi tshad chen po byung ba / dper mtshon tsam brjod na/ rgyal rtse rdzong khongs zhal che lcang ra lho

10snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/pa'i jo lags sa zhing rmo sar nad gzhi ci yang med par gdong skrang lbos kyis ltogs shi thebs shing / rgyal rtse khrom sde khul gyi mi mang rnams bza' rgyu med rkyen bong bu bsad nas mnyam bzas byas pa sogs brjod kyi mi lang ba'i bkres ltogs dang / ngal rtsol 'ar 'ded/ tshogs 'du/ 'thab rtsod sogs kyi mnar gcod chu gnyer lta bu rdzogs mtha' med pa'i las 'gul ji snyed la brten mi yul gyi dmyal khams ngo ma zhig tu gyur ro/khyim du 'byor rjes gal srid lto chas yod na yang ri steng nas yong ba'i rdzi bor ru khag 'go 'khrid kyis sgal pa'i lto phad chung ngu'ang bsngogs nas lci ba sogs 'khyer yod med blta zhib byed pa sogs me shing ha cang dkon/ rang khyim du lto chas chad pa'i dka' ngal med kyang sru mo zhi spel zla skyid nang mir 'bru rigs dang rtsam pa dkar thig tsam yang med pa'i dka' ngal che yang spun mched phan tshun 'brel ba byas mi chog 'on kyang phran gyis sru mo thengs gcig ma thug na rtsa ba nas mi 'grig bsams shing de sngon ngo shes yin pa khul de'i 'go gtso lhag pa tshe ring mdun phyin te/ phran 'khor zhag gnyen 'phrad 'byor nas spun gzhan rnams thug 'phrad byung yang sru mo zla skyid sa khul mi 'dra ba yin stabs thug 'phrad ma byung / dbu khrid mchog gis gus pa'i sru mo thug 'phrad chog pa'i bka' 'kho la ci nas yod pa mkhyen zhus pas/ 'go gtso lhag pa tshe ring gis chog mchan sprad de 'go khrid gzhan

'kho ra zhag gi dus tshod thengs gnyis pa/ 107gyis dris na/ ngas chog mchan sprad byung 'es brjod ces bshad byung bas/phran gyis spun mched gzhan rnams las bza' chas phran bu re slong ste rdzi sgye cung che ba gang byung ba khyer nas sru mo'o sa khul du 'byor skabs de sngon sprang motsware bu mo ru khag 'go khrid gzhon pa zhig gis gtsos/ bud med du ma zhig zhing nang yur ma rgyag gi 'dug pa mo'i sar phyin nas nga zhi spel zla skyid thug par yong pa yin/ sa khul 'go gatho sa chog mchan gnang byung yang khyed rang ru khag gi 'go khrid yin pas lhang tsam zhu bar yong ba yin brjod pas/ mo na re/ zla skyid mo da lta nang la yod pa dang khyim pha gi red ces mig ston byas/ sru mo'i khang pa 'og shod gzan khang rnying gog cig 'dug pa sgo rtsar 'byor ba dang sru mor nga slebs yod/ gang 'dra 'dug ces brjod skabs 'u/sa 'gyel ma gug 'khar ba la brten nas yar ldang nas phran la 'thams te ngu bzhin 'dug pa/ phran yang skyo nas mchi ma thon la nye bar sru mo'i lus skyor bzhin sru mo mar sdod bcug nas bza' chas rnams phar sprad/ sru smad zla skyid de sngon ru khag gi rdzi bor mngags pa brag ri'i ldebs nas rbab ril sna ra te rkang pa ya gcig chag grum gyur pa lus 'khar bar brten nas sgur rer 'gro dgos stabs/ ru khag gi 'go khrid rnams kyis skad gtong skabs mo re khyi mo smad chag ces 'bod pa sru mo dang spun mched rnams kyis brjod/nga gnyis bar lam dka' sdug myangs skor shod skabs sru mos khang pa'i nang

1༷8 zhing pa'i dran tho/rtsam pa dkar thig tsam med kyang sems bzang can kha shas kyis ra lug gi lpags pa ster ba btsos nas bza' yiciyod/deng skabs sngo tsag tsig skyes yod nga/ra brten ltogs shir 'gro ma dgos tsam mi sku/nga ngam zhes mig nas mchi ma phrum phrum lhang zhing yang sems gso tsam galta nga rgyu las rogs phan bya ba'i nus pa ni rang nyid la'ang dben/ dus yun gang tsam bsdad rjes phan tshun yang bskyar thug pa'i smon lam 'don zhing kha bral dgos byung ngo /pha dam pa phyag g.yas la rtsa grib phog ste 'gul mi thub par gyon gos mi gzhan gyi mo gas ram la brten dbo sa/ kyang sman rnarma sa sman pa mkhas dbang tsho'i zhal mngags ltar/ phul bzhes kyis nyin nyi shu tsam nas rim pas ldang skyes byung ste phran 'gro khar phyag 'gul bskyod gang 'tshams thub pa/ nyin gcig nga gnyis kyis gu ru chodas dbang gi zhabs rjes tshe bum lto phad nang blugs nas chu khar gyon thodas bkru bar 'gro tshul lung pa'i chu rgyud ri zur gyi brag btsan gyi rten gzhi brag dkar po'i gseb tu sbas/ 'khor zhag dus yun rdzogs pa dang rgyal rtse nas thon te sngar mus ltar spo bo spra rmog btson khra/ nga gnyis pa'i las khungs lhe bar las ka byas te dgun thodag gnyis rgya rigs las mi dang mnyam du ri la sol ba sreg par btang ba dang / stodan dpyid sa zhing rmo 'debs kho na byas/ rang nyid las slob sogs rgya rigs

'khor zhag gi dus chodad thengs gnyis pa/ 109mnyam yin yang bza' 'byu dang gla cha sogs bod pa las mi dang gcig mtshungs dang / s+t+ri lo 1965 lor gzhis rtse nas gla rim par bzos pa'i rgya sgor nyer brgyad nas skar li gcig ma spar yang 'drud 'then 'khor lo gtong ba dang / bzo bcos sogs sbyang brtsodan mu 'thud byas/ btson pa 'o/ dus gtsang ba rnams la las mi zhes ming bsgyur kyang bathongan pa dang khyad med lta bu'i dam drag che zhing 'tsho ba'i thog gro skam rngos pa'i tsam pa kho na dang / gro zhib dang gro lpags 'dres ma rtsing po zhig zla rer ki lo bcu dgu/mar snum gang rung ngotshe/ gsum/ ja ki lo phyed/ tshwa ki lo gcig bcas zhing las pa'i 'char gzhi ltar dang / gla cha'am 'ahrū dod mi mang che bar rgya sgor nyer bzhi dang / mtho bar rgya sgor nyer brgyad// zla ba'i gla cha nas 'bru rigs/ ja mar tshwa bcas kyi rin dod 'phri ste sgor kha shas blang rgyu yod pa nas nyer mkho'i gyon chas sogs nyo dbo sa/phran tsho mang tshogs dang 'brel ba rtsa ba nas byas mi dzadag cing rgya las kyis nga tsho las mir rgyun du nas khyod 27sa mu 'thud bsgyur bkod byas nas zhwa mo phud thub pa dang mi gsar par bsgyur nas tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung bi/ rjes su 'brang thub pa/ 'byor med gral rim srid dbang sger 'dzin la mu mthud srung rtsi mtha' gcig tu zhus nas ngal rtsol sgyur bkod kyi gtan 'bebs sgrig lam khag dam srung / mi mang srid gzhung gi las byed

110 zhing pa'i dran tho/rnams kyi bka' bkod mtha' dag la dang len brtsi 'jog zhu dgos pa sdudags bshad/ bdun re dang dus tshigs re/ lo phyed mjug bsdoms/ lo 'khor mjug bsdoms bcas slob sbyong che ba khag dang / de bzhin ming 'dra min btags pa'i slob sbyong dgong ltar tshugs/spyi lo 1971 tsam nas dmag don sku tshab zer ba'i dmag mi 'gyor nas bzung skabs re las byed dang / sa khul de'i mi ser bcas kyi tshogs 'du'i thog nga tsho ru star bsgrigs bcug nas drag chas dmag dpung dang / skabs der ched du btsugs pa'i btson pa las mi dang rgya gzhung las byed la yang gdug rtsub 'thab rtsod byed pa'i rdung rteg tshogs chung gi mi 'ga' zhig gis nga tsho rgyug shar glod bcug nas tshogs ra bar 'khrid/ mtha' tshang ma drag chas dmag mi mdza na cha lnga gas pas bskor nas las mi btson pa rnams sgur bcug nas dmag dodan sku tshab dang / btson khang gi do dam pa dmag dngo na gyis yongs bsgrags su phran tshor nga tsho'i mdun du yod pa 'di rnams tang dang mi dmangs kyi dgra the/ yin/ nga tshos mi ngan 'di rnams nas su zhig la 'thab rtsod gtong 'dod kyang btang chog khyod tsho tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'byor med gral rim srid dbang sger 'dzin la brtsi srung mtha' gcig tu zhus nas log spyod 'byor ldan gral rim gyi langs phyogs dang lta ba goms gshis sogs mtha' dag bsgyur babo da

'khor zhag gi dus tshod thengs gnyis pa/ 111mthar phyin pa gtong dgos/ khyod tsho'i mdun du yod pa ni lam dkar nag gnyis yin/ gcig 'od zer stong ldan gyi lam dang gcig shos ni 'chi lam red/ ces sogs gshe gshe du ma btang rjes/ mar rgyugs shig ces tshang ma rgyug shar spyodad bcug nas mjug tu lus pa'i rgas gcong rnams la rdog rgyag sogs zhus nas sdod yul bar 'ar 'ded btang gi yod/lhag par du brjed mi srid pa'i gnad don zhig ni bzung sna'i las khungs lte ba dang bzung sna zhing las ru chen gyi ru 'bring bzhi pa dang lnga pa bcas kyi sgo rar sa sbug gting ring drud nas btson khang bzos/ btson pa dang las mi'i nang nas ro/na gnad phran bu byung ba kha cig sa dong nang batho na 'jug byas/ phran gyis shes gsal las mi btson pa nag chu ba dar rgyas dang rgya rigs yacad yi sang gnyis sa dong nang dus yun gang tsam bcug go/nyin zhig chab mdo sa khul gyi btson pa a than zer ba zhig thodas byol du phyin tshul gyis me mda' brgyab nas nags 'dabs ru chen du bsad pa'i mgo lag sa gnas de dang / 'dam chu ru chen/ chu mdo ru chen/ spra lung ru chen sogs su 'grems ston byas pa dang / de bzhin bzung sna ru chen btson khang gi thodag sa gcig tsam brtsigs pa'i me shing steng / mi mgo rlon pa khrag ral dzar rer bkal nas mdun ngos sa stong du nga tsho mi bzhi bcu tsam yod pa bskongs nas ru star pus mo btsugs te mig yar blta

112 zhing pa'i dran bo/bcug thog 'bo khrid gtso snga rnams kyis gtam bshad byas snga na/ mi ngan kho pa bros kyang thar thabs ma byung ba ni nga tsho dmag dpung gi lha bas rtsal drag shugs gnam 'og 'gran zla med pa'i malnga na tshul gsal wa ra mthong thub pa red/ mi ngan kho par rjes 'bras 'di ltar byung bas khyed tshos kyang sdug tshod ma zin na/ rjes 'bras 'di rang red/ ces sogs thengs du mar gshe/de bzhin slob sbyong yang dza drag je cher btang nas mi re re'i lo brgyad tshun gyi lo rgyus bskyar bshad byed du bcug pa dang / mi gcig gi lo rgyus bshad rjes yang mi re res sngon du bshad pa'i mi de'i lo rgyus la dbye zhib byed du bcug pas mi rer dgong mo drug tsam 'gor gyi 'dug pa ma zad/tshig zur mtho dman la yang sgro 'alnga gas kyis 'thab rtsod tsha nan dang / shing gi rkang khri'i thog pus mo btsugs bcug nas sked pa hreng nger lag gnyis mar slod nas bzhag ste gdong nas rngul chu dza re dri ba 'dra min bkod de dathodang ltar mtshan phyed yol tsam bar btsan bkag kho na byas/ btsan bskul gyi 'jigs zil ma bzod par btson pa dang las mi gtsang chu dang khron pa'i nang mchongs ba dang / shing sdong la gnam thag brgyab pa/ rang sge bcad pa bcas kyi rang shi rgyag mkhan ji snyed byung ngo /yid shin tu skyo ba zhig la spyi 'e/ 1970 nas spyi lo 1973bar bathe na pa dang las mi dmar gsod rim nga/ra btang ba nas btson khang

'khor zhag ci dus chori zengs sanis pa / 113ang gnyis pa'i khongs gcig por nyin gcig btson khang gi las khungs lte bar chab srid btson pa bcu gsum sdeb gsod btang / btson pa dang las mi dmar gsod gtong rim bzhin khor yug khag tu yod pa'i ru chen gyi 'gro mi thub pa'i nad gcong re zung ma gtogs sa/zhan rnams rlangs 'khor dang / 'drud 'then 'khor lo/ lag skyor 'khor lo sogs kyi nang blugs te btson khang gi las khungs lte bar 'dzoms thog sngon du ru chen so so dang /ru chen nas ru 'bring / ru 'bring nas ru chung bcas gral star bsgrigs/dmar gasdusad gtong yul nas rgyang grags gcig tsam bar gyi lam kha g.yas g.yon me ḍar bcu tsam sar drag chas dmag re langs/ tshogs ra'i mtha' dmag dpung gis bskor cing chodags rar rgya dmag 'ga' shas kyi blta rtogs dang ri 'gor dmag dpung je mang 'grems 'dzugs byas/sdings cha'i thog rgya las dpon po 'ga' zhig bsdad cing kho pa tsho'i mdun ngos dang mtha' skor du lag tu mchodan cha thogs pa'i nyen rtog pa dang spyi bde mi sna 'ga' shas langs te nyen srung byas/ de rjes rlangs 'khor zhig nang thag pas lag gnyis dam por bsdams nas ske la yang 'gag thag bslangs shing gnya' steng shing byang ring po re gzer ba'i dmar gso da gtong byed kyi mi rnams tshogs rar khrid de bang sgrig nas sgur rer bzhag ske la 'gag thag bslangs yod pas skad brgyab mi thub cing thag pas bsdam che bas

114 zhing pa'i dran tho/rang 'tsho zin thabs med kyang drag chas dmag mi gnyis gsum nas dmar gsod gtong byed mi re bzung / dmar gsod lag star byed pa'i rgya dmag rnams kyis mig shel nag po dang / lag shub dkar po gyon te lag tu me mda' re bzung nas gra sgrig ngang bsdad/ rgyang grags nas tshogs 'du 'go tshugs kyi khyab bsgrags byed pa dang nga tsho'i mdun na yod pa'i mi ngan 'di dag ni lo rgyus kyi sdig can dang / log spyod pa/ 'byor ldan gral rim pa sogs ngan smras sna rgu byas te khyod tsho tshogs ra'i sgrig khrims dam srung byed dgos pa las/ gang byung 'gul bskyod byas tshe skabs bstun lag star bya rgyu yin zhes bcadad/de nas go rim gyi gtam bshad mang po zhig bshad rjes dmar gsod gtong byed rnams kyi ming dang / nag nyes mdor bsdus bshad tshar ma thag lam seng dmar gsod lag star byed dgos zhes brjod pa dang / drag dmag nas lam seng drud kyin tshogs ra dang bar thag me ṭar bzhi bcu tsam du sa dong brus yod pa'i khar khrid di bang bsgrigs nas bzhag ste/ dmag dpon zhig gis lag star byed dgos pa'i bskul brda btang ba dang de ma thag me mda' brgyab nas dmar gsod btang zhing / dmar gsod btang ba'i phung po rnams sa dong nang sdeb gcis sbas/ dmar gsod btang ba'i btson pa ming ngo shes pa chab mdo khul gyi sprul sku be chung a dkar dang / chab

'kho ra zhag gi dus tshod thengs gnyis pa/ 115mdo khul gyi rdo rnam/ kong po ba bu a nyog sogs yin/ de'i rjes kyang chab srido btson pa dang las mi gnyis gsum re dmar gasdudad rim par btang nga /ra bzi gdon gyis myos pa'i gshed ma yis//la rgya brtan pa'i bod rigs spun zla rnams//sha tsha'i smre ngag dbang med 'don bzhin du//sa steng 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol bsgral//tsāri () snalani 4stoX sdu

11snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/le tshan brgyad pa/7gong sa mchog gi sku par las/ nga dang a co ngag dbang la gnas tshul 'phrad pa/rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul tshugs nas bzung btson pa rnams khrim/sa chad 'o/ dus gtsang yang rang khyim du cadag rgyu bkag nas mi tshe btson khang gi khor yug tu bskyal rgyu'i cho zo zhig gtod nas nam zla skyel skabs/ phran mtshams re gza' nyi mar dgongs pa zhus te gtsang nas mnyam du yong ba'i ding ri a jo ngag dbang sogs kyi mdun spra lung gi las mi ru chen yod sar yang yang phyin te ding ri a jo ngag dbang la bcol ba'i rngorgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par mjal te smon lam re btab/ sku par gcizhan rnams phran gyis khyer nas 7gong sa mchog gi sku par gcig a jo ngag dbang gi dad rten du nyar ba spra lung las mi kha shas la a jo ngag dbang gis

7bo/nga sa mchog gi sku par las/ nga dang a ce ngag dbang la gnas tshul 'phrad pa/ 117mjal kha btang yang gnas tshul ci yang ma 'phrad/ da dung nga tsho snying nye blo thub rnams bod don skor re stong gi 'char snang 'dzems bag med par bgro kleng dang bros byol du 'gro rgyu sogs gsang don rirma par bshad kyang gnas tshul phyir gyar rtsa ba nas med stabs blo bder gnas skabs te/ phran rgya rigs las mi nyi shu lhag tsam dang mnyam du btson khang gi las khungs lte bar snga lo'i mjug bsdoms lho ba sbyong byed skabs/ spyi lo 1973 zla 1tshes 5 nyin gcigado gong dro spra lung las mi ding ri ngag dbang 'dzin bzung byas skar thas sa/phran sdod yul btson khang gi las khungs lhe ba yin par brten sa khul gzhan gyi gnas tshul kha par 'dre ra gyi yod pa rgya mi rnams kyi bo thos byung ba dang phan tshun lab gleng byed/ rang nyid sems 'tshab dang blo pham chen po byung yang ma shes pa'i zol gyi snang med lta bur mu mthud slob spyong byed mur nyin gsu’ma nas spra lung las mi'i 'cho ba'i 'gan 'khur ba tsha ba mdzo sgang gi bsod nams nor bu de ring 'dzin bzung byas skor thos pa dang /dgong mo lho ba sbyong tshar nas log khar rgya las 'go khrid shus kha'i krang dang gro mo ba rta mgrin dbang phyug gnyis kyis gus la khyod rang spra lung la lung pa gcig pa dang ngo shes sar yang yang 'gro skabs/ khyed rang gi deb sogs khug ma nas zags pa'am dngos su bzhag pa sogs ji 'dra sku/da/ gsal
