118 zhing pa'i dran tho/po shod zer/ phran gyis nga'i deb sogs lus pa dang bzhag pa rtsa ba nas med ces bshad pas/ tshur thag gcod mdog kha po de 'dra ma shod/ bsam blo gtong yul zhig bzhag nas mno bsam legs par btang ste gsal ngo zhu na/ da lta rang 'gul gyis rtsis 'bul zhus par brtsi chog tang gi srid jus ni kha gsal la gu yangs dang / sbas skung la drag gce na bya rgyu yin/rang 'gul ngos len dang gzhan gyi 'ther 'don rjes ngos len gnyis dbye ba chen po yod/ khyed rang gis rang skyon ngos len dang gzhan skyon ther 'don byas te byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel thub pa dgos zhes sogs brjod byung yang / phran gyis tang gi srid jus la yid ches dang skyon dang nor 'khrul nag nyes sogs 'byung phyin srid gzhung la rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu kho na las gzhan gyi thabs lam dang phan 'bras gang yang med pa ngos 'dzin gsal por thub/rang nyid kyis spra lung du deb sogs lus pa dang bzhag pa sogs gang yang med zhib 'jug gnang gro gas zhes ngos len rtsa ba nas ma byas kyang /sems nang spra lung gi las mis ra sprod par 'ong yang sku par la lag bris kyi ming sogs med/ gal srid btson khang du bcug kyang da lta'i gnas stangs dang khyad par gang yang med snyam nas ngos len mi byed pa'i sems thag bcad/ de nas slob sbyong gros bsdur byed mus dang / rgya las kyis do dam slob gsetsware gtam bshad skabs shugs kyis phran gyi gnas tshul brjod pa dang /

7bo nga sa mchog gi sku par las/ nga dang a co ngab dbang la gnas tshul 'phrad pa / 119sde tshan 'gan 'dzin shus zhes pas dri ba thengs kha shas bkod byung yang gong zhus las ngos len tshigatsagacig ma byas/ nyin gcig rgya las dang rgyun du 'dris che ba 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i kha lo ba gro mo ba nor bu chung bas las yul du phran la nang mol gyis khyed rang la tā la'i par yod skad brjod pa de ltar yin tshe ngos len dang rtsis 'bul ma byas na rang nyid dka' ngal dang /mdun lam la gnod skyon chen po sku nga lugs brjod byung bas phran gyis khyed rang nas nga la thugs 'khur gyis bka' gnang ba ngos 'dzin gsal po 'dug kyang rang nyid la rtsa ba nas med brjod pa yin/rang nyid blta rtogs 'og 'tshud pas gang byung 'gro bskyod dka' bar brten las rogs bod rigs shar pa dpal 'gyor la sku mkhyen/ khyed rang gis sku par dang ga'u bcas ri steng brtan sa zhig la sbas rogs brjod pas khong gis de ltar khas blangs thog ri la bskyal/ ding ri a jo ngag dbang bzung sna btson khang du bskyal 'dug zla ba gnyis tsam rjes nyin gcig snga dro las 'asku tshugs pa'i dus phran btson khang gi las khungs lte ba'i gzhung las khang du skad btang nas spra lung ru chen gyi 'go gatho rgya mi zhig dang / gro mo ba rta mgrin dbang phyug gnyis kyis phran slebs pa dang rkub stegs steng sdod bcug thog rgya mi des rnam 'gyur ha cang 'jam po'i sgo nas/ de ring khyed rang 'dir skad gtong don dri rtsad min par gros mol rnam pa'i thog

120 zhing pa'i dran tho/nas nga chod kleng mo la bya rgyu yin/ khyed rang gis lo mang ring las ka yag sngo byed kyi yod pa 'bo khrid tshang mas gcig grags brjod kyang mi su yin yang dge skyon zung 'brel yong ba chos nyid red/ khyed rang spra lung du lung pa gcig pa dang lhag par ding ring ngag dbang gi mdun thengs mang phyin pas gnad ro/na gang yod gsal ngo ra shod/ nag nyes chad pa gang yang med pa'i 'gan len nga gnyis kyis byas chodag zer ba sogs bshad kyang / rang nyid kyis ding ring ngag dbang dang gdong thug ra sprod gtong rogs brjod pas rgya las gnyis kas rnam 'gyur 'jam po'i ngang gdong thug ra sprod chodag gi ma red/ khyed rang gi par skor ding ri ngag dbang tsam ma yin par mi gnyis gsum gyis dngos don gsal por brjod kyi 'dug pa/ nga tshos kyang zhib 'jug mthar phyin byas pa las skabs re dzad thos dang ro/gas pa tsam gyis mi la dri rtsad byas pa'i gnas tshul yod kyang da lta'i de 'dra min/ dper na/nga tsho gzhung las khang du bsdad pa'i skabs 'dir phyi nas mi zhig gis phag pa tshang nas phyi la thon no/ zer ba'am/ yang na phyi'i lcags ri log 'dug zer ba lta bu'i skad brgyab pa thos na/ phag pa phyi la shor ba dang / phyi'i lcags ri log pa'i cha 'dzin ma byas par/ phag tshang du phyin nas grangs ga tshod phyi la don pa dang rgyang thag ring thung ga tshod sar slebs yod pa sogs blta dgos pa dang / de bzhin lcags ri'i mdun phyin nas dngos su log

7gong sa ma chog gi sku pri ra las/ nga dang a co ngag dbang la gnas tshul 'phrad pa/ 121min mig gis balnga dgos pa ma zad/ gyang ring mtho'i tshad ga tshod zhig sku da med sogs zhib 'jug mthar phyin gyis gsal por shes pa byed dgos pa ltar/ dang po khyed rang gi red brdzod pa nas da bar gyi gnas tshul rnams gsal por shes rtogs byung / mi gsum yan gyis khyed rang gi yin pa'i ngos len zhus na khyed rang gis khas ma blang yang khrims chad gtang dzadag gi red/ de ltar ma dgos par khyed rang bi/sa ngos len zhig byas na nyes chad blta bzhag tshogs 'du sogs la ming lha na tsam byas mi yong / zhes sogs 'jam bshad kho na byas kyang lngaras len rtsa ba nas ma byas par gung zas kyi dus zin/gung zas rjes bsam blo yag po btang nas mu 'thud sku nga dgos brjod pa ltar gzhung las khang du phyin pas/ yang kho rnga4 gnyis kyis phran la nyes chad ma 'phog pa'i skyodab thabs kyi dmigs yul kho na yin zer ba sogs 'jam bshad kho na las skad shugs che tsam kyi 'ur shodab tshig gcig kyang ma brjod pa dang / g.yo can de gnyis kyis sha tsha'i zol gyis 'jam bshad kho nas rang gi bsam blor rang nyid nas kyang brdzod mi shes pa'i slo bur g.yo 'gul zhig thebs nas da nga rang gis lnga sa len zhu yi yin/ par de rnams rang nyid kyi yin/ spyi lo 1968 lor rang nyid 'khor zhag tu 'gro skabs khang pa bshig rgyu dang sngo ba sogs byed skabs sngon gdung ma'i gseb la

12na zhing pa'i dran tho/bzhag pa'i sku par rnams khyer te rang nyid kyis nyar bar zhed snang gis blo thub yid ches yod pa'i ding ri ngag dbang la bcol ba yin/ ding ri ngag dbang gis phran la par yod pa shes kyi med pas tshur nyar gyi yin zhes brjod pa rtsa ba nas med/ gang ltar par gyi nyes 'gan ngos rang la yod pa las ngag dbang sogs mi gcig la yang le thogs med brjod skabs par rnams da lta gang du yod zer/ phran gyis par lo shas ding ri ngag dbang la bcol yang mu 'thud bzhag na blos 'gan mi bzod pas lo gcig bo nga nas tshur blangs nas mer bsregs pa yin/ zhes brjod skabs kho pa gnyis kyis tan tan mer bsregs sam/ rjes su don na gang min bya yi red/ brjod pa / phran gyis da lta yod na/ lam seng 'bul lam zhus nas khyed gnyis dang mi dmangs srid gzhung dgongs pa dwangs ba dang thugs yid ches pa yong nges kyang nyar ma nus par mer bsregs pa yin/ zhes bshad/ kho pa gnyis kyis khyed tsho bros byol 'gro rgyu sku gas sgrig 'dzugs btsugs pa'i gnas tshul mang po sku da pa las mi gzhan dang gnas don ga re yod na'i gsal po shod/ ding ri ngag dbang la par bcol skabs dang len skabs khyed gnyis bar gsang gtam ji bshad dam/ zer byung ba phran nas ngag dbang nga gnyis rgyun du 7rgyal dbang rin po che sku zil pa phrum mer bzhugs yod pas snga phyi ma gtogs bod rang btsan 'thob rgyu'i slor phan tshun bshad pa las bros gyol

7gong sa mchog gi sku par las/ nga dang a co ngag dbang la gnas tshul 'phrad pa/ 123skor rtsa ba nas shes kyi med/ kho pa gnyis kyis khyed rang bros gyol sgrig 'dzugs la zhugs pa red ces brjod rgyu med kyang sang nyin nas las ka mtshams bzhag nas da bar gyi gnas tshul gang yod gsal po 'khod pa'i sngoras len zhu yig cig bris shig ces don du bsam blo'i dus tshod zer ba'i gnon shugs kyi 'bo btsugs/zhu yig nang sku par gyi 'byung khungs dang 'gan rang nyid la yod pa / rang nyid rjes lus rmongs pa yin stabs gtam brjod dang / bya spyod gang sar skyon nor yod nges kyang dmigs bkar 'di byas ngos len zhu rgyu rtsa ba nas med ces tshig thag bcad do/ha go don rtogs can gyi dad sems la//ha cang ma bzod gdug can kla klo yis//a 'thas rang shed kho nas rgol na yang //a re dad stodabs lhag bsam ci la 'gyur//

124 zhing pa'i dran tho/le tshan dgu pa/gcen po'i nad dang / stes dbang gi bza' zla/gong gi gnad don der nyes 'gan che ba bzos ma byung yang lo de'i zla ba 4 pa tsam la phran bsgu na khang gi las khungs lte ba nas rgyang grags gcig gi sa'i mi brgya lhag tsam yod pa'i bzung sna zhing las ru chen du mngags/ bzung snar bod pa kher gtsang yin zhing rgya rigs las mi rnams dang mi 'dra bar bod pa las mi rnams 'o/ ltar dbyar ston gnyis kyi dus tshigs su zhor las rta rtswa dang / phag rtswa/ dgun dpyid gnyis ri nas lud tshad gzhi bzos nas bsgrugs dgos pa sogs mi rigs kyi dasde 'byed de ltar byed/ lo 'khor mjug bsdoms su las mi kha shas la rtswa dang lud rgya ma sko nga phrag kha shas zhor las su bsgrubs pa rnams re re bzhin ming tho dang /grangs klog skabs rang nyid kyis rtswa lud spar mo gang yang 'thu yi med pas

gcen po'i nad dang / lces dbang gi bza' zla/ 1na5ming ston dngos su ma byas par shugs kyis gshe gshe phran bu btang skabs rang nyid la sems 'khur byed mi rnams kyis rtswa lud phran bu bsgrugs pa'i re ba byed/ tshad gzhi longs min lta zhib byed mkhan bu tshe ring gis gus la sems 'khur gyis khyed rang gis rtswa lud phran tsam bskyal na ngas tshad gzhi mtho tsam brgyab kyang chog mod/ khyed rang gis rtswa lud rtsa ba nas ma 'khyer na tshad gzhi tho rgyag thabs ga la yod ces bshad myong yang gus pas snang 'jog rtsa ba nas ma byas/ bzung sna ru chen gyi las mir de sngon btson pa dang las mi dmar gsod gtong yul ri khug cig tu khang pa brgyab cing lcags ri bskor 'dug de nas btson khang gnyis pa'i las mi yongs la lo de'i mjug bsdom brgyab pa dang 'brel las mi nyung shas/ shig zhwa mo phud pa yin zer nas sdod khang sogs zur dbye dang / las mi mang che bar 'tsho snon gla cha phran bu spar ba las lag rtsal med pa'i zhing las pa gla cha che ba rnams la sgor 35 tsam dang / lag shes kyi mi sna rdo bzo ba dang /shing bzo ba nyung shas la sgor 46 tsam bcas 'tsho snon gyi gla rim bzos/ru chen tshang ma'i 'drud 'khor kha lo ba rgya bod bsdoms nyi shu tsam gyi dge rgan gtso bo rgya rigs shig yod pa kho par rig gzhung thog nas 'phrul 'khor skor gnas lugs gting zab bshad rgyu yod kyang dbang cha yod mir brten bzo bcos sogs de tsam mi byed/ phran ni 'drud 'then 'khrul 'khor

12snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/dang / rmo 'debs 'khrul 'khor/ sa bshang 'phrul 'khor/ 'dam g.yos 'phrul 'khor/ 'grim 'grul 'phrul 'khor sogs gtong dgos pa ma zad/'khrul 'khor che chung khag rang mgo thon pa'i bshig sgrig gi bzo bcos shes pas/ gte po'i dkyil gyi gzugs bzang zhes pa ltar ru chen khag gi las mi dang btson pa rnams kyis 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i rig 'dzin zhes 'bod kyi yod/ don dngos kyi las ce la dang lag rtsal mi dman tsam yang sku dpar gyi gnad don des gla phog 'tsho dod sngar gyi sgor nyi shu rtsa brgyad nas skar li gcig ma spar ba'i thog spyir las 'gul rim pa dang / lhag par lin dgag khung dgag zer ba'i las 'gul skabs btson pa dang las mi'i nang du gros bsdur dgag rgyag tshogs chen sogs je mang spel 'jug gi yodad/skabs de dag tu 7rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis la dgag pa rgyag dgos pa'i 'bod bskul gyis btson pa dang / las mi'i dkyil nas yar thon dang hur brtson can rnams kyis gtso lnga ra dgag pa'i gtam bshad byas/ rjes lus pa tsho yang dgag pa'i gtam bshad dang rang nyid bsgyur bkod bya rgyu'i chod sems kyi yig cha bajo sa nas tshogs chen lnga ga spyodag bcug nas mthar yig cha rgya las 'thod khrid la sprad dgos/rang nyid kyang thengs kha shas shig dgag yig 'bri klog bya dgos byung ba'i nang ro/na 7rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi mtshan zhe sa dang bcas

gcen po'i nad dang / ltes dbang gi bza' zla/ 127te bris nas da bar khong gnyis la slo gtad re bcol byas kyang rang nyid la thob 'os pa'i grub 'bras bzang po ci yang ma byung / dngos don gzhir bzung slad de rigs kyi re stong dor nas bsgyur bkod hur brtson bya rgyu'i chod sems brtan por 'dzugs rgyu yin sogs/ 'bri klog mi byed ka med byung yang khungs med kyi rgyu mtshan bzos nas khong rnam gnyis la mtshan smad zhus pa/ yig ngag bsam blo gang thad nas sne gcig med/ las 'bras ni nam yang bslu med dang lhag par 7rgyal mchog gnyis ni mgon skyabs nyag gcig yin snyam pa'i sems la nam yang g.yo 'gul ma thebs/ dper na/ zhing nang 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i rmos rgyag par 'gro dus btson pa rnams r+shang rtsa dang / rdo pha bong chen po btsan shed kyi 'don du bcug skabs nus shugs kyis 'grub re bral ba'i rigs rang nyid kyis lcags thag/ gis 'then pa sogs nang khul rogs phan gang yong byed kyi yod stabs/ btson pa dang las mi rnams kyis dga' snang chen po byed la/ lhag par glog khang dang chu 'then 'khor lo gtong mkhan gro mo ba bu tshe ring dang nga gnyis 'cham mthun yod pas/ bu tshe ring gi las yul zur sdod yin rkyen rlung 'phrin las rgya gar gyi gsar 'gyur dang res gza' phur bur 7gong sa mchog gi gsung chos phran bu rgyang sring byed pa nyan nas gnyis ka yid gdung gi mchi ma nar nar phyung nas sdod dgos kyi yod/

128 zhing pa'i dran tho/spyi lo 1975 lo 'bo ra phran gyi gcen po dngos grub 'o 'khor nad mnar ha cang lci yang khyim du gcen po'i bza' zla rgan mo gcig dang dgung grangs gya lngar son pa'i pha las med pas nang mi dang grong tsho'i 'go khrid/ gnyen nye sogs kyis gnas yig dang / tar 'phrin sog/sa rim 'asdudar la 'phral du lha rab rtsa dgongs dang de ltar ma byung yang 'khor zhag tu dgongs sdokyis kyis gcen po sman khang la bskyal nas 'phral skyob bya dgos sogs rim 'byor la phran gyis gnas yig dang / tar 'phrin 'dre ra rigs rnams rgya las 'go khrid rim pa ra bstan te 'khor dgongs la gtang ba'i skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa zhes thengs mang zhus mthar 'khor dgongs su dpyid 'debs tshar 'phral gtang 'thus khas blangs pa ltar/ spyi lo 1975 zla 4 pa'i nang 'kho ra zhag tu gtsang theg mchog gling dgon gyi dbu mdzad dbang phyug rdo rje sogs mnyam du lha sar 'byor te dbu mdzad dbang phyug rdo rje'i tsha mo bkra shis dbang mo'i mdun gnas tshang g.yar/rgyal rtse'i rang khyim du 'byor rjes gcen po pho ba'i nad gzhi lci pos zas ma 'ju bar bshal te dus yun ring po phyin nas rgyal rtse khul bod rgya sman khang gang sar brten yang phan bskyed ma byung bar/ gzhis rtse 'am lha sa gang rung la sman bcos bya na gang 'dra sku nga zhes nang mi spun mched rnams kyis bsam tshul tsam brjod pa las gson pa'i re ba de tsam mi byed/ gcen

gcen poci chad dang / ltes dbang bi bza' zla/ 1na9mo 'das po'i bza' zla dbang grags kyang mgo bo'i na tshar sman bcos kyis bcos ma thub pas phran gyis gnyis ka lha sar khrid de gzhan ngo shes med stabs dbu mdzad dbang phyug rdo rje'i tsha re bkra shis dbang mor gnas tshang g.yar/ bkra shis dbang mo gral rim mnga' bdag dang sgyur bkod kyi mi sna yin pas khang pa yang 'og/ shod gcig las med pa so/gas 'chos ba'i thog dka' ngal che yang / nyin bdun re'i mtshams 'grul pa gnas dzadad chog pa'i bka' 'khrol chodag 'dzin zhu bzhin zla ba gsum tsam ring nad pa gnyis la rgya bod kyi sman khang bsten pas gcen po'i nad gzhi seng drag byung ba dang /dbang grags kyi mgo bo'i na tsha yang sang 'tshams drag skyed byung bas gnyis ka rgyal rtser khyim du phyir skyel byas/ pha dgung grangs gya lngar son yod kyang sngon gyi nad gzhi drag skyed byung nas rang g.yog rang gis thub cing khyim dang spun mched rnams kyi gnas stangs mi dman tsam du gyur te sru mo zla skyid kyi nang du 'gro skabs sru mos dgre/'a spro'i ngang da lta'i bu khyod la spags zhig zo zhes brjod rgyu yod ces dga' skyo zung gi mig chu btang /rang nyid kyi 'khor zhag dus tshod zla ba gsum lhag nar 'gyangs gyur par gnas lugs rim par btson khang gnyis pa'i las khungs la phul yang / ga re brjod cha ma 'tshal ba'i mur lha sar sngon las kyi bkra shis dbang mo dang mdza' mthun du gyur te bkra shis nga/bang mor mngal du bu phrug

130 zhing pa'i dran tho/cig kyang sbum/ bkra shis dbang mo'i de sngon gyi bza' zla bod gzhung gi rtse drung zhig yin pa spyi lo 1959 lor rgya dmar gyis 'dzin bzung gis bod dmag khul khang dang / grwa bzhir btson bcug byas rjes las mir btang skabs 'das grongs gyur/ nga dang bkra shis dbang mo thug skabs snga 'dzar bu mo chodas sgron lo bcu bdun du son 'dug phran sgyur bkod mi sna yin pa dang bkra shis dbang mo gral rim pa yin pas nga gnyis mnyam gshib yong rgyu ha cang dka' zhing stabs nyes na rig 'dzin bskyar du btson khang la 'gro rgyu'i nyen tshabs che zhes/ dga' nye ngo shes rnams kyis kleng yang nga gnyis la bya thabs ci yang mi 'dug mthar phran spo yul du 'gro rgyu dang bkra shis dbang mo lha sar bsdad de sbum ldan yin pa gsang ste phru gu ma btsas sngon gnyen sgrig chog mchan 'thob pa'i 'bad brtson bya rgyu thag bcad/phran lha sa nas thon te spo yul gyi bzung sna btson pa'i las khungs lhe bar 'byor 'phral 'brel yod las byed rnams la gcen po'i nad gzhi bcos thabs rkyen pas dus 'gyangs gyur lugs bshad skabs sngon 'tshud nas gnas lugs rgyu mtshan 'phrin yig thog phul bas snyad 'dogs ci yang ma byas/ de nas phran lo na che tsam la slebs par brten bza' zla zhig dgos nges pas/ las mi dbang phyug rdo rje'i tsha mo zhig dang mdza' mthun ngang gnas na / 'di nas phran la chodag mchan dang ngo sprod lag khyer zhig gsol ras

gcen po'i nad dang / ltes dbang gi bza' zla/ 131thugs rjes gzigs zhus/ 'go khrid kyis ston las sna/ 'debs kyi dus zin la nye bas 'phrul chas la nyams gasdud dang grwa sgrig byed gal che lugs dang /gnyen sgrig chog mchan ngo sprod 'di nas lam seng sprod thabs med kyang sngon la bza' zla'i 'brel yod nas ngo sgrod yi ge zhig byung na/ nga tshos ngo sprod sprad chog zer byung ba/ rang gnongs kyis lo de'i ston las rmo 'debs rnam 'gyur gang zab dang / spyi mtshungs ltar zhor las rtswa lud bsag rgyu sogs rang bzhin gyis bya rgyu las thabs ma byung / skabs der zhing las ta krer slob sbyong zer ba'i las 'gul nang las ka dza drag shugs chen bskul 'ded kyis nga tsho bzung sna ru chen gyi las mi'i nang rgya las 'go khrid kyi tsha 'ded smos ci las mi'i nang khul 'go pa rnams dang / lhag par da lta rdzong gsar bshad sgra dgon du yod pa'i sde dge rdzong sar dgon pa'i mkhan ming kun dga' dbang phyug gis las mi rgan gzhon bar gsum la las slob sgrig sogs la 'ar 'ded dang re zung la nyes rdung yang gtong gi yod/las mi rnams zhogs pa nas nyin gung chu tshod dang po bar hūr brtson gyis lud gsog dgos pa dang / de nas gung zas spags dang ja khu bza' 'thung skar ma bcu tsam byas rjes sgal par sle po khyer nas rgyug shar ngang lci ba dang rta bang sogs sle po re zhor la bsgrugs dgos cing / nyin gung chu tshod gnyis par spyi las 'go 'dzugs dgos pa sogs btson pa dngos

132 zhing pa'i dran tho/las las mi rnams dka' ngal che ba'i skabs rang nyid kyis las ka rnams byed pa smos med thog do dam 'go khrid rim par gnyen sgrig ngo sprod zhig gnang rogs/ bza' zlar phru gu 'khor yod pas snyad 'dogs mi yong ba'i nges pa med ces thengs 'ga' zhus kyang bza' zla'i phyogs nas ngo sprod ma 'byor bar sprad kyi min zhes brjod/ lha sa nas ngo sprod 'thob pa'i 'bad brtson byed dgos zhes phran gyis bza' zla bkra shis dbang mor yi ge rim par btang yang phyogs gnyis nas ngo sprod ma 'thob sngon te spyi lo 1976zla 2 tshes 26 nyin phru gu btsas pa dang bu yin pa'i gnas 'phrin 'byor/ phru gu btsas pa lha sa'i sa khul ༷/ yon lhan khang 'bo khrid kyis shes te phru gu'i pa phar yi ge sogs gtang mi dzadag pa dang / phru gu nag po yin pas bza' 'bru them tho sprod kyi min la nyes 'gan ji yod ga ler thag gcad rgyu+o yin brjod 'dug pas blo 'tshab ngang thabs shes med par sdod dgos byung nga /spyi lo 1978 lo 'gor lha sa nas las mi phyir log yong mi zhig la bkra shis dbang mo ar las 'bo sa'i ru khag drug pa'i snasku khrid kyis bkra zhis dbang mor mi gzhan bza' tshang med pas do bdag gi re bar khyed tsho'i las mi rig 'dzin dang / gnyen sgrig bya rgyu phan tshun 'dod mos yod cilugs la de ga'i las khungs kyis chog mchan gnang 'thus mchis na ngo sprod

gcen po'i nad dang / ltes dbang gi bza' zla/ 133cig gnang thabs yod pa zhu/ zhes 'khod pa'i thel sbyar yi ge zhig bskur ba/ rang nyid kyis do dam las byed gtso bo lha sa ba bud med tshes gsum lha mor ngo sprod bstan te chog mchan dang gnyen sgrig lag khyer zhu bar lha sar nyin shas dgongs 'khrol zhus pas las khungs 'go khrid dang bo sa bsdur thag gakhyodad byas chog ces bshad/ dpyid 'debs grub mtshams gnyen sgrig chog mchan ngo sprod zhig dang / gnyen sgrig ched lha sar bskyod chog pa'i ngo sprod bcas sprad/ btson khang dang po'i rlangs 'khor zhig nang lha sar 'byor dus bu lo gsum son nas phar tshur 'gro thub pa ma zad/ phran gyis pang du blangs te bu pa pha ngo shes kyi 'dug gam/ nga bu rang gi pha yin zhes brjod skabs mig gis phran la yun tsam zhib mo ra bltas te 'khris su bsdad pa phran gyis dkar yol nang gi ja sprad pa sa phran bu zhig btung / de nas btson khang gnyis pa nas bskur ba'i ngo sprod lha sa grong lhan gnyis pa'i 'go khrid la bstan nas/'di ga grong lhan nas bkra shis dbang mor ngo sprod chog mchan gnang mo gas zhus don bzhin grong lhan nas sprad byung bas/ ngo sprod gnyis ka khyer nas gnyen sgrig lag khyer sprod mkhan gyi las khungs su ngo shes zhig mngags pas lag khyer thob/ rang nyid bsgyur bkod kyi mi sna yin stabs spo bo spra rmog tu ma phyin par thabs med stabs bkra shis dbang mo grong lhan dang ar las ru khag nas zla drug dgongs pa nus na/sa spo yul du nga tsho gsum mnyam du

134 zhing pa'i dran tho/bskyod cing / bzung sna las mi ru khag gis sdod khang chung ngu zhig zur du sprad de nga tsho gsum mnyam du lo gcig min tsam sdod ring blta rtog gang legs byas/spyi lo 1979 lor bod kyi chab srid btson pa tshe btson sogs nga dgu'i 'brel yod btson pa tshang ma btson khang nas glod pa dang / las mi sogs chab srid kyi zhwa mo g.yogs pa rnams phud de rang nyid kyi nyes zhwa yang phud nas zla phogs rgya sgor zhe drug dang sgor zur kha shas sprad kyang /bza' zla them tho lha sa nas bsgyur na las ka sprad rgyu dang gla phogs spar te las bzo ngo mar bsgyur chog ces spo bor sdod dgos tshul rim pas brjod pa / phran gyis kha gsal lan 'debs ma byas par bsam blo gtang gi yin tshul brjod nas dpyid 'debs tshar 'phral bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo dgongs dus zla ba drug las med pas dgongs pa bskyar zhu byed par snyad de dgongs pa zhus te lha sar bskyod cing / lha sar grong mi u yon lhan khang dang 'brel ba byas nas mnyam las zhig nang 'phrul chas bzo bsnyu sa sdudags kyi las ka zhig sprad gnang dang 'di nas ngos sbyor gyis btson khang ang gnyis pa nas rtsa dathodangs yong thabs gnang rogs/ zhes re ba zhus pa bzhin grong mi ༷/ yon lhan khang la 'phrul chas bzo bcos shes pa'i mi dgos gal yod pas mnyam sdeb gsum nas gang du sdod 'dam ga sprad pa dang / mnyam

gcen po'i nad dang / lhes dbang gi bza' zla/ 135las kyi mi thub bstan ye shes la ngos sbyor bskur nas ched gtong byas kyang thub bstan ye shes kong po bar las ma phyin stabs lha sar ngal sgyur las khungs la mnyam las kyi 'go khrid dang / phran phyin nas rtsa dgongs yong ba'i bka' khyab gnang rogs zhes zhus pas ngal sgyur las khungs nas thodas bsdur bya chog ces brjod/phran mnyam las der las ka byed skabs nyin gcig btson khang gnyis pa'i rgya las lha sa ba bud med tshes gsum lha mo dang / chos sgron gnyis yong nas khyod rang mar las khungs su log rtsis bya yi med dam/ ngos gnyis kyang log 'gro yi yin mnyam du 'aspo zer byung ba/ phran gyis rtsa dgongs yong ba'i snyan zhu ngos sbyor sogs las khungs la thad kar rim 'bul dang /ngal bsgyur las khungs la yang zhus pa bka' 'khrol yong re byas nas bsdad yod/ da lta'i khyed kyis kyang dgongs bzhed gnang rogs zhes re 'dun bton yang ston las byed nye bas thengs gcig mar phyin nas ston las tshar ba dang bza' 'byu them tho sogs bsgrur nas thag gcod gtsang ma yong ba bya na legs zhes bshad pas/ nga tsho mnyam du ngal sgyur las khungs la phyin nas 'gro ma dgos pa'i gnas lugs zhu skabs chab srid u yon zhes pa des kyang ston las tshar mtshams dgongs pa rtsa 'khrol nga tshos kyang sku nga thabs byas chog thengs cig mar rgyugs zhes bshad pas yang bskyar lpo yul du 'gro

13snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/rgyu'i thag gcod kyis bza' zla bkra shis dbang mor ngal sgyur las khungs la zhabs bskul zhu dathodas zhes 'gro rgyu'i grabs byed skabs/ bu yis phran la 'thams te nga/ pha dang mnyam du 'gro yi yin zhes yud tsam yang kha bral gyi mi 'dug pas bu khrid de spo bor phyin/spo bo spra sna ga tu 'go khrid rim par kha sngon zhus pa bzhin phran pha ma rgan gog gso skyong 'gan khel yod lugs dngos don la brten ston las grub 'phral/ rtsa dgongs skyabs 'jug yong ba zhes zhus kyang nga chos gros mol byas chog ces pa las dgongs pa sprad 'dod mi byed pa ma zad/ ston las tshar mtshams dgongs pa zhu skabs bsam shes do khur ma byas par snang med nyin 'gyangs zhag phud bdag med du skyur bar/ phran gyis rang skyong ljongs khrims khang la zhu yig gcig bris te zur 'dzar dang bcas mi brgyud bza' zla bkra shis dbang mor mtho rim khrims khang la 'bul rogs zhes dang / gzhis rtse sa khul 'bring rim khrims khang la zhu yig thengs gnyis bcas sbrags thog brgyud bskur ba'i nang don/ ngos la spon chad khrims gcod lag 'khyer nges gtan med pas lo rgyus dngaganag nyes sogs la bskyar zhib gnang rogs zhes dang / rang skyong ljongs mtho rim mi mang khrims khang la 'bul byed zhu yig don ni phran da cha nang mi bza' zla sogs kyi dngos yod dka' ngal gyis rtsa dgongs yong ba'i ngo sprod sogs/ 'brel yod sa khul

gcen po'i nad dang / ltes dbang si bza' zla/ 1sku7nas rim nga ra phul ba ngal bsgyur las khungs kyis kyang gsal por mkhyen te ston las tshar mtshams dgongs 'khrol codang ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad kyang /da cha dgongs 'khrol thag gcod mi byed pas mtho rim khrims khang gis rtsa khrims gzhir bzung thag gcod yong ba'i skya bas 'jug gnang rogs zhes bkod yod/ gong gsal khrims khang nas thag chodad ma byung na spo bo'i btson pa'i las khungs las byed kyis dbo ngas pa mi sprod pa gtan khel bas sa zhing rmo 'debs tshar rjes las kar ma phyin par/ skabs re las mi'i ma byan grwa pa bgres song gnyis la me shing gshog rogs byas te nyi ma phud kyang las kar mi 'thod ba'i rgyu mtshan dri mkhan ma byung / skabs der btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab lnga rgyal sa lha sa dang spo yul rgyud du phebs te nga tsho'i las mi re zung la mjal 'phrad kyang byung 'dug pa/ nga tshor mtshon na mi lo nyi shu lha ga gi gnas tshul bzang cadas thos pa zhig yin pas dga' spro'i spu long rab tu g.yo zhing bsam bzhin mig chu dbang med 'chor/ gus kyi slo nye byang gnam mtsho kha pa ba yan nor bsam 'khor zhag la phyin nas dzaXr lam lha sar sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan mjal 'dug pa dang nor bsam gyis srung ma dmar nag gnyis kyi 'phrin bskul dang / ma smad bamo da nams/bden gsol spyodan lam bcas ngo bshus bris ma zhig 'khyer 'dug pas phran

138 zhing pa'i dran tho/nas gang thub bris te las mi blo nye ba nang khul la bkrams pa dang / kha shas shig las mi sde dge ba skar ma tshul khrims kyis sde dge phyogs su'ang bskur/phran gyis las ka ma byas par sdod pa las dgongs pa 'ong ba'i re ba 'don gyi med kyang nyin gcig phran gro mo ba bu tshe ring mnyam nyal khang du gleng mol byed bzhin pa'i skabs/ rgya las rdo rje chung ba dang slob ston pa yang gnyis yong nas phran la bsam blo ga re gtong gi sku da dam zhes brjod pa/ phran gyis kha sngon rim zhus ltar rtsa dgongs zhu rgyu las gzhan ci yang med bshad pas/ kho pa gnyis kyis khyed rang nga tshos gso skyong byas pa'i mi yin pas dgongs 'khrol yong gi ma red ces bshad byung / phran nas de 'dra ma gsung / gso skyong gnang zhes pa mi ngo rang nyid gsar brjer zhugs nas las ka dang lag rtsal sogs slob sbyong gnang ba yin na gso skyong zhes brjod kyi red/ nga ni de las ldog ste de sngon sgyur bkod ched 'dod rung ma 'dod rung las gang zhig bskul yang dang len ma zhus thabs med las rang mos thog gso skyong gnang ba rtsa ba nas min/ da cha tang gi srid jus yang dag la brten/ gus tsho yang zhwa mo phud nas spyi 'bangs kyi gras su tshud skabs pha ma rgan rgon dang / bza' zla bu phrug gi dngos yod dka' ngal 'gan 'khur ma blang na rtsa khrims dang 'gal gyi 'dug brjod pas/ slob ston pa yang yar langs nas rkang 'khrab lag brdab kyis khyed rang rtsa khrims la slob sbyong yag

gcen po 'i nad dang / rme sa dbang gi bza' zla/ 139po byed dgos/ las gnas nas kha bral te khyim tshang gi dka' ngal 'gan 'khur byed dgos zhes pa rtsa khrims la gsal med cing khyim la dka' ngal yod na dngul phran bu bskur na 'grig gi red/ ces bshad byung bas phran gyis khyed rang slob ston pa zhig yin pas rnam 'gyur drag po ma gnang / ngas kyang rtsa khrims 'go nas mjug bar bltas kyang khyim tshang gi rgan khog dang bu phrug sogs la dka' ngal yod na dngul phran bu bskur na 'grig zer ba ma mthong / dngos don nga'i dka' ngal rim zhus la 'brel yod sa gnas khag nas ngo sprod dang ngal sgyur las khungs nas kyang zhal bzhes ngos sbyor gnang bar brtsi med 'di ltar gnang na/ da cha rim pa gong ma mtho rim khrims khang la snyan zhu 'bul rgyu dang / de nas kyang thag gcod ma gnang na rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blon la snyan zhu 'bul gyi yin/ gal te srid blon gyis phran btson khang gnyis pa'i khongs nas kha bral mi chog pa'i bka' phebs na de nyin nas ngas tshig gcig zhus mi yong / de bar zhu gtug bya rgyu yin brjod skabs las mi tshang ma las mtshams bzhag nas log yong gi 'dug pa kho pa gnyis kyis bshad rgyu ma mang zhes phyir log go/de lta'i mur nyin ma 'khyol thabs med pas sang nyin btson khang ang gnyis pa'i 'go khrid gtso bdag lha sa ba phun tshog rdo rje'i mdun phyin te phran gyis sngon nas rim zhus ltar yang / 'dang nub slob lton pa yang gis

140 zhing pa'i dran tho/dgongs 'khrol rtsa ba nas yong gi ma red sogs gsungs byung bas da cha khyed rang sar gnas lugs zhu bar yong ba yin brjod pas / phun tshogs sna rjes 'dang nub slob ston pa yang nga'i mdun slebs byung / khyod kyis rgyag res zhe drag brgyab byung zer/ 'on kyang ngas slob ston pa yang la rig 'dzin khyim tshang gi dka' ngal sogs dngos yod la brten dgongs 'khrol dgos kyi red/ces bshad yod/ gnas tshul chen po yod na rim pa gong mar snyan seng zhu/sa chog kyang khyod rang la gnas tshul che ba gang yang med par rtsa dgongs zhu rgyu'i ched snyan seng zhu dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med/ ngas mkhyodags myur thag gcad chog pas 'go khrid la rgyag res ma brgyag zer byung / phran gyis bza' zla'i gzugs gzhi bde min thog snying nad yod pas/ pha bu gnyis 'dir lus yod stabs snying nad tshabs che ru 'gro dogs sems tshabs che bas mgyogs myu/ra dgongs 'khrol yong rgyur 'gyur med thugs rjes gzigs zhus nas phyir log phyin/dgongs 'khrol 'ong ba'i re sgug ngang nyin nyi shu 'das kyang ya lan tshig gcig thos rgyu med pas phran gyis 'go khrid gtso bdag phun tshogs the rje dang / ru chen gyi 'go gtso slob ston pa yang gnyis la rim pas rtsa dgongs zhus par sngon ma'i rnam 'gyur ltar ma yin par 'jam gro'i thog 'drud 'then 'khor lo gtong mi gzhan rnams lag rtsal rang skya 'pher ba 'byung thabs byed

gcen po'i nad dang / lhes dbang ge bza' zla/ 141dgos zhes brjod kyi 'dug pas/ phran gyis rang nyid kyis gang shes gzhan la de snga nas lag rtsal sbas skung med par bslabs te mi kha shas rang skya 'pher bzhin pa red/ de lhag nga mi tshe gcig bsdad na'ang bslab rgyu gang yang med/ ces bshad kyang kho pa chongs rnam 'gyur 'jam pos nar 'gyangs kho na gtong rtsis byed kyang stabs legs pa zhig la nyin gcig gzhis rtse 'bring rim mi dmangs khrims khang nas sbrags zam brgyud yi ge thel 'byar zhig phran la thad kar btang 'dug pas/ 'brel yod kyis yi ge ma sprad pa dang kha sngog pa sogs bya tshe rnyog dra 'ong dogs phran la sprad pa dang chabs cig khyedad rang rtsa dgongs zhu dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan khyim gyi dka' ngal sogs kha gsal 'khod pa'i zhu yig bris nas 'khyer shogre/ brjod / de ni kho pa tshos phran dgongs pa ma sprad gong gzhis rtse nas yar bskong na kho pa tsho ngo tsha kha skyengs 'ong dogs dgongs 'khrol gtong khul gyis spyi lo 1980 zla 4 par dgongs 'kho la gyi lag khyer dang / bza' 'byu'i lag khyer/ zla ba gcig gi za 'bru'i dod dang lam gron rgya sgor brgya dang lnga bcu sprad/ phran la sprad pa'i za 'bru'i dod dang lam gron ha cang nyung ngu yin zhing sngar lo sprad pa'i ngal rtsol gyon chas stod gos lheb gyon dang ko lham spu yod cha gcig yod pa bzhag dgos zhes bshad byung bas phran gyis lo mang ring 'phrul 'aho/ ra btang / mi tshang ma'i 'char gzhi las 'gal ba'i khyodan chas blangs yod na

142 zhing pa'i dran tho/gsungs rogs/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang zan dang tshe g.yog kyang log khar gyon chas bshus pa sku thos med/ rang gi thob thang gyon chas yar 'bul mi thub ces ma sprad/ skabs der rtsa dgongs 'gro mi kha shas yod pa nas smar khams phur pa tshe ring stobs rgyal yang yod pa tshe ring stobs rgyal lha sar bsdad de dgongs 'khrol lag 'khyer dang / bza' 'bru'i lag 'khyer sogs len par slebs pa'i bza' zla ngag dbang sgrol mar tshe ring stobs rgyal gyi lam gron rgya sgor brgya dang lnga bcu nas stod gos lheb gyon dang lham rin dod rgya sgor dgu bcu tsam gcog bya byas so/phran tsho rtsa dgongs zhu mi rnams lag 'khyer sogs bzo bar nyin shas 'gor ba'i skabs lha sa nas las mi blo bzang mgon po'i mdun snga 'dzar bu mo chos sgron gyis a ma na ste sman khang du yod pa mgyogs po yong thabs byed dgos zhes lan bskur 'dug pa/ phran log skabs bza' zla ngo 'phrad yong min nges pa med pa ni 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin kho nar song bya thabs ci sku da kyang bu dang ma gnyis ngo thug tsam ma byung na blo pham che bsams te spo yul nas nying khri dang / kong po gsum mdo babs tshugs/ rbab la bcas brgyud lha sar nyin gung yol tsam zhig la 'dre ra zhing /phran gyi sgal par nyal 'jo dang lto phad sogs dang bu'i sgal par chu dam zhig bskur te nged gnyis dngangs 'tshab kyis zhi sde dgon sasham bza' zla'i sdod

gcen po'i nad dang / lhes dbang gi bza' zla/ 143khang gi sgo ra 'dzul skabs gangs sman spel dmag drung gi sku zla bsod dpal mjal ba/ khong nas dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis 'tshams 'dri gnang / bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo kha sang sman khang nas khyim du spos te rim pas drag skyed byung ba dang de nyin nas nga tsho bza' mi bu phrug gsum ming don mtshungs pa'i khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba skyel 'go tshugs/ding ri ba a jo ngag dbang yang nyin shas sngon 'khor zhag la phebs zhor bkra shis dbang mo la gzigs par phebasari'adug pa bcas/ las mi ru khag nang mi lo bcu drug tsam sdod ring gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus tsam las zhib par 'god nus ma mchis pas/ don gnyer can rnams kyis de khul gyi gnas stangs zhib par mkhyen 'dod na deng skabs bzhugs sgar du yod pa ding ri a jo ngag dbang dang / tsha rong tshe brtan rnam rgyal/ phur pa tshe ring stobs rgyal/ a pho badz+wa/ sbi ri sa skya dgon gyi mkhan po kun dga' dbang phyug bcas la bka' dri gnang na gsal rtog thub nges dang / da dung khong rnams kyis phran gyi lta ba dang / langs phyogs/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs/ ga/tam brjod/ rnam 'gyur mthun lam sogs rgyun gshis kun spyod ji 'dra yod mkhyen nges bcas btson khang dang chab srid kyi zhwa yod sgyur bokod ra bar mi lo nyer gcig bkol spyod drag tu myangs pa'i lo rgyus rdzogs sa

144 zhing pa'i dran tho/le tshan bcu pa/rgyal sa lha sar khyim gzhis bcas te/rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/spyi lo 1980 zla 4 par btson khang gi khor yug las thar nas lha sar gnas bcas shing bod mi gzhan dang spyi mtshungs 'tsho ba skyel 'go tshugs te/ rang rgyal dang mi rigs bcas spyi don la sman thabs bya dgos rgyun mar sems la bcangs bzhin gnas na/ra/spyi lo 1980 zla 7 par btsan byol nge da gzhung gi sku tshab gzhon nu lnga bod du gzigs slor phebs rgyu thugs gtan khel te lha sar phebs kyi yod skor thos 'phral rang nyid kyis shes rtogs dang / bod mi'i gnas stangs/ bsam 'dun/ phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i rang rigs la lhag bsam gyi zhen bskul/ lhag par 7gong sa mchog gi sku bcar ba rnams kyis

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 145sku sdir 'gan srung skad gcig lhod med gnang ba'i re zhu sogs dang /gzhon nu sku tshab lnga po sa thag ring nas bod nang phebs par phran gyis gzhis lus bod mi'i tshab zhus nas/ khong rnams la ches bla na med pa'i mdza' brtse'i 'tshams 'dri dang dga' bsu zhu rgyu sogs 'khod pa'i le tshan gsum 'khod kyi yig cha zhig bris te 'bul rgyur gra bsgrigs/ lo de'i spyi zla 7 zla mjug gi nyin gcig khong rnams bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar phebs te g.yu thog zam pa dang thag nye'i sne len khang ang dang po zhes par bzhugs yod par/phran gyis nyin de'i dgong dro'i chu tshod bdun pa tsam la bskyod skabs sne len khang gi rgyab ngos thog rtseg gnyis can gyi star pa'i nye 'gram sgo ra zhig tu mi 'ga' skug 'dug rgya las bod rigs kha shas kyis de ring khyed tsho rang khyim du log thegs/ sang gnangs ga ler mjal chog gi red ces brjod nas mi gtong / yud tsam nas bu mo zhig sgo zhig nang 'dzul bas de ma thag phran yang rjes su phyin pas khang pa zhig nang pho gzhon gzugs ring zhing rid po bod chas bzhes pa zhig gi mdun bu mo de skad cha shod kyin mchi ma gtong / phran gyis pho gzhon der khyed bod gzhung gi sku tshab lnga'i khongs yin nam zhes zhus pas yin gsungs/ yig cha bton te phul nas thugs zhib gnang rogs zhes dang / dus yun ji tsam bzhugs/ ma/tshan la ci zhu bcas dris pas/ ming la phun tshogs dbang rgyal zer ba dang bdun gcig

14snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/tsam sdod kyi yin gsungs byung ba/ phran gyis rim pas bcar gyi yin zhus te yi ge phul thub par dga' spro dang bcas phyir thon/skabs der rgya gzhung gis a ma rang btsan tshe ring lha mo btson du bcug pa'i gnas tshul zhu thub pa byed dgos snyam ste sang chodags nam gsal tsam la khong rnams bzhugs yul du phyin/ rgya las shig sgo 'gram sgrog ce re steng tshig tho 'god deb cig bzhag ste rkub stegs thog bsdad 'dug pas/phran la kho nga chod nas su ngo shes min dang su 'cho la mkhan yin nam zhes dris byung ba/ phran gyis khong tsho su gcig ngo shes kyi med kyang sngon ma spun mched cig phyi rgyal la phyin nas da lta gar yod shes kyi med pas bka' 'dri zhu bar gtong rogs gnang zer skabs/ sa gnas gang nas yin min dang ming bcas bkod pa bo nga gseb cig nas yin tshul dang ming rdzun zhig bshad pas yar btang byung ba khong rnams thog sa gnyis pa'i nyal khang chung ngu rer bzhugs 'dug pa/ thog mar pad+ma rgyal po mjal byung ba phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi mdun bcar mkhan yin zhus pas khong gis phun tshogs dbang rgyal sbron gnang ste khyed rang gsung rgyu ci yod kyang phun tshogs dbang rgyal la gsungs chog ces gsungs/ de nas phun dbang gi gzim khang du bcar skabs bar tsho'i lcam chung sogs lha sa'i mtho rim bud med kha shas shig gis gsol ja bzhes stob phul te bzhugs 'dug pa phran bu'i yi ma rang ba

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i zho skabs dang du blangs/ 147zhig byung / phran gyis phun dbang la zhus don da res khyed rnams 'dir phebs nas don phan ldan pa zhig dgongs bzhes gnang rogs/ rang btsan a ma tshe ring lha mo btson du bcug don ni bod rang btsan yin zhes bshad pa'i gnad don gyi yin pas khyed rnams kyis 'di'i sprodag nus pa thon pa zhig ma gnang na/ phyis 'byung bod mi mang gi 'thab sems la skyodan yong gi red ces sogs dang / phran gyis khyed rnams la gse la ja bzhes stob 'bul dbo sa kyang rang nyid ni btson pa gu yangs btang ba'i mi yin pas cha rkyen sogs med ces sogs zhus/ phun dbang gis a ma tshe ring lha mo'i skor nga tsho pe cing nas yong khar thos byung ba deng skabs rang phyogs nas don tshan gsum bton te rgya gzhung dang smeng mol byed kyi yod tshul gsungs/ khong la 7gong sa mchog gi sku dpar dang byin rten phran bu gnang rgyu e yod zhus don sku par med kyang byin rlabs phran bu re der yod tshang mar gnang / de rjes gnas tshul rnams rim pas snyan seng zhu dgos bsams kyang phran lha sar 'byor nas zla ba gsum tsam las phyin med stabs lha sa'i gnas tshul de tsam shes rtogs mi thub cing cha rkyen sogs kyang zhan tsam la brten/ khe nga rnams dga' ldan se'u thang la phebs nyin yang bskyod ma thub/ stabs ma legs par khong rnams glo bur rgya gzhung gis phyir 'bud byas te snga dro thon skabs rgya mis nga tsho phyir phud byas byung zhes/ skad 'bod gnang ba lha sa'i

148 zhing pa'i dran tho/mang tshogs re zung nas mthong thos byung slor gnas tshul khyab pa blo pham ci che'i gnas su gyur/de rjes rje btsun pad+ma dang lha mgon rin po che sogs lha sar gzigs lha ra la phebs skabs nyin gung tsam zhig la phran khong rnams bzhugs yul snye len khang ang dang por/ snang med zol gyis 'dzul nas gar bzhugs rtsad gcod zhu skabs rje btsun pad+ma bzhugs med kyang lha mgon rin po che bzhugs 'dug pas/ phran gyis 7gong sa mchog gi sku phywa'i skor bsam tshul phran bu zhus pa dang / gus kyis kyang 7gong sa mchodag sku tshe zhabs pad yun gnas yong ba'i smon 'dun rtse gcig zhu lugs rgyud zhu mdzad gnang dang / khyed rnams kyis gzigs skor grong khyer gyi rnam pa tsam ma yin par gtso bo rgya che'i zhing 'brog sa khul mi mang gi gnas stangs la thugs zhib zab nan mdzad dbo sa zhes zhus pas/ khong gis de don zhal bzhes dang phyi rgyal nas rang rigs phebs mi mang che ba yag po sku da kyang kha shas nyams myong 'dang min la brten/ skyon 'ong nyen che bas khyed rang rjes su rang rigs phyi rgyal nas sku nga mi tshang mar kha gsang po ma byed ces bka' slob gnang /de nas dga' g.yu sgron gyi bu blo bzang don grub dang / rig 'dzin chos sgron gnyis kyi khyim du rje btsun pad+ma mchog mjal 'phrad zhus thog 7gong sa mchog sku tshe zhabs pad —brtan pa'i gsol 'debs kyi yig chung zhig phul

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 149ba las/ der mi 'ga' shas kyis bka' mol zhus nas zang zing ngang gnas 'dug pa gnas tshul gzhan ci yang zhu ma thub/ gong du phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / rje btsun pad+ma mchog la phul ba'i phran gyi lag bris yi ge da lta 'di ga bod gzhung yig tshags nang yod nges red snyam/spyi lo 1982 lor 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog rgya dmar gyis btson 'jug zhus pa nas dbus gtsang du phebs thengs dang po yin pa dang / rgyal sa lha sar phyogs mtha'i bod mi kun 'dus te 7kun gzigs mchog gi zhal mjal gsung thos kyi skal bzang dga' ston la mi 'bor ha cang che bas 'tshang khas mi gcig brdzis nas 'chi skyon byung ba sogs/ dad gus brtsi bskur tshad med zhus par rgya dmar pe cing gzhung gi tshod bgam las ldog te hang sang dgos pa zhig byung / bod mi ma nga gis de lta'i dad gus brtsi bkur zhu bar rgya dmar gzhung gi 'dod bab med la dbus gtsang gnyis bar sngon 'gal ba ji yod 'khyog bshad dang sbrags rgyun nas dril bsgrags dang / lhag par skabs der dril bsgrags shugs che byed pa'i skabs yin yang 7kun gzigs rin po che gzigs zhib gang du phebs pa'i tshan pa dang mi mang mnyam sdeb khag tu lha sa'i ser skya mi mang tshos dad gus spro gsum ngang phebs sgrig sogs zab rgyas zhus/ phran chorware mnyam sdeb la phebs khar rang nyid kyis kyang phebs sgrig nyin mtshan sbrel te zhus nas

150 zhing pa'i dran tho/gzigs zhib la zhabs sor bkod nas chu tshod gnyis tsam ring rdzod bzhugs thog mang tshogs la bka' slob dang mjal kha sogs gnang ste bskal pa bzang po byung / da dung 7gong sa mchog kyang zhal mjal gsung thos ’kal bzang gi thod skabs shig 'thob na ci ma rung snyam pa dang bar skabs 7gong sa mchodag nas spyi lo 1985 lor bod du zhabs sor bkod gnang mdzad 'char bka' slob yongs khyab bstsal bar re ba chen po byung yang / rgya dmar gyi bya byed la yid rton mi rung bar g.yo sgyu ngan spyodad kyis spyi lo 1983 nas nyes med bod mi spyi dang lhag par gdan sa khag gi dge 'dun pa 'ju bzung btson 'jug byas dang byed bzhin pa sogs rgya dmar la blo khel thabs med par brten/ gus 'bangs gzhis lus rnams kyis gnas skabs bod du chibs sgyur gnang thal med pa sogs gsol 'debs zhus/rgya dmar gyis spyi lo 1985 lor bod rang skyong ljongs btsugs nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dus dran gyi byed sgo spel ba dang / 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin ngo che lha sar rgya dmar gyi byed sgo'i thog zhabs sor 'khod nas rgya phyogs kyi 'dod slor bstun pa'i bka' slob phyi tshul nas de ltar gnang dgos byung ba las nang bstan 'gro'i bde thabs thugs 'khur bla med mdzad pa phyis su ra 'phrod kyang / skabs der mi 'gas nang gi de nyid ma stodags par phyi yi mthong lnga sa kho nas 7paṇa chen rin po cher mtshan smad phran

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 151bu zhus pa rang nyid kyis kyang srin 'bu me khyer nyi zlar 'gran sems ltar yi ma rangs po'i bsam tshul sna tshogs skyes pa snying dbus nas mthol zhing 'chags sa/skabs der 7kun gzigs mchodag la mtshan smad phran bu zhu mkhan byung ba ni bod mi rigs dang bstan pa chab srid bcas pa'i la rgya'i lhag bsam kun slong ha cang rno ngar che ba'i rang shugs kyi rnam 'gyur thon pa las/rgya dmar gyis brjod tshul ltar/ dbus gtsang 'gal zla'i zhe 'khon rtsa ba nas ma yin par rjes su dgongs pa zhi dbyings thim pa nas da skabs bar gyi gnas tshul nas gsal sna gas yod pa slad kha ba ri pa'i gzhon skyes rnams kyis thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ spyi lo 1987 lo 'char ma thag rang nyid kyis yun ring re smon ltar 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i zhal dkyil mjal rgyu dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi thos te thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i dbang bzhi sogs dngos su 'thob rgyur rtse gcig dmigs nas rang nyid dang / bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo/ bu blo bzang dbang phyug bcas rgya gar 'phags yul du sku nga rgyur cha rkyen sogs gang cir zhan rung sems thag bcad de rgya dmar gzhung gi lam yig lag 'khyer sogs/ thabs shes ci yong gis lha sa nas bod zla 11 tshes shar la thon te bal yul brgyud rgya gar rdo rje gdan du bod

15da zhing pa'i dran tho/zla 11 tshes 20 tsam la slebs shing / nyin shas rjes gsar 'byor bar mjal kha bstsal gnang gis blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi gsung chos dang 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin snang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang bcas legs par ba355 ba'i 'o/ mang smon lam btab pa'i don 'bras mngon gyur byung ba de ni sngon bsags kyi 'bras bzang cung zad cig yod pa'i mthu las byung ba yin nges dang / rnyed dka'i go skabs bzang po der tshang mas 7gong sa mchog sku tshe zhabs pad brtan cing bzhed don lhan gyi 'grub ched brtan bzhugs star 'bul zhu thub na/ ci ma rung snyam pa'i kun slong shugs drag yod skor lha sa bzhi sde dgon gyi grwa blo ldan bstan dar nga gnyis 'phros mol byung / nged gnyis kyis sku/ga zhabs drung dang bka' mol gyis phran gsum brtan bzhugs 'degs 'bul zhu rgyur blo mos byung rjes chodas zhu ba gzhan la'ang bka' 'dri zhu skabs tshang mas de don blo mos rtse gcig byed/phran gsum gyis skabs de'i bde srung drung che blo bzang tshul khrims kyi drung bcar nas sku sger yig tshang rgyud snyan seng sgron 'bul skyabs 'jug zhus pa bzhin sang nyin nyin gung chu tshod gnyis pa tsam la sku sger yig tshang la snyan seng zhu bar ro/ga gsungs/ phran gsum yar bcar skabs gam pa'i jo lags dang bu rig 'dzin bcas kyang nga tsho dang chabs cig snyan seng zhu

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rled dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 153bar phebs 'dug par/ nged tsho drug sku sber sku ngo byams tshul sku mdun bcar skabs sku ngo mchog gis khyed tsho ga re'i don yin nam gsungs pa lam seng lan phul mkhan byung ma song bas/ phran gyis nga tsho 'dir sku bcar zhu don ni bod mi tshang mas rgyun du spos rkang gcig dang mchod me kong gcig 'bul skabs kyang 7gong sa chen po sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i smon 'dun kho na zhu bzhin pa ltar/ da res 'dir 'byor bod mi chos zhu ba gzhis byes tshang ma'i brtan bzhugs star 'bul thub pa'i re 'dun snyan seng zhu rgyu yin/zhes zhu skabs mdzad rim dus tshod gtan khel bas 'di lo dus tshod zur du yong thabs med kyang kru'u zhi ta chodas tshogs nas brtan bzhugs 'bul rgyu'i snyan seng sngon 'tshud nas zhus don zhal bzhes dus tshod gtan khel bar brten/ de dang chabs cig 'bul na zhes bka' phebs pas gus tshos 'di ltar zhu rgyu zhes zhus/ yang sku ngo byams tshul gyis byes khongs rnams skad dang rgyus mnga' yod pas gra sgrig las ka mang tsam dang / cha rkyen gang 'byor gyi 'grig 'thus las ma 'grub bzhin dka' ngal chen po bsten mi dgos la zhal 'debs dad ldan rnams kyis gang phul las tshad gzhi rma byed/ bod mi gzhis byes tshang ma'i yin bakhyodad pa bzhin tshang mas bo thos yong ba'i khyab bsgrags byed dgos / zhes gsungs/7gong sa mchog brtan bzhugs kyi cho gas phebs skabs gdan

154 zhing pa'i dran sgo/zhu'i spos sne dang / maṇa ḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhu mi chol kha gsum gyi mi drug yod khongs rang nyid dbus gtsang ཿ5la kha'i mthus tshab tu gdan zhu'i spos sner bcar thog thog ma'i khri 'khod maṇa ḍal rten gsum dge bshes blo bzang chos dbyings dang gus gnyis kyis 'degs 'bul zhus pa 7gong sa mchog gis rang gang gi kho ngas yin nam zhes bka' phebs byung ba/ gus pa dbus gtsang khongs yin zhus/ 7gong sa mchog gi khri 'phang mngon mtho'i khor yug tu bla sprul mkhan po dge bshes rnams bzhugs pa'i gral star du nga tsho chol kha gsum gyi mi mthus rnams gdan la 'kho da bcug gnang sgyu ga rim gyis gasku la ja/ bzhes 'bras/ tshogs 'khor sogs zhu bzhin par maṇa ḍal gsum pa gtang rag gi maṇa ḍal 'bul ba dang chabs cig nged drug la 7gong sa mchog gi sbyin phyag phyag dbang dang / mjal mdud/ mjal dar nang mdzod re bstsal/ de nas spos sne dang bcas pho brang du zhabs sor bde bar 'khod pa bcas bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la longs su spyod pa'i bskal bzang gi dga' lton de lta bu/ sngon chad rang gi bsam yul du yang 'khor ma myong ba dngos su lhun gyis grub pa ni 'di phyi'i legs tshogs mngon par masgo bar snang / skabs der zhal 'debs dngul 'bor che tsam byung ba 'bul ba dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor bsnyen bkur sku 'gyed/ tshogs rdzas rgyas par phul te brtan bzhugs grub

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 155rjes/ dgong dro mchod rten chen mo'i drung stong mchod rgyas pa 'bul bshams dang 'dus mang la yang bskyar sku 'gyed/ ngan slong ba rnams la sbyin pa bcas rgya cher btang / nyin shas rjes 7gong sa mchog rdor gdan du 'tshogs rgyu 'i rgyal spyi'i btsun ma'i tshogs mgon du zhabs sor 'khod rgyur bsdad 'dod che yang rogs pa rnams kyis brel 'tshub byed par brten/ war ṇa dang rtswa mchog grong / mnyan yodad bcas su gnas mjal bar bskyod cing /spyi lo 1987 zla 2 zla mjug rda sar 'byedar nas rgya gar gyi khang pa zhig ba/nas g.yar byas/ bod lo'i dgung gsar rjes dpyid chos chen mor 7gong sa mchog gis lam rim chen mo'i gsung chodas dang / rta mgrin yang gsang / gsang sgrub kyi bka' dbang bcing5 ba bcas cha tshang ba masbyadas pa dang / pho brang du mi grangs lnga bcu skor la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bstsal thob byung / dpyid chos grub mtsham bod nas gsar 'byedar ba chodas 7gong sa mchog sku tshe srid mthar brtan ched sku sger yig tshang la brtan bzhugs star 'bul chog pa'i snyan seng zhus pa bka' bzhes thob ste/ las sbrel gzhan dang lhan du phran gyis 'go snyan seng zhu rgyu nas mjug rtsis mjug ma bsdus bar 'khur rkang len zhus/brtan bzhugs legs grub byung rjes hin sgor stong phrag kha shas lhag pa tshwa zur zhang blo bzang yon tan dang gus gnyis kyis bzhugs sgar

15snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/du yod pa'i rgyud grwa stod smad dang / gdan sa'i zhabs brtan khang rnams la cha bgos kyis phul zhing skabs der tshwa zur zhang slo yon de nyid dang ngo shes 'brel ba thog ma byung / de rjes bzhugs sgar du skyabs rje 'dan ma blo chos rin po che mchog nas lha mgon bcu gsum dang 'jigs byed them skas bco brgyad kyi byin snang bstsal thodab byung / spyi zla 3 pa'i tshes cha bzang zhing rgyal dang phur bu khel ba'i nyin zhig nged bza' zla bu phrug gsum la 7gong sa mchog gi gzim chung mjal kha bstsal ba dang / bu blo bzang dbang phyug rnam rgyal grwa tshang la dzadas zhugs bgyis pa'i sgrig zhugs gasdudal ja dang / mjal dar/ sku 'gyed sogs phul/dpyid chos sku gas zhu sgo cha tshang legs grub rjes spyi+o 'e/ 1997zla 4 par bzhugs sgar nas a khu ngag dbang dang / bu bla bzang dbang phyug gis skyel ma dang bcas bsdokyigs sgar nas kha bral dgos sems pham yid gdung ci che'i ngang thon dgos byung yang bya thabs dben/ sdi li sne len khang du nyin gsum sdod ring rgan blo bzang dar rgyas dang / mi zhig sngo sa sar phebs te rgan blo bzang dar rgyas kyis mi der khong gi mtshan la ngag dbang rgya mchod zer zhes ngo sprod gnang zhing khong sdi li nas bal yul bar gnam gru brgyud bod du gnyen 'phrad phebs rgyu dang / bal ༷༅la gyi bzhugs gnas kha byang phran la gnang nas bal yul nas nge da bar dang lha sar phyag

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 157rogs zhu 'os ci mchis zhu dgos zhes gsungs/ bal yul du 'byor rjes rgan ngag dbang rgya mchorware mdun bcar skabs khong gis rang gzhung nas 'grems spel zhus pa'i dril bsgrag/sa dang/ bka' rā ba/ lo rgyus sogs deb grangs bcu bzhi tsam bsnams yod pa gus pas lha sa bar khyer dgos pa dang lha sar rtsis blang gi yin gsungs pa de don khas len bgyis/ de bzhin gus rda sar sdod ring bde srung las khungs la thengs kha shas bcar skabs a pho dga' dgas 7gong sa mchog gi sku par brgya lha ra zhig dang bka' slob deb chung gang tsam bskur ba dang / rang nyid nas dpe tshong khang nas 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam dang / gzi'i kha ris can gyi bod kyi rgyal rabs/ mkhas dbang zhwa sgab pa'i srid don rgyal rabs stod cha dang /smad cha/ lha srung bsten phyogs deb/ 7gong sa mchog dbyin yul sogs phyi rgyal khag la chibs sgyur skabs bsgron pa'i gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin 'khor thag dang / bka' lho ba sgra 'dzin 'khor thag bod kyi rgyal dar chung ngu 'ga' shas 'khyer yod pa bcas rgan ngag dbang rgya mtshos bskur ba bcas khyon bsdoms ma mthar ki lor bco brgyad tsam gyi lji tshad ldan pa'i lto phad gcig byung /dril bsgrags sku/ chas phon che bas 'gram 'gag sgor dka' ngal 'phrad dogs bal yul don gcod las byed cha la'i jo lags su de rnams

158 zhing pa'i dran tho/'gram 'gag cad ma bo la bar 'khyol thabs skyabs 'jug zhus kyang don smin ma byung bas/ gzhan zhig la re ba zhu skabs ku li la 'khyer hrogs brjod na / deb che ba re tsam las cha tshang 'khyer mi thub cing deb re la bal sgor nyis brgya tsam sprad dgos brjod par phran la gron dngul nyung ngu las med stabs bya thabs ma mchis pas/ gyodan chas sna re gnyis la deb cha brgodas kyis sgril te rtsam snod sogs ras phad nang blugs shing kha yig 'dra min bris nas mi gzhan gyis bskur ba'i lag rtags yin khul baX sa shing / gnas chung phyag nas phran bu re do po'i nang blugs te rdog chas brgyab/skabs der rgya dmar gyis gzhan gyis bskur ba'i lag rtags la dam drag de tsam bya yi med kyang ci ste gnas tshul gyar ba byung tshe gzhan gyis bskur ba las/ rang nyid kyis ga re yin mi shes zhes brjod rgyu bgyis shing brnyan 'phrin 'khor thag bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo'i sked par ras zhig la sgril nas dkris te/ nga tsho mi grangs bco brgyad kyis snga skyel rlangs 'khor che ba zhig glas te 'gram 'gag sgo bar bskyod skabs 'gram gyi sa mtshams zam chen spyodal mtshams bod kyi sa sne'i lam dum zhig log nas 'gag lha bar shar bskyod ma thub stabs/ zam pa don nas do skyel bas dbor rjes rgya mi'i rlangs 'khor glas te 'gram 'gag lha ra sa rub tsam la 'byor nas do po rnams rlangs 'khor dang chabs cig 'gag sgo'i sgo 'gram de nub 'jog

rirgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 159dgo sa brjod de/ mi'i lag 'khyer dang sgal pa'i lto phad rnams la zhib bsher rob tsam byas nas sne len khang du phyin chog pa byung stabs deb dang byin rlabs bcas nyen kha ma byung bar thar/sang zhogs nga chorware nang nas mi kha shas kyi ngo shes 'gag lharware las byed pas do po rnams sngog bsher ma byas par rim pas so so'i sgal par khyer nas sne len bar dawa ra thub byung bas 'gag sgor nye kha las yongs su grol/ de nas sa skya dbo na dang gzhis rtse bkra shis lhan ngo dgon/ rgyal rtse so/gas la gnas mjal zhu bzhin bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo'i khyim pa snam shol po dang / phran gyi khyim rgyal rtse lung dmar bcas la spun mched gnyen nye rnams thug 'phrad kyis rngobo nga sa mchog gi sku par dang bka' lho ba dril bsgrags yig cha/ mjal mdud sku gas rgya gang che 'grems spel gyis gang thub rtsa don rgyun 'khyodangs dgos skor sogs lhug por brjod cing / nying ro smad bar gyi lung khug gi mi mang la rang gi gnyen blo dkar se gas brgyud btsan byod bod gzhung dang 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad 'phrin dang dril bsgrags yig rigs deb dang sku par sogs rgya che tsam 'grel brjod byed thub/de nas rim bzhin do skyel rlangs 'khor la bsdad cing lha sar 'byor nas rgya gar nas khyer ba'i sku par dang yig rigs deb 'ga' zhig

1snyo0 zhing pa'i dran tho/lam seng 'grems spel zhus kyang / da dung sku par dang deb yig rigs bcas mi nyung ba zhig lhag thog rgan ngag dbang rgya mtshos bskur ba'i deb bcas gnas skabs nyar thabs su sbag lcogs cung che ba zhig yod pa'i gsham char/ 'dzar pang tho gang tsam stong cha yod par mthil pang rang 'gag cig bzos nas de'i nang deb sogs gang gshong sbas skung byas//nyin zhig rgan ngag dbang rgya mcho dang / lha sa ba zhig mnyam du gus pa'i khyim du phebs pa khong gnyis la gsol ja zhus rjes/ gus kyis rgan lags khyed kyi sku chas rnams 'bul chog sku(da pa ga dus bzhes sam zhus/khong gis lha sa ba der cha tshang sprod dgos gsungs pa cha tshang mi der sprad/rang la yod pa'i sku par deb sogs slo nye rnams brgyud rim pas 'grems spel dang / rang gi lag bris dbu chen yi ge bris nas rgya mi'i btsan 'dzul dang / byas nyes sogs bkod pa'i yi ge dang bod rang btsan yin slor sogs 'grems spel gang thub byas/ gus kyis phar 'brel ba bya rgyu'i bsam blo ci yang med kyang tshwa zur zhang de nyid gus sar phebs nas gsung don/ nga tshos bod don skor gang thub las ka byed dgos gsungs pa gus kyis nga tshos dril bsgrags yig cha gang mang 'grems spel gyis mi mngarugi sems shugs rgyas thabs dang / dus bab kyi gnas stangs so/gas mang tsam shes thabs byed thub na yag sngo 'dug kyang lag pas yi ge 'ga' zhig bris nas 'grems

rgyal sa lta sar khyim gzhis bcas te/ rnyed dka'i go skabs dang du blangs/ 1snyo1spel byas kyang mngon gsal snang che ba mi 'dug pa/ snum par zhig byung na yi ge phon che tsam 'grems spel thub kyi red brjod pa/ khong gis snum par zhig g.yar thabs gnang rgyu bgyis nas nyin shas nas srin bal bar 'tshangs kyi nyal chas zhig la bsgril nas bsnams byung / nga gnyis la snum par yod kyang gnyis kas snum par rgyag stangs rtsa ba nas shes kyi med la snum par khyim tshang sger gyi nang nyar te las ka bya rgyu dka' ngal ha cang che yang / phran sgo srung dang khang gnyer sogs kyi las ka byas nas mnyam las nang sdod kyi yod stabs snum par gyi las ka byed yul cha rkyen bzang shonu/ ldan/ phran gyis snum par gyi shog bu dang / snag tsha/ lcags sang sogs dgos mkho rnams gra sgrig legs par byas te ma yig 'bri stangs dang / snum par rgyag stangs sogs gzhan las sbyangs/ gus kyis bod rang btsan gtsang ma yin pa'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang / rgya dmar gyis bod la dmag dpung btang nas btsan 'dzul byas lugs nas btsan shed kyis rtsub spyod ngan g.yo rim byas dbang gis dza drag gnas stangs shig gi 'og 7gong sa mchog btsan byol la ma phebs thabs med byung tshul/ bod nang bod mir mi yul gyi dmyal ba mngon sum ltar dmar gsod mnar gcod ltogs shi dang/ 'jigs snang ma bzod par rang shi brgyab pa sogs bod mir sngar rgyal rabs lo rgyus nang rtsa ba nas mthong thos med pa'i gdug rtsub

1snyon zhing pa'i dran tho/mnar gcod myangs skor/ mthar nga tsho rang dbang rang btsan mthar phyin pa zhig ma byung bar zhi ba'i 'thab rtsod mu mthud bya rgyu sogs 'khod pa'i shog lhe drug can zhig bris te/ snum par brgyab nas tshwa zur zhang slo bzang yon tan mchog la gzigs rtogs ched phul bar yag po 'dug gsungs kyang /gus kyis zhang khyed nas gcig ser byes gtsang pa dge bshes lhun grub thabs mkhas su spyan 'bul zhus nas 'grems spel bya rung dang mi rung bka' 'dri zhu bar phebs rogs zhus don/zhang blo yon gyis dge bshes lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog gi sku mdun bcar nas bka' 'dri zhus par 'grems spel bya na legs tshul bka' slob phebs byung bas/ shog lhe drug can de snum par la cha tshang stong phrag lnga tsam par brgyab nas steb rtseg chung ngu re brgyab cing 'gyig thag gis bsdams te lto phad sogs nang blugs nas lha sa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la 'grems spel byas so//

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 1snyo3le tshan bcu gciga'otho rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi r+shasnal/spyi 'o/ 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nyin phran rgya 'bum sgang khrom gzhung la rkang 'khor 'khrid de sha nyo bar 'gro skabs de snga phran dang spo yul du btson grogs rgyal rtse gur la bla brang pha rdo rje don grub khrom gzhung nas hon thor thor gyis sku nga nas phran dang thug skabs/ da yang yong ba mi 'dug da lta bar skor nang grwa pa 'ga' shas kyis bod rang btsan yin zhes skad 'bod byed kyi 'dug ces brjod byung bas phran ni de thos ma thag lus kyi spu long g.yo ba lta bu'i tshor snang skya sang nge ba zhig byung bas/ sha nyo rgyu yang bcam bzhag gis rkang 'kho ra bzhon nas bar skor nang 'gro skabs dge 'dun pa rnams bar skor thengs gsum bskor nas rnge bo dbu skra'i mdun thang brgyud de sman rtsis khang rnying pa'i nye 'gram slebs nye zhing / dge 'dun pa rnams

1snyo4 zhing pa'i dran tho/kyi rjes su mi mang po 'brangs cing rgya gzhung nyen rtog pa 'ga' zhig kyang mjug ded nas 'gro / phran thad kar dge 'dun pa rnams kyi rjes su mdun bskyod byed skabs ngo shes nyen rtog pa'i 'go khrid tshe dbang zer ba dang thug pas thad kar 'gro thabs bde min la brten/ rkang 'khor la bzhon nas myur bar rang khyim du song nas bza' zla bkra shis dbang mor gnas tshul rnams gsal brjod dang 'brel dge 'dun pa rnams rang skyong ljongs sgo 'gram skad 'bod gnang bar phebs mkhan red/ khyed rang mgyogs po rang skyong ljongs rgyal sgo'i mdun song zhes bshad/ bkra shis dbang mo rang skyong ljongs rgyal sgo'i mdun 'byor skabs dge 'dun pa rnams rgya mi'i nyen rtog pas rlangs 'khor lam g.yas g.yon sgrig nas bkag cing / nyes rdung gshegang bzhin 'ju bzung gis rlangs 'khor che ba'i nang blugs skabs mi mang gis phar 'then tshur 'then gang tsam byas kyang dge 'dun pa rnams dang / skad 'bod rme/nga yod pa'i skya wa'i gras bsod nams rgyal po sogs 'dzin bzung gis bce na khang la khrid pa sogs kyi gnas dzaXl rnams bza' zla bkra shis dbang mos bshad rjes/ mtshan der gnyid kyang khug mi thub pa'i gnas las ga/zhan bya thabs ma mchis/sang nyin brag ra klu sgug sku zhabs thub bstan rnam grol sogs blo nye gzhan dang mnyam ga re bya na dga' zhes 'asngo sa mo la rim par byung mthar/

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 1snyo5spyi zla 10 tshes 1 nyin se ra dgon gyi dge 'dun pa 'ga' zhig nas khrom skor gnang gtan khel ba gsang ba'i thog shes mor byung / nga tshos thabs shes kyis mi gang mang bar skor nang snga po nas yong thub pa byed dgos sogs gsang 1—sa bgyis don ltar phran gyis kyang spyi zla 9 tshes 30nyin/ ser skya mi mang 'ga' zhig la sang zhogs chu tshod bdun pa nas brgyad pa bar 'gyangs med bar skor la yong dgos bskul ma zhus/ de'i khongs nas dge 'dun pa gcig tshes 1 nyin nyen rtog pas 'ju bzung gis nyen rtog las khungs su se ra'i dge 'dun pa rnams dang lhan du bcug ste nyes rdung du ma btang /phran bza' tshang gnyis spyi zla 9 tshes 30 dgong mo 'phros mol byas don sang zhogs gnyis ka bar sgo ra du phyin nas gal srid gnyis ka 'dzin bzung du 'tshud tshe khyim nang mi gcig kyang med pa ma zad/ dza drag gi skabs der spyi tshogs lnga ga las ka bya rgyu dang / 'brel ba sogs bya thabs chad kyi red/ phran bar sgor du ma phyin par bsdad de las don mu mthud mjug skyong bya rgyu dang / bkra shis dbang mo srung ba dang phyag nas sogs gang legs btags nas bar skor la 'gro rgyu thag bcad/spyi zla 10 tshes 1 snga dro chu cho da 7 pa tsam nas bkra shis dbang mo bar skor la thon pa dang / phran gyis khyim du bsang zhig btang ste

1snyosnyo zhing pa'i dran tho/'phrin bcol sogs zhus rjes phyi rol lam chen du don nas gsar 'gyur skug nas sdod skabs chu chod bcu pa ma zin tsam la mi rnams ha las pa'i rnam pa'i thog khrom slor byed mkhan dge 'dun rnams bar sgor mngags gtong khang du bcug go/ zhes tshang ma brel 'tshab zing zing byed/ mi legs pa'i gsar 'gyur rna bar thos 'phral phran gyi sems nang gnon thabs bral ba'i khrag rtsa khol ba ltar gyi tshor ba rgyas nas sdod thabs med par yar phyin nas khyim la sgo lcags zhig brgyab ste/ bar skor du thad kar 'gro skabs jo bo dbu skra'i mdun thang dang mngags gtong khang mdun bcas la mi tshogs kyi 'du long 'khrigs shing sgra gnam sa gasku ba ltar grags shing / mngags gtong khang gi lha'i g.yas g.yon la rlangs 'khor chung ba bdun brgyad tsam dang sbag sbag re gnyis bcas mgo rting bslogs/ phran gyis mngags gtong khang gi sgo 'gram phyin te mi gzhan dang mnyam nga dzarware dge 'dun pa rnams 'phral du glod dgos zhes skad 'bod byed bzhin du/ mngags gtong khang gi rgyal sgo dbye thabs byas kyang rtsa ba nas phye thub kyi mi 'dug la bcags gtor yang ma thub pas/ phar tsam bshigs te rgya mi'i nyen rtog pa'i rlangs 'khor la me brgyag rtsis skabs gus kyis snum lam yong khungs lhu lag bshig bo gas bgyis/gyen 'o/ga pa rnams kyis mngags gtong khang gi rgyal sgor me spar

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 1snyo7zhing lag rdo 'phen te sge'u khung shel rnams bcag nas sge khung nas nyal chas dang dug log sogs thon rigs sgo 'gram mer bsregs stabs/ me che cher 'bar nas sgo dang khang par me skyon che tsam byung nas rgyal sgor mi thar tsam zhig ral du gyur te me dpung che cher 'bar yang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dkor gnyer byams pa bstan 'dzin gyis rgya sgo'i nang 'ur mchongs kyis 'dzul bas me dpung gis sku zhabs byams pa bstan 'dzin gyi sku sha 'tshigs nas sha thigs pa brgyag nyer khong mar phebs/ dang po rgya gzhung drag las mi snar 'phen byed lag rdo dkon yang rgyab phyogs bud med rnams kyis lto phad dang pang gdan nang the mkho sgrub kyis mdun sngo sa mi rnams la mkho sprod byas shing / gang mtshams zhig nas skor lam ar 'dam bsngogs pas thege gang dgos thodan/ bod mi rnams kyis lag rdo 'phen zhing nga tsho'i dge 'dun pa rnams lam seng glod dgos zhes mu mthud skad 'bod skabs mngags gtong khang gi cha shas mes 'tshigs nas me mda' dang phyo ga sbag gi sgra bar mtshams med par grags pas/ skabs re mdun lnga sa mi rnams phyir bshig phran bu byed pa mi 'gas ki sgra re rgyag skabs mdun mchodangs shugs cher byed/gus kyis mngags gto/nga khang gi rgyal sgo'i mdun nas rdo gang mang 'phen yang yid ma tshims par de'i lho ngos thog rtseg gsum ldan gyi slob chung nang phyin nas bar thog sge'u khung nas rdo 'phen skabs/ mngags gtong

1snyo8 zhing pa'i dran tho/khang gi rgyab phyogs byed gte gling khang pa'i nya rgyab sgang nyen rtog pa 'ga' zhig bzhon te mdun ngos mi dpung la kha bltas nas me mda' 'phen gyi 'dug pa / gus dang mi 'ga' yis nyen rtog pa de rnams la sdig ste lag rdo 'phen yang nus pa lnga na ma thub/ de nas mar babs te mngags gtong khang gi mdun ngos nas lag rdo 'phen te skad 'bod rgyag skabs rgya gzhung me gsod ru khag gi rlangs 'khor dmar po chen po zhig mngags gtong khang dang slob chung gi srang lam brgyud 'gyor zhing / ras kyi chu gtong sbu gu 'then bzhin snum 'khor rgyab rgya darma ga 'jabs te mngags gtong khang gi spru gas su yong skabs bod mi tshang mas the tshom spu tsam med par the bcom btang bas/ me gsod rlangs 'khor phyir bshig rgyag dgos byung yang rlangs 'khor nas me mda' 'phen te rwa sgreng bstan pa tshe ring rmas skyon 'phog bod mi 'ga' zhig gis rlangs 'khor dang rgya dmag phyir phud btang zhing la las gnas chung slob bu dkar gsal gyi sku phung 'khyer nas khrom skor byed pa dang / kha shas kyis bar skor lho ngos lag shes las khungs kyi sge'u khung mdun mes 'tshigs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkor gnyer byams pa bstan 'dzin gyi phyag tu dar dkar zhig dkris nas khong dang mnyam skad 'bod byed/ gang mtshams shig nas gnas chung slob bu dkar gsal 'das wa'i sku phung mi 'ga' zhig gis bkyag ste jo bo dbu skra'i mdun thang brgyud rang skyong ljongs phyogs la khrom

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi skol/ 1snyo9slor du bskyod pa'i rjes su mdun phyogs bod mi phal che ba 'brangs te bskyod pas/ mngags gtong khang mdun mi nyung ngu las ma lhag cing da dung mi 'ga' bar lha ra lto phyogs su phyir bshig byas pa bcas kyis mngags gtong khang gi mdun phran dang / se ra'i grwa log byams pa/ phyi rgyal mi gnyis bcas las mi 'dug mngags gtong khang gi mes ma 'tshigs pa'i khang pa nas nyen rtog pas me mda' mu mthud 'phen yang gus dang / se ra'i grwa log byams pa/ phyi rgyal gzugs ring ba zhig bcas nged gsum gyis mngags gtong khang nang dge 'dun pa rnams bcug yod nges snyam ste/ blos ma bzod par shing ra'i sgo 'og gab kyin rdo 'phen skabs nyen rtog pas me mda' thung mda' zhig nga tshor 'phen bzhin yang nga tshor rmas skyon sogs ci yang ma byung /rgya dmag rnams mngags gtong khang dang bar thag me ḍar brgya phrag kha shas chod pa'i rgyab phyogs nub ngos ka'o chi'i za khang dang / klu sgug rgyud gra sgrig ang bsar yod pa rnams bod mi rnams bar slor mdun med pa'i go skabs dang bstun mngags gtong khang dang / lho ngos slob khra/ nga bar gyi lam nas yar 'dzul bas nga tsho bzhi gros bsdur gang yang ma byung bar se ra'i grwa log byams pa dang phyi rgyal ba gnyis bar skor lho rgyud la phyir 'then byas/bod mi tshang ma phyir thon tshar zhing bar skor rgya dmag gis bzung bas rang nyid gcig pus byed thabs ci yang med rkyen mngags gtong khang

170 zhing pa'i dran tho/gi byang ngos nas jo bo dbu skra'i mdun brgyud rang khyim bzhi sde dgon gsham bkras khang sgo rar shar rer bskyod/ cung zhig nas bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo 'gyor ba bod mi rnams rang skyong ljongs sgo 'gram bar bskyod de rlangs 'kho ra chung ba zhig kyang mer bsregs tshul brjod/ mngags gtong khang gi nang bcug pa'i se ra'i dge 'dun pa rnams nas dge 'dun pa gcig la rgya gzhung nyen rtog pa bod rigs dbang phyug bsod nams zer bas me mda' 'phen te sa gnas de gar 'das bo ngas gyur yang / stabs legs par dge 'dun pa spyi byings rgya gzhung nyen rtog pa gtsang pa phur bus mngags gtong khang gi lto ngos sge khung nas bton par grags so/nyin de'i dgong dro phyi rol du macibaskyod par rang khyim du bsdad cing sang zhogs nam gsal tsam la phran bar lha/ra la bskyod pa skor bar 'gro mi nyung ngu las med cing rlangs 'khor 'tshig ro sogs dbor tshar nas mi 'dugamangags gtong khang 'tshigs skyon dang ldib skyon che tsam byung ste me ro'i du ba 'tshub 'tshub ngang gnas shing mngags gtong khang dang jo bo dbu skra'i mdun thang bcas su the hrug gis khyab cing / skor bya'i nyen rtog pa sogs gcig kyang med par 'jam thing nger gnas/ bar skor nas rang khyim la 'dre ra nas bsam gzhigs byed skabs snga nyin phran bza' mi gnyis kas 'dzems zon med par mdun lnga sa su thon nas 'thab rtsodad rgyun ring byas pa

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi skol/ 171gsal rtog byung yod na 'ju bzung bya nyen che bsams pa dang / phran gnyis bal yul du bskyod chog pa'i thongs mchan lag 'khyer dus tshod gtsang med pas lnga sa byol la 'gro dgos min gros mol byas te/ phran gyis dge bshes seng ge rin po che'i sku mdun bcar nas mjal dar zhig dang rgya sgor lnga phul te kha sang gi gnas tshul rnams zhib par snyan gseng dang / chabs cig phran gnyis 'gro sdod ci bzang thugs dam zhig gnang rogs zhus/ dge bshes seng ge rin po che mchog dang rgyun du 'brel ba che tsam zhus te bka' slob ci yod nang mol tshul gyi mdzad kyi yod pa bka' phebs don/ khyed gnyis bros byol phyin yang mi legs pa med kyang 'di gar bsdad na legs che/ zhes gsungs/ phran gyis sems thag gtsang bcad ngang gus rgya gar nas 'byor te dus tshod ring po phyin med pas bod du gnas tshul byung 'phral bros na 'gan 'khur ma byas par g.yol ba lta bur gyur srid pas bsdad rgyu yin zhes zhus/rang khyim du bza' zla bkra shis dbang mor dge bshes seng ge rin po che'i thugs dam nang don bshad de bsdad rgyur thag gcod mos mthun byas nas/ spyi tshes 3 nas phran mnyam las kyi las kar nyin ltar bskyod kyang de sngon nas mnyam las nas rtsa dasgo ngas zhus te/ grong gseb gang sar chosang rilas tsag tsig gnyer nas skabs re 'gram la'ang phyin nas de sngon bal yul

17na zhing pa'i dran po/du phran gyi zhang po blo rdor gyis ngo sprod mdzad pa'i rgyal khongs bal yul yin pa'i mi zhig dang phyis 'brel ba zhu rgyu'i kha dan byas pa'i 'char gzhi ltar/phran rgya gar du ma bskyod sngon mnyam las kyi 'jib 'khor kha lo ba yin yang mnyam las 'go khrid kyis phran la yid ches shugs cher byed kyi yod pas thad kar rtsa dgongs zhu rgyur cung 'tsher snang gis kha lo ba dgongs pa zhus na/las ka gzhan med rkyen rang bzhin gyis dgongs 'khrol yong res gzugs gzhi dang lo na'i bab la bsnyad de dgongs pa zhus kyang / 'go khrid kyis kha lo ba dgongs pa sprad de phran la thugs 'khur chen pos mnyam las kyi mdzod khang dang / 'grul khang / slog bcas kyi blta rtogs pa dang khang gla bsdu rgyu/ sgo srung ba/ las khungs kyi kha par dang yig 'brel tshags par bcas kyi do dam dang 'gan 'khur ba'i las 'gan sprad pa dang / khang pa yang mnyam las nang cha rkyen yongs su tshang ba zhig sprad pas chodag ma'i bsam tshul ltar dgongs zhu ma nus par spyi zla 10 nang mnyam las su spos te las 'gan 'khur/mnyam las der bzo grwa'i las khungs a ma'i ma lag cha tshang la sa khang rgya khyon ha cang che zhing ar las ru chen gnyis / skam bakhro'i las grwa'i ru khag gcig 'grems ston lha khang gcig rum thag bzo grwa dang / 'tshem khang las grwa/ tshong khang / thug thag chang khang / ar khang / glog 'phrul/

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 173mabo na khang sogs tshang ma lcags ri gcig nang yod/ rgyal sgo bar lha gcig nang du ru chen so so'i shing bzo 'khor khang dang mdzod khang / yig tshang /'phrul rigs/ ar las rgyu cha 'jo sa/ yul thab tshang gnyer tshang sogs cha tshang re yod/ rgyal sgo phyi ma'i g.yas g.yon la bod khang thog rtseg gnyis can khang mig che chung du ma dang / phyi sgo nas bar sgo'i bar ra ba rgya chen po zhig dang thog sa gcig ldan khang pa bzhi bcu tsam yod/ gang ltar rgya sgo phyi sgo nas bar sgo ma mdzul bar khang pa tshang ma 'grul khang du khang gla gtong byed kho na yin/mnyam las khang du srung bya ba gsum tsam gtan sdod byed cing mtshan mo skor g.yeng byed pa'i las khungs dbus mas zur 'dzugs byas pa'i bde 'jags mi sna gsum la phran gyis gzhogs 'degs bya dgos/ phran tshor las khungs nas glog gi rgyug pa dang 'phrul mda' dbyin ji kha ldum gcig dang / rgya mi'i 'phrul mda' phyed rang 'gul can gcig bcas sprad/de bzhin las khungs kyis gling kha gtong mir yo byad gla g.yar byed pa dang las khungs su khang mig sum cu sku gcig gi mgron khang zhig yod pa phran gyis bogs mar blangs/ de ltar rang nyid sger gyi dpal 'byor cha rkyen cha tshang 'dzoms kyang rang nyid phyug por 'gyur 'dod ma bgyis par bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs bstan pa chab srid bcas kyi ched du/ rang nus dpags

174 zhing pa'i dran tho/pa'i las don bya rgyur sems thag gtsang bcad kyis 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob sgra 'dzin 'khor thag phab bsgyur dang / deb dang dril bsgrags yig rigs par brgyab ste se 'bras dge gsum gyis gtsos sa phyogs gang sar 'grems spel bgyis so/snum par yo byad zla ba gsum tsam bed spyod byed bzhin yang do bdag nas phyir sprod dgos lugs gsungs pa bzhin gzhan gyi snum par bde spyod rgyur blo khel po mi 'dug pas rtsis sprad pa dang / nga tsho'i las khungs kyi dngul gnyer dang rtsis par snum par yod kyang de dag bed spyod 'dun ma bcangs par las sgo nas bzos pa'i lcags sang la shing lha ma bzos na ma/ 'thus pa med par bsams shing / shing bzo chen mo ba pad+ma'i mdun bskyod de lcags sang phul te/ bed spyod stangs dang dgos 'char rnams zhus te khyed nas ji 'gab dgongs bzhes kyis shing sgrom zhig bzo dgos pa'i re ba zhus/ lcags kyi lhu lag re zung dgos pa rang nyid kyis bzos pa dang khong gis shing sgrom las grub pa'i snum par zhig bzos pa stabs bde'i bed spyod byed thub pa ma zad/ las sgo'i snum par rgyag skabs sgra phran bu grags kyang shing sgrom snum par gyi sgra rtsa ba nas med pas gzhan gyi shes dogs bya dgos med pa byung / rang nyid kyi las khungs las 'gan phal che ba bza' zla bkra shis dbang mos tshab byas pa dang rang nyid kyis rkang 'khor bachodan nas nyin

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 175mo gang sar gnas tshul 'cho la bsdu dang mtshan mo rgya dmar gyi bya spyod las 'gul ji 'dra zhig spel ba la skyon brjod kyi rgol yig dang / rang rigs rnams sems shugs 'phel thabs/ bod rgyal bstan mi rigs dang rig gzhung sogs la gces mthong dgos skor sogs yig cha'i ma zin bris pa dang / snum par brgyab ste 'grems spel sogs rgyun chad med par bgyis/yig cha dpar deb kyi shog bu dang / snag tsha/ lcags sang sogs kyi rgyu cha rang nyid kyis 'dzems zon med par nar gtong byas /gong smos dgu pa'i nyer bdun dang / bcu pa'i gcig gi las 'gul rjes zla 10 tshes 6 nyin 'bras spungs dang gnas chung dge 'dun pa sogs gsang ba'i thog lha sar ngo rgol la phebs kyang / rgya dmar gyis sngon 'tshud nas shes rtog thub ste rkyang thang na khar dmag mi dang nyen rtog phon ches sgug ra sprad de dge 'dun rnams la lcags hreng so can dang / ber rgyug la lcags 'dzer can sogs ched bzos lag chas nyes rdung tshad med kyis kha shas rkang lag bcag pa sdudags rmas skyon tshabs cher baX sa/yang / spyi lo 1987 lor brag lha klu sgug sku zhabs thub bstan rnam grol gyis 'gan gtso bo bsnams te bod rang btsan yin pa'i sgrub byed don tshan bcu gsum 'khod pa'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus mdor bsdus sogs/yig cha kha shas shing par du bkod rgyu'i gra sgrig gnang bar phran gyis par shing

17snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/dang / yig cha kha shas mkho sprod zhus shing / spyi lo 1987 'o/ mjug la rgan blo bzang dbang phyug btson khang du yod mus la sku srog 'da' khar sman rtsis khang nad khang du sman bcos ched gdan drangs nas grongs pa/ bstan rgyas gling nye 'gram khyim tshang zhig nang gdan 'dren zhus 'dug pas thabs shes kyis gdung mjal zhu bar bcar nas sku par sum cu skor zhig bsgron nas/ spyin shog gsang thabs kyis bal yul du phran gyi a zhang blo bzang thege rjer nges 'bul gyis spyin shog cha tshang zhig bshus nas rang gzhung la 'bul rogs zhus don/ zhang blo bzang rdo rjes sku par cha tshang zhig rang gzhung phyi dril brgyud 'bul lam zhus pa rang gzhung gis par skrun gnang ba'i dam pa de nyid kyi phyag deb cig gi mjug shog tu bkod pa'i sku par de yang de'i khongs gcig yin/ de la sogs pa phran gyis bskur ba'i chab srid btson po'i por 'di gar tshags shog dang dus deb kha shas thog bkod thon byung sang nga //spyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nas bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar khrom spor dang rnam pa 'dra min gyi bod don las 'gul rgyun chad med par spel bas chab srid btson pa rim 'phar byung ste lha sa gsang yib dang / u'u kri tud/ si khru'u/ rgu tsha/ drag chas nyen stodag spyi khyab khang gi 'phral sel btson khang bcas su btson pa je mang 'gro ba rang nyid kyi bsam tshul la ris

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang bi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 177med btson par rogs skyor zhus nas tshang ma'i sems shugs rgyas thabs byed dgos gal cher mthong ste/ nyin mtshan ltos med dka' ngal 'dzems med kyis chab srid btson pa'i 'tsho ba dang 'phrod bsten la blta rtog dang / sman khang kha shas la dngos su bskyod pa dang kha shas la mi brgyud gron dngul phul ba/ nang mi dka' ngal can rnams la rogs ram gang thub zhus pa bcas kyi khongs nas deng dus btsan byol du yod pa rwa sgreng bstan pa tshe ring dang /dga' ldan bkra shis/ shug gseb btsun ma pa sangs sogs yod/ dga' ldan bkra shis gzugs smad 'gul bskyod med par mi mang sman khang du yod skabs nad g.yog gis gsang gcod nang khyer ba'i thod skabs dang bstun/phran gyis par brgyab cing khong mi mang sman khang nas sman rtsis khang du spos skabs phran gyis 'khrug chung ngu las med pa'i rlangs 'khor chung ngu rgya skad la hrang had rtags can zer ba gra sgrig zhus/ bkra shis slo bur sman khang nas rkang pa btsugs nas har langs thub kyang rna bas sgra thos rgyu med par gyur par ngo thug gis yi ge bris nas sems gso dang nad gso/sa sprad/gong smos btsun ma pa sangs rgu tsha btson khang du nad mnar gyis sman rtsis khang du 'byor skabs smra lce 'gul bskyod ma thub pa'i nad gzhi lci po phog skabs ngo thug gis sems gso dang nad gsos phul ba zad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po seng ge rin po che'i sku mdun phran bcar te dar

178 zhing pa'i dran po/dkar dang sgor lnga phul nas btsun ma khong gi nad gzhi'i skor snyan seng dang 'brel/ srog nyen yod med dang rim gro ji dgos sogs thugs dam skyabs 'jug zhus nas thugs dam dgongs don bzhin/ rim gro tsag tsig bgyis pa bcas gong ming spyodas pa tsam las gus kyi rogs ram zhus pa phyis btsan byol du yang phebs pa ji snyed yod la bod nang du'ang mang dag yod/ lhag par zla 10 tshes 1 nyin 'das bo ngas glur pa'i gtsos las 'gul nang gshegs pa rnams kyi 'das mchod bdun tshigs skabs gdan sa gsum dang / dgon sde khag la mchod 'bul bsnyen bkur zhu ba'i gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur me tog chos mdzad dang brag lha klu skug thub bstan rnam grol gyis mdzad par rang nyid kyis gzhogs 'degs hur bskyed zhus/ rang nyid kyang phal cher btson du 'tshud nges snyam nas rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo 'jigs pa'i bdag bskyed bsdus pa dang thun drug bsdus pa bcas blo la bzung nas mu mthud bod don las 'gul spel/spyi lo 1988 nang lha sa'i nye 'dabs dgon pa che chung rnams nas sngo rgol khrom skor gnang khongs snye thang ra stod dgon par rgya las zhib 'jug pa yong ba dge 'dun rnams kyis lnga rgol dang / kha shas kyis rgya las kyi rlangs 'kho ra chung bar 'bar rdzas bzhag nas gtor thabs byas par brten ra stod dgon gyi grwa blo bzang gtsos/ dge 'dun pa gsum tsam 'ju bzung
