lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi skol/ 179gis chu shur lja nga du btson bcug byas pa bcas kyi gnas stangs la nyams zhib byas pas grwa blo bzang lo gsum gyi khrims thag bcad yod pa shes rtogs byung / de ni spyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nas rang btsan skad 'bod dang khrom skor byed mir dus bkag khrims chad btang ba thengs dang po yin/ tshwa zur zhang blo bzang yon tan dang phran gnyis gros mo la byas te gra blo bzang thag ring la gtang tshe nyal gos sogs dka' ngal 'phrad nyen che zhes nga gnyis mnyam rub kyis gyon bo sa gra sgrig dang / phran gyis nyal 'jo zhig dang / nyal gdan gcig sring bal bar 'tshangs kyi nyal chas 'bring ba gcig de bzhin za chas dang khrus rdzas dung ban gcig sogs chu shur rdzong du zhang lags ngo bskyod kyis blo bzang la 'phrod thabs byas/spyi lo 1988 zla 3 tshes 5 nyin dga' ldan gyi dge 'dun pas sne khrid de lha sa'i smon lam grub nas byams pa gdan 'dren skabs bar skor du ngo rgol rngam ston gnang mthar rgya dmar nyen rtog dang / dmag mis lha ldan gtsug lag khang nang 'dzul nas dge 'dun pa'i gzim shag gang sar rngog bsher gyis sku chas dang dngul gang yod ham 'phyog dang / dge 'dun pa 'ga' shas kyi phyag gi chu tshod kyang 'phrog 'khyer/ sku gsung thugs rten mdun gyi maṇa dral dngul sogs rku 'phrog byas/ phran gyis skal bzang tshe dbang brgyud lha bris zhig la rgya mi'i nyen rtog dang / dmag mi'i bya ngan

180 zhing pa'i dran tho/de dag gi gzugs brnyan gsal por snum par gyi shog bu'i steng bkod dgos pa'i re bskul zhus te snum par je mang brgyab nas gang sar 'grems spel byas/ btson khang khag nang btson par dza drag gi mnar gasgu da gtong ba dang sger bcug byas pa/ bod rigs btson pa kho nar zungs khrag btsag pa sogs gdug rtsub che ba'i las 'gul rim par sgol gtam dang sdig ra'i gnad che'i yi ge 'ga' shas mtho rim las khungs dang / khrims khang / nyen rtog pa'i las khungs khag gi 'go byed so sor thad kar btang ba bcas de ltar phran gyis nyin mo gang sar 'brel ba byas te spyi chodags dang btson khang sogs kyi gnas tshul nyams zhib dang / mtshan sdu/ yig bris dang snum par brgyab pa so/gas dgong mo phal che ba mtshan mo'i chu tshod gnyis pa gsum pa tsam gyi bar mkhris su glog thab cig spar te glog 'od 'og las rtsol rgyun sring bsten pas/ spyi lo 1989 dbyar dkyil la phran la nad gzhi ha cang lci po zhig 'o/ga nas sman khang gzhan gyi nyal khri ma thob kyang dza drag gi nyal khri'i steng nyal nas nyin re bcud ldan sman chu shel dam gnyis re chad med brgyab ste 'jib 'khor nang rang khyim la log yong /de ltar nyin bdun tsam byas mthar phran bu drag skyes byung ba mu mthud bod don ched 'gro bskyod gang 'tshams byas pas nyin gnyis kyi rjes nad log brgyab nas zug zer tshad med dang / cung zad 'gul bskyod byas

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang si lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 181na'ang mi bzod pa'i na zug drag tu rgyas shing tsha ba 'phar te sems rnal du gnas mi thub pa dang / so rnyil la dreg pa chags pa sogs dka' ngal ha cang che bas mtshan gung sngo shes bod sman em chi bgres song zhig gdan zhus kyis khe nga gis na zug 'jags thabs zangs phor brgyab pa sogs/ bcos thabs gang drag gnang yang na zug rtsa ba nas ma 'jags/ phyi nyin mi gzhan brgyud mi mang sman khang gi go gnas malnga ba'i sman pa la 'brel ba byas nas de'i bka' drin gyis sman khang du nyal khang thob pa ma zad/ 'phrul chas sna tshogs kyis brtag dpyad dang / nyin bcu gnyis ring bcud ldan sman chur sman gzhan bsres te shel dam gsum re star chags dang / nyin ltar brtag dpyad kyis skabs dbo sa sman sprad/ brtag dpyad byas pas shes gsal la blo tshad dang mkhris pa rgyas pa/ glo ba'i phyi shun la chu ser yod pa bcas red brjod/ nyin bcu gnyis rjes na zug gang tsam 'jags pa dang / kha lag kyang za 'dod dang kha phye byung / mi mang sman khang du zla gnyis tsam sdod dgos byung ba de'i ring bar skor sogs la yig skyur 'grems spel byed mkhan dngos gsal dod pos nyung du phyin skor brjod mkhan byung / phran gyis snum par gyi yig skyur yongs rdzogs dbu can yin pa dang mjug byang du chol gsum mthun tshogs zhes bskadad yod/spyi 'e1 1989 zla 3 tshes 8 nas rgya gasdo/nga gis bkag rgya

18da zhing pa'i dran tho/bsdams pa sogs dam drag che ba'i skabs phran gyis ja dam che ba'i phyi shun nang yi ge steb rtseg byas pa gang blugs te rkang 'khor bzhon nas skyel bar thengs du mar bskyod/ lam bar gang 'gro dri mi byung na ja dam shel nyo bar 'gro yi yin zhes brjod kyi sku da/ khrims khang dang nyen rtog las khungs sogs la dza drag gi yig cha ras phad nang blugs nas tho rengs rkang 'khor ba6den nas lcags ri'i phyi nas ras phad chabs cig rang nyid ngo mas dbyugs kyi yod/ yi ge 'ga' zhig bod ljong sa slob grwa chen mo'i 'dzin khang dang / bod sman rtsis khang slob grwa'i 'dzin khang nang sbyar 'grems byas/ dza drag yi ge mang po 'grems spel byas skabs rgya mis mi mang gi mnyam sdeb sde tshan se gas las khungs khag nang snum par la glo bur zhib bsher byas shing phranu/ gyi gnas yul las khungs su yang thengs re zung zhib 'jug byas/spyi lo 1988 lor 7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che lha sar phebs nas chab srid btson pa nga bdun tsam glod babo la mdzad pa'i dus su spyi lo 1987 lo tshun bod don ched btson khang la 'tshud pa 'i btson pa skya ser pho mo lung tshan ris med thams cad la phran sger gyis yig lkog nang sgor nyer lnga re dang / mjal dar zub phyi re/ snye thang rma'o lcogs 'brog pa chab srid btson pa zhig la dmigs bsal sgor sum cu so lnga bcas dgon lung khag gi 'brel yod mi sna brgyud phul/ skabs de dus rang nyid kyi bsam

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 18zhatshul la bod rang btsan dang spyi don byed mi tshang mar gzengs su bltod pa dang khyon yongs nas rgyab skyor shugs chen zhig yod pa'i 'char snang gis sems shugs 'phel thabs gal cher mthong nas mi gcig gnyis kyis rgyu gron btang ba dang / rgyab skyor byas pa'i rnam pa bstan na gdeng 'jog de tsam e sku da bsams nas rang nyid kyi yin khul ming tsam ma brjod par rgyab phyogs la rgyab skyor dang stobs shugs chen po yod pa'i rnam pa'i thog nas rogs phan zhus/ gong gsal dngul sgor nyer lnga dang kha btags bzhes myong ba'i mi sna 'di gar phebs pa'ang gang tsam yod/rang nyid nas nyin ltar gnas tshul zhib rtsad ched rkang 'khor bzhon nas gang sar blta zhib nyan 'jog byed par nyin nas zla ba dang zla ba nas lo sbrel te khrom skor byed mkhan byung rim la khungs gang nas yin pa dang / mi grangs ga tshod sku da min/ ga tshod 'dzin bzung byas min/ rmas skyon sogs ji byung 'brel yod nas thabs shes yod rgus zhib rtsad byas te gnas tshul rob tsam shes rjes dza drag rmas mar sman dang / za chas/ gyon chas gang mkho thabs shes kyis gang myur 'khyol thabs dang / 'dzin bzung byas nas khrims thag ma bcad bar gyi btson par thug 'phrad byed mi bcug pas de rigs la thabs lam brgyud cing drag chas nyen rtog spyi khyab khang sku gas 'phral sel bce na khang kha shas la nges med thabs shes kyis za chas sdudags 'phrod

184 zhing pa'i dran rbo/thabs byas/ phran dang tshwa zur zhang blo bzang yon tan gnyis kyis thodag mar mnyam rub kyis sa thag ring ba dang blta rtogs byed mkhan med rigs rnams gtso bzung gis mi rer zla ba 'char can mar ki lo gcig dang / bye ma ka ra pa'o gsum tsam/ 'o tsam ki lo phyed tsam/ shing 'bras/ kha zas/ gyon chas/ rtsam par bsres pa'i sman rigs dang byin rten bcas dang / blta rtog byed mkhan med rigs la de'i khar sha mog dang / bag tsha mar khu/ sha 'bras se gas kha lag sna snu gas dang ja/ khyodan chas mo gas chag med 'bul gyi yod/spyi lo 1989 zla 12 tshes 10 nyin gyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang nyin 7gong sa mchog la zhi bde'i gzengs rtags 'bul nyin skad 'bod khrom skor gnang ba'i gar dgon btsun ma rnams rgu tsha btson khang du bcug thog de'i khongs 'ju bzung byas rjes rkang pa'i nya ril la me mda' 'phog pa'i btsun ma rgyal mtshan dbang mo sa gce sa btsun ma gsum 'dam gzhung rdzong nas yin par brten/ rgu tshar nyin dgu las ma nyar bar 'dam gzhung rdzong gi btson khang la rtsis sprad pa/ phran dang tshwa zur zhang slo bzang yon tan gyis shes 'phral 'dam gzhung gi dgun dus gnam gshis ha cang grang ngar che zhing grong gseb sa char rogs phan byed mkhan yang dkon pas/ de rnams la pags rdzus kyi phyu pa dang gu thung re dang za chas se gas gra sgrig gis mi

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rlol/ 185gcig glas te ched du mngags/ gar dbo na btsun mas thog mar spyi lo 1987 bod zla 10 tshes 30 nyin rgyal sa lha sa'i bar skor nang bod rang btsan rngam ston khrom skor gnang ba de ni lha sa'i nye 'dabs btsun dgon nas rngam ston khrom skor byed snga thodas dang thengs grangs mang shos gar dgon btsun ma yin par brten/ gar dgon nyams gso'i skabs gang thub mo gas ram zhus shing / phran tsho mi 'ga' zhig gar dgon la ched bcar gyis 'dus cho gas la bsnyen bkur zab rgyas zhus nas zhag gnyis bca' mal bgyis/ de bzhin gdan sa gsum sogs bod don ched skad 'bod mdzad pa'i dgon khag tshang mar dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas gang thub rgyab skyodar dang / btson khang khag gi thug 'phrad so sor tshwa zur zhang lags dang phran gnyis ched mngags bskyod pa dang skabs 'gar phran khom pa ma byung tshe bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo bskyod de zas gos sogs sprad pa dang / ngo thug skabs slad dgos mkho ji yod dris te 'dod pa bskangs thabs byed kyi yod/btson pa'i ched 'brel yod tshang mar lo gsar dkar gro sogs ched mngags 'tshams 'bul bstar te btson par rgyun gtan za chas 'bul lam 'tshol gyi yod/ lo gsar skabs rang dbang can gyi mi dang mi 'dra bar btson pa rnams gnyen nye 'dzoms te dga' skyid byed pa'i skabs med kyang de dag la lo gsar skabs skal thob lta bur kha zas phon che bsregs te

186 'ing pa'i dran tho/bskyal/ btson khang khag nang skabs re rgya mis dza drag gi dam drag sogs kyi las 'gul skabs phran dang tshwa zur zhang lags sogs nas gtsug lag khang dpal lha dang / drag mo bcas kyi zhabs 'og tu btson khang khag tu yod pa'i chab srid btson pa'i grangs 'bor bzhag nas bskang 'phrin gsog skrub byed pa'i dge 'dun pa bdun dang bzhi gang rung gdan zhus kyis nyin 'khyongs bsnyen bkur zhus/ bskang 'phrin gsog sgrub zhu skabs zas dang ja g.yo sbyor gtsug lag khang gi dkor gnyer byams pa bstan 'dzin gyi gzim shag tu gra sgrig zhus shing khong gis gang cir mthun 'gyur dpe med gnang gi yod/'dzin bzung bya rgyur 'tshol zhib skabs bros thar ba btsun ma ngag dbang 'dzoms pa dang / ngag dbang pad+ma/ 'das grongs song ba'i rgyal mtshan bde chen sogs gsang thabs gab yib tu zla ba drug tsam nyar nas mthar rgya gar du bros byol btang ba dang / chab srid kyi nyes 'gan las rgya gar du btsan byol la bros mkhan mi nyung bar lam gron rgya sgor chig stong tsam dang 'ga' shas la brgya phrag kha shas dang / zas gos/ lam khrid mi snar 'gro gron/rlangs 'khor rdal gla bcas sprad pa mang dag yod pa de'i khongs nas deng dus rgya gar lho phyogs dga' ldan dgon gyi dge 'dun pa mang dag yod/spyi lo 1990 lo tsam la tshwa zur zhang lags kyis sngaged phrug gi slob chung zhig btsugs te thog mar slob phrug grangs bdun brgyad yod pa slob

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 187khang gi thog 'gebs shing dang / nag pang bcas phran gyis mthun rkyen sbyar ba dang / bod yig dge rgan tshwa zur zhang lags kyis gtso 'gan bzhes rgyu dang deng dus bal yul du yod pa'i dge 'dun rin chen gyis dgong dro zhor du dbyin yig slob khrid bya rgyu bcas dang / de bzhin mi gzhan gyis zhor du rogs pa phran bu zhus pas rim bzhin slob phrug mang du phyin/ spyi lo 1991lo 'go tsam nas tshwa zur zhang lags slob grwa'i las don gyi mdzad brel la brten btson par zas gos 'bul bar phebs mi thub kyang / phran dang mi gzhan sogs kyis sngar bzhin chad lus med par btson khang khag la zas gos phul/ btson khang khag tshang mar zhal lag 'bul byed mar ki lor bdun bcu nas brgyad cu tsam dang 'o rtsam gyig shog lnga bcu tsam/ bye ma ka ra ki lor lnga bcu lhag tsam/ de bzhin rtsam pa dang / sha mog sha 'bras/ bag tsha mar khu sogs phon che gtong dgos shing sha mog dang bag leb bzo yul khag gis kyang sha mog dang bag leb zhal 'debs phran bu phul gyi yod/ de dag nas btson pa rer zla rer 'char can mar ki lor gcig tsam dang grwa bzhi srid btson bu ru khag lnga pa'i spyi thab la mar rgya ma bcu nas bcu gsum bar chad med dang btson khang gzhan rnams kyi spyi thab la mar ki lo kha shas re bcas 'bul gyi yod/spyi lo 1991 lo mjug nas de sngon mnyam rogs phyogs bskyod

188 zhing pa'i dran tho/byas pas bce na khang khag la 'char can zas gos so/gas 'bul rgyu nga tsho'i phyogs gtogs phran gcig pur thug kyang / the tshom med par sngar bzhin chad med rgyun 'khyongs kyis spyi lo 1992 lo mjug bar phul ba ma zad/gro zhib ki lor brgya dang don lnga tsam gyi kha zas dkar gro bsregs te phul ba dang / da dung lo gsar la tshag sha smad ling bzhi tsam nyos nas lcug btang ste skam por phul ba kha zas bzo mi dang sha lcug gtong mi da lta'ang 'tsho bzhugs yod/ 'on kyang skabs de dus lha sa khul du mi 'ga' zhig gis rig 'dzin chos nyid kyis da lta btson khang sogs su 'gro spron 'di lta bu btang ba rjes su rang btsan 'thob mtshams rtsis khra chen po zhig gasnga na rtsis yod pa red/ ces dang / kha cig gis kho tshor bod gzhung gis btson pa'i ched 'char can 'thod gron phon che gtong gi yod nges kyis srid btson zhig gi ma rgan nad mnar gyi nad g.yog gi gla sku gas/ dka' ngal yod 'dug pa khyed rang tshor ma ṇi'i dngul dang ro'i dngul med dam zhes brjod pa dang /nyin zhig rgu tsha btson khang nas spyodad 'grol btang ba'i btsun ma kha shas sngar gyi sdod gnas nas phyid phud de gar sdod cha ma mchis pa'i skabs/ lha sa'i grong khul mi zhig gis btsun ma de rnams la gshong kha gling kha'i nye 'gram mnyam las chen po zhig gi bsang 'bum chen po sku da pa'i khang pa'i nang pa lags shig yod/ kho nga gis khang pa thabs shes byed kyi red ces lam ston

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang bi lha sa'i 'i rgol/ 189byas pa ltar btsun ma gsum mnyam las su phran thug par slebs/rang nyid la blo dkar ba'i mi zhig gis kyang phran la gathodang kha gling kha'i nye 'khor sdod mkhan zhig la btsan byol bod gzhung phyogs nas dngul phon chen 'byor gyi sku da 'dra zhes mi gzhan gyis brjod kyi 'dug ces brjod/ de ltar mi phal mo zhig gi 'char snang du phran la gron dngul phon che'i yong khungs yod nges dang btson par lta rtog byed mi ched 'dzugs yin par snyam gyi sku da/ don dngos rang nyid kyis bod don las 'gul brtsams pa nas btsan byol ma yong bar gzhan nas byung ba khag gsal bshad zhu rgyur/spyi lo 1990 nang 'di phyogs nas rgya sgor 5000 bskur 'byor byung ba de'i 'byor lan du bu rang gis da res ma ṇi ril bu grangs lnga stong tham pa bskur 'a5ོོra byung ba thugs rje che/ de dag bed spyod legs par bya rgyu las gnas skabs ma ṇi ril bu bskur mi dgos zhus sku da/ yang lo der 'di phyogs nas bskur tshul mi zhig gis rgya sgor 6000 tsam dang rjes tsam nas rgya sgor 1000 bcas sprad pa las grangs ga tshod bskur min gsal bshad byas ma byung /spyi 'ong 1991 lo tsam la gus nas mi 'gro zhig la ngag thog gi mngags bya zhig zhus don la de nas mi 'ga' shas la phyag gron galta/nga gnang mdzad kyi yod tshod la mi gang byung la 'bo gron ma gnang na legs tshul dang

190 zhing pa'i dran tho/gus pa tsho ni/ zhu sems rtsa ba nas med lugs brgyud zhu bya rogs zhes mngags bya zhus kyang ji bzhin zhus min ma nges/ de min phyi rgyal ba'i sbyin bdag chen po zhig yod tshul brjod par gus phyi rgyal ba'i skad yig tshig gcig mi shes rung / phyi rgyal bar bod don brgyud bsgrags bya rgyu mtha' dag gus kyi 'thab grogs dge 'dun rin chen brgyud byed kyi yod pa/ khong deng dus bal yul du a ri'i rgyang sring rlung 'phrin gyi gsar 'god pa gnang nas bzhugs sku da pa khong nas gsal por mkhyen nges dang / btsan byol bod gzhung nas phran la gron dngul phon che btang yod med 'brel yod las khungs ma lag dang bcas nas gsal mkhyen yin/ mi sger 'das po shag byang skal bzang tshe dbang gis dngul dmar dang dpal 'byor gyi rogs ram gang thub gnang zhing / yang snga phyi bsdoms rgya sgor 3000 tsam sprod mi re gnyis dang zas dang sman rigs gang sa nas rogs ram mdzad mkhan kha shas ya da/rgya phyogs nas nyen kha dang de ltar rang phyogs nas kyang gzhi med kyi sgro 'dogs la ma ltos par nus shugs dang thabs shes gang yod bton te zas gos sogs btson khang du gtong thub na dga' spro dang bcas phul bas rang nyid la nyen kha yang gang tsam 'phrad/ gsang yib btson khang sbug mar zas gos bskyal skabs nang chen ba karma don grub/ a mdo ba a led/ chu

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang gi lnga sa'i zhi rgol/ 191shur ba karma/ dkar mdzes pa thub bstan dge legs bcas la lha khul nang mi spun mched sdudags gang yang med par brten/ phran gyis nang mi bzhin btson srung bar 'gro lugs snyan seng zhus nas lto sgor gcig tu skad btang gi yod/ de min grong gseb khul gyi btson par nang mis de tsam slebs thub min bcas la zhal lag phul gyi yod stabs/ nyin gcig btson srung ba phur bu tshe ring gis khyod kyis mdo stod smad sogs yul lung gang sa'i mi la zas gos sdu/gas sprad dgos rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/zhes zas gos sprad ma bcug par phyir phud/ yang nyin gcig phran dang tshe smon gling sku zhabs zla ba mchog gnyis thug 'phrad byed mi'i khongs yod kyang yar ma btang bar bkag nas khyed gnyis rtag par zas phon che khyer yo nga ba tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs shig gi red nga/ma/ zhes gshe gshe btang /phran gnyis kyis tshogs pa sgrig 'dzugs gang gi yang min par ngos gnyis sger gyi yin/ thugs rjes gzigs/ brjod pas mthar thug 'phrang/ byed bcug tsam byung / spyi lo 1992 lo'i bod kyi lo gsar 'char nyer phran gcig pu gang sar 'gro dgos la brten 'brel yod khong mi gcig la dkar gro dang rten 'byung cha tshang 'bul rogs da lta rgya gar du bzhugs pa a cag bsod nams chos sgron sbran te mnyam bcar zhus par khong gis byi ril spus legs gang tsam nyos te phul/

192 zhing pa'i dran tho/spyi lo 1992 lor phran gyi 'thab grogs gcig nas 'brel ba thog ma byas te phyi rgyal grogs po gsum gyis 'char gzhi ltar lha sa nas stod gangs dkar ti si'i bar gnas tshul mkho bsdu dang / brnyan 'phrin par blang ched 'grul bzhud gzhan dang mi 'dra bar gang du sdod dgos kyang sdod rgyu dang / ga dus 'gro dgos kyang thon chog bcas byed thub pa'i rlangs 'khor zhig gra sgrig dgos lugs brjod pa bzhin phran dang 'thab grogs gzhan zhig gis shar rlung rtags can rlangs 'khor che ba zhig glas te gra sgrig byas shing /phyi rgyal ba'i grogs po tshor stabs bde'i bza' chas dang / chu lham/ char khebs sogs dgos mkho gang tsam gra sgrig byas nas lha sa nas 〈snan te stod gangs rin po che'i bar skor bskyod byas nas tshur 'khor skabs/ rlangs 'khor bdag pos sa cha gang sar 'gro dgos byung ba dang rlangs 'khor 'gro gron che lugs sogs la bsnyad de gtan khel ba'i gla cha'i khar snon ma gang tsam sprod dgos byung / phran gyis rlangs 'khor gyi rdal gla dang rdal gla kha snon sprad pa sogs gron dngul gang tsam btang ba las zhib phra'i 'gan phran gyi 'thab grogs khong gis mdzad pas kha byang sogs zhib phra dri rtsad byed rgyu ma byung na/ zhib phra 'thab grogs dge 'dun rin chen gyis gsal bshad mjug skyong gnang ba'i re ba yod/spyi 'o/ 1992 'o/ mjug tsam nas bcesan khang khag la zhal lag

lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang rge lha sa'i zhi rgol/ 19kedang tsag tsig phu'/ ba'i 'gro song zla rer rgya sgor 3000 nas 3000tsam bar 'gro yi sku da pa phran gyi grogs dge 'dun rin chen gyis zla ba gnyis gsum gyi 'thod song thabs 'tshol gnang byung / de bzhin phran nas btson pa nad pa kha shas la khag theg 'gan len zhus nas sman khang la khrid pa dang sman khang du gron dngul snga snur gte mar sprad pa/ nad g.yog bzhag pa/ nad khang du bsdad 'thus thabs shes dang gron dngul btang ba sogs bgyis/spyi lo 1992 gsum lnga dang gsum bcu'i dus dran/ bod kyi sku gsar bcas kyi skabs yi ge zhig lha sar 'grems spel zhus pa cha tshang 1992 zla 6 shes bya'i nang bkod thon byung 'dug pa bcas mdor bsdus tsam dang / gong 'khod lo zla de dag gi nang lha la yig sogs 'grems spel byas pa'i yig rigs mang dag cig ring min tshang ma'i spyan lam du gzigs 'bul thub pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu yod/

194 zhing pa'i dran tho/le tshan bcu gnyis/lngasted gnas khyab spel brgyud bsgrags dang bros gyol/phran spyi lo 1987 'o/ 'gor rgya gar du yong skabs bzhugs sgar rda ram sa lar rang gzhung phyi dril las khungs kyi skabs de'i drung che brag g.yab pa bsod nams stobs rgyas dang 'brel ba nan tan zhus te bka' mngags ltar bod nang 'byor rjes gnas tshul dang / tshags shog sogs rim 'bul zhus par 'byor lan tsam yang ma byung bas phyi dril las khungs dang 'brel ba mjug skyong ma byung yang gnas 'brel zhus pa'i yig rigs da lta'ang khungs ldan yod 'dug pas zhib rtsad zhus na kha gsal yong rgyu dang /rang gzhung bde srung las khungs la 'brel ba zhus te btson khang khag nang chab srid btson pa ji yod ming tho dang / khrims chad lo dus/ btson pa 'ga'i

bod gnas khyab spel brgyud bsgrags dang bros byol/ 195khrims chad kyi yig cha ngo bshus/ 'ga' zhig 'ju bzung byed pa dang nyes rdung gtong ba'i par rigs sogs zla ba gnyis gsum mtshams bsdoms re brgyab nas zla dus tshes grangs bkod nas 'bul lam rgyun zhus dang /thengs gcig grong khyer 'dzugs skrun 'char 'god las khungs kyis ched du bajo sa pa'i rgya nag rgyal yongs kyi sa khra dang / lha sa grong khyer gathong bor byas pa'i de'i khyab khongs rdzong khag gi sa khra/ lha sa grong khyer gyi sa khra bcas sa khra khag gsum bde srung las khungs la phul/ de bzhin gnad che'i deb cig a rir dus nga/bang gnang skabs 'bul lam zhu rgyur a ri ba zhig brgyud bskur/ bud med kyi mngal nas phru gu 'don byed lag cha cha tshang dang phru gu mngal nang gtor byed sman khab/ btson par rgyag byed lag lcags/ slog rgyug nyen rtog pa'i bed spyod pa'i gri ang rtab/sa can/ spyi lo 1992lo'i 'khrungs lha dbyar gsol nyin khrom gzigs sgang du bod mi rtsam shod galta nga mkhan la rgya mi'i nyen rtog pas gri brgyab nas bsad pa'i nang 'jam khrag ral can sags bskur/gtso bo bde srung las khungs la rang nyid kyis rgyun sring u tshugs ngang 'brel ba zhu thabs dang / 'di phyogs kyi 'brel yod bal yul du 'das grongs gyur pa byams pa la sogs mi grangs bcu sgor la 'brel ba rim par zhus/ gus kyis 'bul lam zhus pa'i par rigs 'ga' zhig 'di khul sger

196 zhing pa'i dran tho/gyi tshags shog dang/ deb sogs kyi thog bar lam bkod thon byung bzhin pa bcas ni ji yin rang nyid nas 'grel brjod mi thub pa dang / phran spyi lo 1980 nas lha sar gnas bcas te spyi lo 1993 bar gnas yig dang par rigs sogs je mang phul ba 'di gar 'byor rjes lo rgyus gnad bsdus phyogs sgrig thub res bka' drung yig tshang dang / bde srung las khungs/ phyi dril las khungs bcas la ngo bshus re bstsal ba'i re ba zhu skabs bde srung dang / phyi dril las khungs nas yi ge dang par re zung gi ngo bshus las de min rnams rag thabs ma byung ba bcas so/spyi lo 1991 lo 'gor gnas chung chos skyong chen po'i bka' lung du 7rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbyangs snyan dang /snyedam tshig rdo rje'i 'das pa 'bum ther du ma gsog sgrub dgos pa'i bka' lung gi phyag bris shig lha sar 'byor 'phral gus kyis shing par par byang spyodan tshig dang bcas pa bzhengs te/ par rgyag rogs shig sbran nas khri gcig lhag tsam par brgyab ste gang sar rin med 'grems spel zhus/ spyi lo 1992lo 'go tsam la chab srid lam ston dang ma 'ongs bod kyi rtsa khrims rin po che'i deb lha sar 'byor 'phral phran dang mi gzhan zhig mnyam shing par blta rgyu'i 'phros mo la gyis mi gzhan gyis par sngo sa bcu bzhi dang / phran gyis par ngo sa nyer drug bcas par brkos mthar par shing phran gyis nyar te shog

bod gnas khyab sngel brgyud bsgrags dang bros byol/ 197bu sogs snyadas nas mi gzhan gyis sngagags ram codig par cha tshang khri lhag tsam brgyab nas gang sar rin med 'grems spel dang mdo smad rnga pa khul la mi brgyud thengs gcig sum stong bskur/ spyi lo 1991 zla 3 par a mi ri kha'i bod skad rlung 'phrin dbu tshugs rjes bod don skor dang 7skyabs mgon rin po che'i mdzad 'phrin sogs rim bzhin sgra 'jug 'khor thag thog bcug nas rgya gang cher rin med 'grems spel zhus/ yang 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang /a ri'i srid 'dzin sbu shī mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i sku par zhig rag byung ba par chung ba in ci bdun tsam yod pa'i grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor lha sar par slog brgyab pa dang / che ba in ji nyi shu can lha sar par slog brgyag ma thub stabs rgya nag gran rdu grong khyer du par slog brgyab ste r+yāng ba rnams rin med 'grems spel dang / che ba rnams nang khul nyar tshags zhus/ de bzhin lo re'i gsum dus bka' slob dang shes bya dus deb sogs re zung lag 'byor byung ba gang thub par slog dang 'grems spel zhus/ rgyal spyi'i thog bod nang gi gnas stangs skabs bsnyun khyab bsgrags ched phran gyis gnas tshul mkho sgrub thabs shes yod rgu byas pa rnams 'thab grogs dge 'dun rin chen gyis dbyin yig tu bsgyur ba'i 'gan blangs/ snga phyi'i dril bsgrags yig cha rnams 'grems spel byed rogs slo mthun mi nyung ba zhig

198 zhing pa'i dran tho/gis rang nyid kyi srog la ltos med phran gyi blo 'dod ltar mdzad byung ba ni gnas stangs de lta bur bsams na bya ba chung ngu zhig gtan nas min/spyi lo 1992 zla 6 par phran gyi las ༷/la mi mang mnyam sdeb tu mu mthud bod don yig cha snum par rgyag skabs bza' zla bkra shis dbang mos phran las ro/na gnyer bzhin pa ma shes par/ zodang sga bde ba am ril mnyam las kyi lha khang la blta bar yong ba khrid de sgo phye ste glo bur 'dzul byung ba/ phran snum par brgyab mus khar yig cha par brgyab rim bzhin gdan steng bskams te bzhag yod pa bza' zla bkra shis dbang mo sa rgyab rnyes kyis yig cha bkab khul byas kyang / khege pas yig skyur par phru ga byed pa gsal por shes so/nga ba phran gyis kho par kha ma grags par mig 'bur tshugs bltas pas kho pa kha skyengs ngang lha khang yag smra 'dug ces bsnyu da nas yig char blta zhib ma nus par phyir log phyin/ kho pa ni rgya dmar la slo rtse gcig ltos byed pa'i rgyug khyi rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs kyi nye 'brel dang rgyug khyi rtser son yin pa lha khul mi sna chab srid la do snang can tshang mas ngos 'dzin byed yul zhig red/ bza' zla bkra shis dbang mos da dpe bsags song /ci bya dgos sam/ kho pa bza' tshang gnyis ma cang rgyan rtsed shugs cher byed kyi yod pas dngul dang mar spus legs gang tsam bcas khyer nas sku mkhyen/da res gnas tshul de su zhig la yang ma gsungs rogs/ zhes brdzod na

bod gnas khyab spel brgyud bsgrags dang bros byedal/ 199gang 'dra yong ngam zer ba/ phran gyis de ltar byas nas gnas tshul ldab skyor btang na legs po e yong / da snang med du bzhag rgyu las 'os med/ da res ma bshad kyang gang ltar kho pas rgya mir bshad rgyu nges can red ces bzhag skabs lo de'i phyi zla 10 pa tsam nas 'go tshugs te/ rang skyong ljongs gsang ba'i las khungs kyi mi snas nga tsho'i bzo grwa'i 'go khrid la phran gyi slor skad cha 'dri yi yod tshul dang / mi zhig gis phran gyi slor rang skyong ljongs gsang ba'i las khungs la snyan seng zhus te gsang ba'i las byed mi sna zhig ched mngags nged la blta zhib byed par ched btsugs byas pa'i ming bcas gcig la gcig brgyud gsang thabs kyis 11sa/ 'brel yod khag gis da mgyogs myur nyen yol ma thub tshe 'dzin bzung bya nges yin pa'i gnas tshul dza drag je che je cher thug pa sa phran gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen seng ge rin po che'i sku mdun bcar nas gnas stangs dza drag la thug skor dang / da cha rgya gar la 'aspos rgyu las thabs shes med stabs gra sgrig sogs ji ltar bya na bzang thugs dam skyabs 'jug zhus don ltar gra sgrig zhu bzhin dril bsgrags kyi sku chas dang yig cha rnams gtsang ma bachodas/ rgya gar nas lha sar phebs pa'i a pho tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang / khong gi las rogs gnyis kyi mkho dbo sa rnams bsgrubs shing mthun 'gyur cha tshang zhus mtshams khong tsho phyir phebs/ phran gyi gnas stangs dza drag ngang gnas yod pa khong gnyis

200 zhing pa'i dran tho/kas gsal por mkhyen no//phran spyi lo 1993 zla 1 tshes 17 bar gang ci'i skabs bstun gra ma 'grig par sems tshab ngang lus ring / rang nyid la blo dkar nang ma du mas dza drag bskul bcag gis 'phral myur phyi phyogs la ma thon tshe dpe bsags yong zer ba dang / 'ga' shas kyis gegs sel rim gro sogs gnang mi byung / zla ba de'i tshes 17 snga dro nam gsal tsam la lha sa nas thon khar rang gi 'brel yod mi kha shas la sngo sa gnyis gtsang la so nam lo gsar ring gnyen 'phrad 'gro tshul brjod nas thon/ skabs der bzo grwa'i 'go khrid gtso bdag gsum rgya nag gren tur phyin pas stabs bde byung yang rgya dmar gyis shes tshor byung nas rjes ded bya mi yong ngam bsams nas sems 'tshab ci che'i ngang nas lam zhugs kyis nyin gung tshod bcu gnyis tsam la gzhis rtser 'gyor/skabs der gzhis rtser mi gnyis srog gcod pa'i khrims chad tshogs chen 'tshogs pas rlangs 'khor la snum dus thog ma blugs par chu tshod gsum tsam 'gor/ spyi tshes bco brgyad nyin gyi snga dro nam gsal tsam la gnya' nang rjong du 'byor nas bza' khang zhig nang kha lag bzas te 'gram 'gag sgo bar ki lo mi ḍar nyi shu tsam las med pa'i sar 'byor skabs/mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mchorware thugs rjes mi zhig gis bal yul bzo grwa

bo da gnas khyab srel brgyud bsgragres dang bros byol/ na01zhig gi bal len mkhan rlangs 'khor zhig tu bal ༷/la bar 'jug rgyu ma zad/'gag lha/ra yang rogs ram gang zab byas/ 'gag sgo mar don mtshams phyir gtong ca dngos zhib bsher khang du bal do grangs bsher byed ring sgo 'gram phran gnyis chu chodad 'ga' shas sgug dgos byung ba/ sems nang lha sa nas 'gag lha re nyen rtewag par kha par 'byor nas bkag bskyil bya mi yong ngam bsams nas dngangs 'argab ha cang chen po byung /'on kyang gnas tshul gang yang ma byung bar bal do dbor mkhan gyi sbyin bdag sogs mi gsum rlangs 'khor chen po de'i kha lo ba sdod sa'i mdun du bsdad cing / nged gnyis dang bal po gcig rgyab gral du bsdad de bskyod mur zam sne'i rgya mi'i nyen rtog pas bal po yin dbang las mar bab dgos kyang ma byung bar zam chen phar sne'i bal po'i khral sar bde 'gyor thub pas sems ltod bder gyur/ bal yul rgyal sar 'byor skabs sbyin bdag des rgyal sar ngo shes yod dam dris kyang rjes su ngage skyon ji yong cha ma mchis pas ngo shes med ces lan btab/ sbyin bdag des da lta sne len khang la bskyodad tshe brlags dor yang yong nyen che bas rlangs 'khor nang nga tsho'i mi gcig srung mir byāsdad kyi red/ khyed gnyis kyang rlangs 'khor nang bsdad na 'grig gam/ zhes brdzod byung bas thugs rje che zhes zhus te rlangs 'khor ga nga nyal/ sang nyin nyi ma shar mtshams nas kha 'o/ ba sdudags

202 zhing pa'i dran tho/bal po gsum gyis bzo grwa zhig tu bal do rnams phab/ rlangs 'khor chung ba zhig glas te phran gnyis sne len khang la bskyal dbo sa kha brda bgyis nas 'gram nas bal yul bar gyi rdal gla sdudags rtsa ba nas dgos skor ma bshad kyang / phran gyis kha lo ba der bal sgor brgya dang rogs pa der lnga bcu sprad de bzo grwa'i kha byang sprad rogs zhes blangs nas thus/sa rje che zhu ba'i gus tshul byas/ bal yul sne len khang du khang chung zhig g.yar nas zur sdod byas pa las bros byol yong lugs dang gsar 'gyor ba'i thob thang sne gcig ma zhus shing / sne len khang du 'byor 'phral rang nyid kyi 'thab grogs bal yul rgyal sar gtan bzhugs smar khams pa rta mgrin rdo rjer zhal par phul bas/lam seng steng zhal gnyis sbag sbag sgyu ga phebs te bza' chas dang gsol ja gya nom pa drangs te bros byol thub par ha cang spro ba chen po gnang / khong gnyis kyi khyim du spo dgos gsungs kyang sne len du nyin shas las bsdad rgyu min pa nga/nga de'i ring mchod rten nye 'gram a zhang blo rdor gyi sku mdun du'ang 'gro dgos yod ces brjod/ skabs der sne len khang du 'thung chu snga dro thun re las med pa de yang nga gnyis la thob kyi mi 'dug pas dga' nye ngo shes/ rnams kyis 'thung chu rim par bskyal/ nyin gcig phran a zhang blo rdor mchog mjal bar bcar skabs bros byedal thub par dgyes mnyes chen ngo gnang gi 'dug pa ma zad/ spyi lo 1987 lo mjug la bod mi'i dpa'

bod gnas khyab spel brgyud bsgrags dang wa sa byedal/ na03bo rgan blo bzang dbang phyug dam pa'i sku phung la bsgron pa'i sku par cha chang 'brel yod las khungs la phul ba dang spyin shog bdag nyar gnang ba phran la rtsis sprad/bal yul sne len khang du phran gnyis yun ring sdod ma dgos pa'i re 'dun che yang sne len khang gis 'grul thon thengs kha shas thog ma btang bar nyin bcu drug tsam bal yul du lus mthar bzhugs sgar du spyi zla gnyis pa'i zla stod du 'gyor/ lha sa nas tshur thon skabs 'brel yod rnams kyis yig rigs mo gas gnad che'i rigs rtsa ba nas mnyam khyer bya rgyu med pa'i kha brda gnang yang / phran gyis sha skam bsrel lcug ras phad gang yod pa'i nang btson pa kha shas kyi par dang rgya gzhung gi bod kyi skad yig lha ra cho gas 'du zhig gi sar 7paṇa chen sku gong ma dang / nga phod rnam gnyis kyis 'dzem zon spu tsam med par gnang ba'i bka' slob kyi sgra phab 'khor thag sogs khyer yod pa 'di gar phul/ rda sar mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi gsham khang pa 'og shod cig tu gnas g.yar byas nas bsdad de nyin gsum tsam rjes 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen rngotsware mjal kha legs par bstsal thob byung / cadan kyang bod nang bod don skor bsgrub rgyu'i las don ji mang yod pa sems nang 'gog me+ed 'char te zla shas rjes bod du log na ci 'dra yong thugs dam zhig zhu dgos snyam pa yod/

204 zhing pa'i dran tho/lo de'i phyi zla bzhi par 7gong sa mchog gis sgang tog tu dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen bstsal skabs bcar te dbang chen gyi spyor dngos rjes gaskum gtsang ma zhu thub pa'i skal bzang dga' bde'i thog ngeng/ gnyis bod nasi gsang bros ma 'ong sngon phran dang / 'thab grogs zhig gis 'di khul gnad don kha shas 'brel ba zhu mi zhig mngags yod kyang khong rda sar 'byor nas 'brel ba zhu yul gnad khel ma byung ba 'am/ gang ltar khong la 'di khul gnad don thag gcod ma byung bar phran bu'i thugs yid ma ches pa lta bur gnas 'dug pas phran nas 'brel yod la ngos sbyor zhib zhus mthar/ sgang tog gi dus dbang grub rjes mi der gnad don thag gcod byas 'thus gsung don ltar dus dbang grub mtshams 'brel yod las khungs la phran gyis mi de mnyam khrid thodag ngo bcar zhus/ zhu don rnams kyi re 'bras don smin byung bas phran gyis mi der lam thodan dang gyon chas ga re dgos sprad 'thus brjod de lham cha gcig sprad pa ma blangs kyang / dngul phran tsam u tshugs kyis sprad mthar 'brel yod mi zhig ngos sbyor gnang nas bal yul du dgos mkho sprad rgyu byas/lo de'i spyi zla 5 tshes 15 nyin bde srung drung gzhon a pho dga' dgas dge 'dun rin chen dang / tsha zur zhang blo bzang yon tan gnyis spyi zla 5 tshes 13 nyin rgya mis 'dzin bzung byas pa/ khong

bod gnas khyab spel brgyud bsgrasas dang bros byol/ 205gnyis kyi lo rgyus 'phral du 'god 'bul dgos lugs 'brel yod las khungs nas gsungs shing spyi tshes 17 tsam la a ri'i bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis khong gnyis 'dzin bzung byas skor rgyang sring byas/ phran gnyis lha sa nas thon te nyin gnyis rjes phran gyi mkhar dngos tshang ma thengs gnyis sngog bsher byas pa dang las yul bzo grwa'i 'grems ston lha khang gi mchod gshom rnams kyang ྅ ga bsher byas pa ma zad/ phran bza' tshang gnyis sa mtshams nas 'ju bzung yang byas tshul/ yang / gus dang 'brel ba yod pa'i rlangs 'khor kha lo bar rig 'dzin bza' tshang gnyis 'gram bar bskyal ba red ces sogs snga gas gnas ha cang chen po byed pa bcas la brten bod du phyir log bya thabs med par sdod dgos byung ngo //

naXsnyo zhing pa'i dran tho/le tshan bcu gsum/btsan dregel spyi snumags nang sri zhu/spyi 'o/ 1994 zla 4 tshes 8 nas nyin lnga ring bka' shag tshogs khang du dbus gtsang chol kha'i dmigs bsal tshogs chen skabs phran skabs lnga pa'i dbus rgyun khongs 'os 'dems gnang ba ltar lo gcig ring drung che rje drung bstan 'dzinabyudang phran gnyis rgyun sdod zhus shing / gong ga/sal dbus gtsang chol kha'i dmigs bsal tshogs chen skabs thag chod pa'i rgya gar rgyal sa ldi li nas bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa bar zhi ba'i bo ma bsku da 'gro mi'i dang blang khongs mir phran ming 'god zhus/ spyi lo 1995 lor dbus gtsang tshogs chen skabs drug pa'i rgyun las la yang bskyar bdams thon byung ba ma zad/ rgyun sdod drung cher bdams bskos byung / snga lo dbus gtsang chodal kha'i dmigs bsal tshogs chen la gtan khel ba'i gom bgrod

btsan byol spyi tshomags nang srid zhu/ 207skor sa/zhung 'brel ma yin pa'i tshogs pa brgyad la yang bka' bsdu ra zhus te las bgos so sor zhus pa/ gom bgrod kyi tshogs gtso dang gur sgron rgyag dbus gtsang chol khas bgyi dgos pas/ spyi lo 1995 lo'i 'o/ 'gor mon gho dus dbang skabs zhi ba'i gom bgrod ched zhal 'debs bsdu rgyu dang / lhag par dus 'khor gra sgrig lhan tshogs su sngon tshud nas re 'dun zhus pa ltar ras gur rnams rin med bstsal byung ba/ phran dang bod nas gsar phebs ngo shes kha shas la rogs pa gnang rogs zhus nas ras gur mar 'beb pa dang / bsdu gsog las khungs bar sgal par dbor ba sogs byas pa dang / skabs der chol kha gsu/ma ma/nyam sbrel zhu rgyu 7gong sa mchog la mtshan 'khod snyan zhu 'bul lam zhu thub pa byung ba sogs rang nyid kyis gang thub spyi don thog lhag bsam hūr bskyed zhus/spyi lo 1995 zla 2 tshes 17 nyin bzhugs sgar theg chen chodas gling gtsug lag khang dus 'khor lha khang du 7gong sa mchog nas zhi ba'i gom bgrod kyi rgyun las dang / dang blang mi mang bzhugs sgar khul yod bcas mi brgya dang lnga bcu tsam la mjal kha dang zab gsal bka' slob phebs shing / spyi lo 1995 zla 3 tshes 10 la bo ma bgrod pa rnams dalnga sa su rdog thon byed nyin rngogong sa mchog gis theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang gsung ra nas gangs can skyid gshongs bar dbu khrid de zab gsal

208 zhing pa'i dran tho/bka' slob bstsal/ rang nyid kyis zhi ba'i gom bgrod pa'i dbu gur sgron rgyag gi 'gan 'khur mtha' 'khyodangs zhus/ dbus gtsang skabs drug pa'i tshogs chen gyi gros chod dgongs don 7gong sa skyabs mabo na chen gro'i sku'i dgung skeg la sku phywa'i zhabs rim du sgrol ma 'bum ther dgung grangs dang mnyam pa gsog ji/ba sdokyi rgyur sa rgyun khag la rang mos zhal 'debs bsdas bskul bya rgyus mtshon/ dbus sa'i 'brel pa 'thus shor med pa sems chung thabs mkhas ngang zhus te ris med sa dge bka' rnying dgon sde che khag mang che bar sgrol ma 'bum ther rer mchod bawen hin sgor chig khri nyis stong lnga brgya dang lha reg skyabs tho re bcas phul te sgrol ma 'bum ther re lnga kha skong dang bcas legs bsgrubs byung ngo /spyi lo 1996 dpyid chos mjug 7gong sa mchog la brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul chog pa'i mtshan 'kho da snyan sgre na 'bul lam bka' bzhed thob ste brtan bzhugs rgyas pa bstar 'bul zhus pa'i skabs/ in ji so drug tsam gyi tshad sku da pa'i gser zangs skus thog drangs in ji bcu drug gi tshad yod pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig dang / thugs rten byang chub mchodad rten/ gsung rten mdo sde skal bzang dang brgyad stong pa sogs 'degs 'bul zhus/ rang nyid spyi lo 1994 nas spyi 'o/ 1998 bar dbus gtsang chol kha'i rgyun las byed ring dbus gtsang chodal khas gsol 'debs zhus dodan

btsan gyol spyi tshobs nang srid zhu/ kai09ltar 7gong sa mchodag gis lo ltar theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin theg chen gso sbyong bstsal smin byung /spyi lo 1996 lor srid tshab bde mkhar ba dang srid tshab blo bzang bkra shis gnyis kyi sku par dang lo rgyus btsan byol nang mthong thos dka' bas/ byas pa can gyi srid tshab de gnyis kyi sku tshe'i lo rgyus dang sku par dgos gal malnga nga nas gang sar 'brel ba zhus pa sku tshe'i lo rgyus phyo gas bsdus byed ma thub kyang / sku par re bzhengs thub par rjes su dbus gtsang chol khas blu yono gnong ste dbus gtsang chol kha'i yig tshang du gnyug mar bzhugs sde/ gsal yad/spyi 'o/ 1997 lor rang nyid la glang zur sku zhabs blo chodas kyis dpal 'byor rogs ram mdzad pa bzhin rda sar mkhas dbang khag gdan zhus kyis mi mang gi go ho gas spel ched brjod gzhi 'dra min thog res gza' spen pa nam 'char la gsung bshad go sgrig thengs du ma zhus/spyi lo 1996 lo mjug zhi ba'i gom bgrod thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su rang nyid gom bgrod nang zhugs thub med kyang sa lu sgar 7gong sa mchog nas dpal dus kyi 'khor 'otsware bka' dbang stsal sprodab skabs/ zhi ba'i gom bgrod kyi gron dngus zhal 'debs bsdu rgyu dbus gtsang dang mdo lha da chol kha gnyis kyis 'gan 'khur yin par brten/ zhal 'debs bsdu

na10 zhing pa'i dran tho/rgyu'i las ka gzengs su thon pa zhus/spyi lo 1995 zla 9 pa'i nang u ri sa/ ma ta spa ti/ sban rda ra / nag spur bcas la dril bsgrags sucimado stod tshogs gtso ṅgan mgo se/ mdo smad dbus rgyun rgyal mtshan/ dbus gtsang dbus rgyun phran rig 'dzin chos nyid bcas nas gyo/sal bshad dril bsgrags chol kha'i dbus spyi khyab rgyun las khang nas gtan 'bebs 'char zin ltar zhus par/ dogs dri khag la'ang gsal shad gang thub zhus pa ma zad/ ma ta spa tir byams pa rin chen zer pa zhig gis dri ba yin khul ham bshad je che byas byung bar 'dzems zon dang 'jigs zhum med par bden ro/na dang 'brel lan 'debs mthar phyin byas/yang spyi lo 1997 zla 1 nang mang mos 'os bsdu'i zab sbyong skabs phran dbus gtsang dzadal kha'i sku tshab zhus nas tshogs bcar skabs/bod mi mang spyi 'thus karma chos 'phel gyis rang btsan skor bshad rjes dbu ma'i lam lo rgyus kyi sdig nyes yin lha ra sogs dang / rgya bod dbar gyi byung rim dngos dang ma mthun pa'i 'khyogs po'i gtam bshad ji mang byas par rang nyid nas 'dzems gzon med par dngos byung gnas tshul gsal brjod dang dri ba thad kar bgyis pa skabs de'i brnyan 'phrin 'khor thag dang sgra 'dzin 'khor thag tu gsal yodad/

btsan gyol spyi tshogs nang srid zhu/ na11spyi lo 1997 zla 11 nang chol kha gsum gyi dbus rgyun rnam sa khag bgod phyo gas bskyod dril bsgrags dang / tshags thodag ched zhal 'debs 'du 'god la 'gro skabs phran dang / mdo stod dbus rgyun sga pa blo gros bzang po/ mdo smad dbus rgyun tshogs gachodan blo bzang rgya mtsho bcas rgya gar byang shar sa khul mang che bar zla ba gnyis tsam bskor bskyod 'gro skabs she long gi mi mang brgya cha dgu bcu lhag gi sne len dang / tsogs 'dzoms zhal 'debs bsdu 'bul sogs rang 'gul gyi mthun 'gyur zab kyang / ro/la rgyal bsten gsol byed pa'i dud tshang bcu lhag tsam gyis ngan gros tshajags 'dzoms byas rjes mi drug nga tsho'i sdod gnas su 'gyor te/ chol gsum chig sgril dbus spyi khyab rgyun las nas bton pa'i dol rgyal skor deb nang dol rgyal tshogs pa dang rgya dmar gnyis gcig mtshungs yin skor 'khod pa khungs bskyal dgos pa dang / don tshan gnyis pa/ dol rgyal rnyog gleng las sa gnas mthus tshogs 'the ra bshig gyur pa thag gcad dbo sa pa/ gsum pa / 'di ga'i sa gnas bud med kyis nga tsho rgya mi'i gsang nyul red ces bshad kyi 'dug pa der thag gcod byed dgos/ zhes don tshan gsum thog rtsod gleng byas byung ba/ phran gyis 'dzems zon dang 'jigs zhum spu tsam med par lan 'debs dang 'brel khyed chod tshab tshub byed mi dgos/ bden rdzun mkhyedags myur gsal gyi red sogs lan 'debs byas par chol gsum

21na zhing pa'i dran tho/sa rgyun dang / gasnyadan nu bud med kyi sa rgyun mo gas tshang mas mgrin gcig tu lan 'debs yag po byung zhes tshang ma mgrin pa btegs thub pa byung /sa gnas khag bskor nas dzaXr log skabs spyi lo 1998 zla 1tshes 6 nyin ldi lir za khang zhig nang kha lag za skabs phran la sha dug 'phog nas sposad pa bshal bar bod rgya gang sar sman bcos byas te bshal nad nyin bcu tsam nas drag kyang rkang pa skrang ste sman khang gang sar bsten dgos byung zhing / mthar rkang pa 'bam nad lci pos rgyun ring mnar bas bod sman lo gsum lhag bzas pa dang chu tshan brgyab pa sogs byas kyang da dung yang nad ro lhag 'on kyang rang nyid kyi bsam 'dun ni 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen wa sku tshe mdzad 'phrin gong nas gong 'phel gyi thugs bzhed mtha' dag 'bad med lhu na gyis 'grub pa dang / bod rang dbang gi bden mtha' myur du gsal te 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog bod ljongs kha pa can gyi gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i pho brang po trī la'i gzhal med khang gi mi 'jigs gdong lnga 'bar ba'i rin po che'i khri steng zhabs sor myur du 'khod pa dang /ngo da 'bangs gzhis byes dga' spro mnyam 'dzoms kyi bsam rjodar chodas bzhin bde skyid rdzogs ldan dpal la longs su spyad thub pa'i re smon nyin mtshan kun tu rtse gcig gi zhu bzhin pa ma zad/ dodan gal po che 'di yi sprodag nus pa thon nges dang dgos gal mchis tshe rang gi lus srog tshun blos gtong bya

btsan byol s+t+ri tshogs nang srid zhu/ 213rgyur the chodam med pa'i dam bca' brtan por bzung bzhin/ tshe lhag don ldan zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa bcas kyi mu mthud s+t+ri don ched spyi lo 1998zla 11 nas bzung sa gnas mthus chodags skabs gsum pa dang bzhi pa lo drug ring byas pa dang /spyi lo 2001 zla 5 nas spyi lo 2004 zla 3 bar gyi rang bden tshogs chung / spyi lo 3000 zla 5 nas dbus gtsang chodal kha'i sa gnas 'os bsdu lhan khang gi zur dpang 'o/ lnga bcas bgyis/spyi lo 1993 'e ra btsan byol la 'byor nas bzung bod du chab srid btson pa 'das grongs su gyur pa shes rtog byung phyin/ chodal gsum dbus spyi khyab rgyun las dang / snga da kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshangags pa/de min dza gas pa khag rda sa dang blang mi mang bcas su 'bod bskul zhus don bzhin gong gsal tshogs pa khag gis kyang 'das mchod dang / mar me'i khrom skor/ skabs thog dril bsgrags sogs mdzad pa bcas so//

214 zhing pa'i dran tho/zur bkol dang po/rgyal rtse khul gyi bstan srung dang dmag rnams kyi ming gzhung gang dran b.lo da pa/1) lcang ra sgo khang gi sde pa glang pa sangs rgyal po dang / legs grub grwa tshang gi 'go dpon zur pa blo bzang rdo rje/ lhag tshing se gas kyis 'go khrid 'og dang dmag mi grangs brgya dang bdun bcu skor yod kyang re re bzhin ming ma thob/2) dkyil ma/khar khul nas ka bzhi ka chodar dang / don grub/ gzhan gcig yod pa'i ming ma shes/ ) rgyal rtse0 grong rdal khul nas rje drung 'jam dpa'/ legs smon/dpal cho sa a ba bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ skyes khungs mdo stod nas yin pri rgyal rtser gtan sdod skal bzang / lha dar nang ma/ blo bzang sogs

rgyal rtse khul gyi dustan srung dang dmag rnams kyi ming gzhung gang dran bkod pa/ na15mi bcu bdun yod pa re re ming lag tu ma son/4) bkras sde bkra shis don grub/ rtar gzhis skal bzang bkra shis/ rta ra sras tshe ring chos 'byor/ nya spel skal bzang / rgya mtsho'i chos mdzad// bla brang mgron gyi sras gsang sngags rin chen/ khong gi sku mched gnyis yod pa ming ma dran/5) gur pa grwa tshang khongs nas ngag dbang chos grags/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ grags pa bstan 'dzin/ mkhyen rab rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang ye shes/ ngag dbang bstan pa// ngag dbang chos 'phel/ slo gros 'jigs med/ bstan pa phun tshogs/ ngag dbang mkhyen brtse/ chodas rgyan/6) legs grub grwa tshang nas skal ldan/ sku na tan/ skal bzang chos dbang / rnam rgyal/ brtso na 'grus/7) dus 'khor grwa tshang khongs nas bstan 'dzin chos grags/bstan 'dzin gras/sa pa/ blo gros/ skal chos/8) grangs med che ba grwa tshang nas dge 'dun bstan 'dzin/9) gser 'og grwa tshang nas dbang phyug blo bstan/ chos dar/yon tan/ chos dbang / dge las bsam gtan/ bsam gtan bstan 'dzin/ tshe dbang / yar 'phel/ chos mdzad/ rgyal mtshan chos dar/bsam gtan grags pa/ skal bzang /

21snyo zhing pa'i dran tho/10) zhi gnas grwa tshang nas blo bzang tshe ring / dbang 'dus/byams pa/ ye shes chos 'phel/ ye shes tshe ring / blo bzang yar 'phel/dge 'dun phun chodags/ blo bzang dam chos/ ye shes 'phel rgyas/ ye shes tshe ring / rgya mtsho chodas 'phel/11) lha ri gzim sgug khongs nas ye shes rab rgyas/ chos ldan/12) lha khang grwa tshang khongs nas blo bzang dbang phyug rgya mchod/'phel rgyas/1 ) kha mo grong tsho nas bu chung / 'jigs grags/14) skrub sku dgon nas gtsang dpal rgyal rin po che/ 'khrungs yul li thang /15) phu ma byang thang khul nas phun dkyil bkra shis rdo rje can so/gas mi bcu yod pa re re bzhin ming ma dran/1snyo) khang dmar khul nas dbye chodal jo lags nor 'gram/ tsha kha lho dkon mchog rgyal ma35na/17) ra lung nas stag tshang shar pa'i bu tshab rgya mtsho/spyi 'o/ 1958 rab byung bcu drug sa khyi 'o/ nas rgyal rtse khul nas bstan srung dang blang dmag la zhugs pa'i dmag mi rnams kyi ming lnga gsal rnyed byung ba 173 gong du bkod pa las da dung mtshan ma 'khod pa ji snyed
rgyal rtse khul gyi bstan srung dang darme ga rnam sa kyi ming gzhung sang dran bkod pa / 317yod pa rnams 'brel yod rnams kyis gzigs the ga gis cha tshang ba zhig kha bskang thub pa'i re ba yod/
